Add your leave and personal work time, e.english: Add all leaves, personal time, business trips, and national holidays to your calendar. Set up automatic email replies requesting senders to resend if urgent. When you return to the office, colleagues can set delayed delivery for emails to reach you on a specific date. (Related to Item 82)
Add your leave and personal work time, e.mandarin: 將所有請假、私人時間、公差及國定假日排入行事曆，並設定自動回信引導寄件者在緊急時重新發信。當您休假結束返回崗位時，同事可設定延遲發送，使郵件在特定時間才寄達您信箱。
Add your leave and personal work time, e.taiwanese: 共所有的請假、私人的時間、出差佮國定假日攏排進行事曆，並設置自動回覆，請寄件人若有急事再重新寄信。等你放假返來返工的時陣，同事會使設定延遲寄送，等特定時間才將電子郵件寄予你。

Ask politely with reason and watch out y.english: Ask politely with clear reasons and pay attention to your tone of voice. Mastering these soft skills is key to effective communication.
Ask politely with reason and watch out y.mandarin: 提問或請求時應保持禮貌、附帶合理原因，並注意說話的語氣。這是職場溝通必備的軟實力。
Ask politely with reason and watch out y.taiwanese: 愛有禮貌且講明原因，注意家己講話的聲調。這是職場溝通真要緊的軟實力。

Prepare questions during the meeting. //.english: Prepare questions in advance for meetings. Understand the agenda and the desired outcomes (similar to OKRs) to define your path as a "free agent."
Prepare questions during the meeting. //.mandarin: 在開會前準備好提問清單。充分理解會議議程與預期產出（類似 OKR 目標），讓自己像「自由人」一樣主動控局。
Prepare questions during the meeting. //.taiwanese: 開會前先準備好提問清單。了解會議議程佮預期的產出目標（親像 OKR），予家己像「自由人」仝款主動掌控大局。

Reserve some buffer for your project, an.english: Reserve buffer time for your projects, establishing a "sacred time and place" (a margin of safety) to focus on self-investment, rest, hobbies, and family. Treat time allocation as an investment portfolio. Use your sacred time to enhance your capabilities. (Mindset of subtraction, passion, focus on high-impact tasks, and energy management)
Reserve some buffer for your project, an.mandarin: 為專案保留緩衝空間，建立個人的「神聖時間與空間」（安全邊際），用以投資自我、休息與陪伴家人。將時間視為投資組合，利用不被打擾的神聖時間提升自我能力。（實踐減法思維、熱情思維、抓大魚法則與能量管理）
Reserve some buffer for your project, an.taiwanese: 做專案愛留寡伸知的空間，替家己起造一个「神聖的時間佮空間」（安全邊際），提來投資家己、歇睏佮陪厝內的人。共時間當做投資組合，用彼段無人吵的神聖時間共家己的本事提升起來。（實踐減法思維、熱情思維、掠大尾魚法則佮能量管理）

Don't jump to conclusions too soon. You.english: Avoid jumping to conclusions too quickly. Do not let your "lizard brain" dictate your actions, as instinctual reactions can mislead. Stay humble and acknowledge that you could be wrong.
Don't jump to conclusions too soon. You.mandarin: 不要過早下結論。避免讓「蜥蜴腦」（本能直覺）主導行動，本能的衝動反應往往不夠理智。保持謙遜，隨時意識到自己可能有盲點。
Don't jump to conclusions too soon. You.taiwanese: 毋通傷緊落結論。避免予「蜥蜴腦」（直覺本能）主導行動，本能的衝動反應往往無夠理智。保持謙虛，隨時提醒家己嘛有可能犯錯。

Smile Always smile. A friend is better t.english: Always maintain a smile. It is always better to make a friend than an enemy. Pursue peace and stay calm under any circumstances.
Smile Always smile. A friend is better t.mandarin: 保持微笑。在職場上多一個朋友永遠比多一個敵人好。追求和平，面對任何狀況都要保持冷靜與克制。
Smile Always smile. A friend is better t.taiwanese: 定定面帶笑容。做朋友贏過做對頭。維持和平，無論按怎攏愛保持冷靜與克制。

Ask effective questions in meetings. It.english: Ask high-impact questions in meetings. It is best to prepare a list of questions in advance. (Related to Item 3)
Ask effective questions in meetings. It.mandarin: 在會議中提出有效的問題。最理想的做法是提前準備好問題清單。
Ask effective questions in meetings. It.taiwanese: 開會的時陣，愛問有路用的問題。上好的做法是先共問題清單準備好。

Collect thank you notes for your KPI and.english: Collect appreciation emails and thank-you notes to support your KPI reviews and achievements. Practice neat documentation, consistent naming conventions, and professional preparation (Mise en place).
Collect thank you notes for your KPI and.mandarin: 收集來自同事或客戶的感謝信，作為 KPI 考評與成就證明的佐證。落實文件化管理、統一命名規範，做好隨時備用的準備工作（Mise en place）。
Collect thank you notes for your KPI and.taiwanese: 同事抑是客戶寫來的感謝批愛收予好，做 KPI 考核佮成就的證據。文件愛照規矩管理，號名愛統一，隨時攏準備好勢（Mise en place）。

Don't be jealous of your colleagues and.english: Avoid being jealous of colleagues and do not treat them as best friends, especially since personal interests may conflict. Connect only via LinkedIn rather than private social media (which should have privacy settings set to friends only). Avoid joking with people you do not know well. Always learn from your colleagues, regardless of age, and remain politically neutral.
Don't be jealous of your colleagues and.mandarin: 不要嫉妒同事，也別把同事當成最好的朋友（特別是當利益衝突時）。避免在私人的社群媒體加同事，僅用 LinkedIn 聯絡並確保私人社群的隱私設定。不要對不熟的人開玩笑。不論年資深淺，都要抱持學習態度，且避免進行辦公室政治評判。
Don't be jealous of your colleagues and.taiwanese: 莫怨妒同事，嘛莫共同事當做換帖的（尤其是牽涉著利益的時陣）。私人的社群媒體莫加同事，干焦用 LinkedIn 聯絡，私人社群的隱私設定嘛愛顧予好。無熟的人莫佮伊烏白滾耍笑。毋管年資深抑淺，攏愛有學習的心，莫去品評辦公室政治。

Determine what your priorities are now..english: Identify your current priorities. Learn to distinguish between what you can control and what you cannot. Focus your energy on things under your control, and proactively seek support for things you cannot control. (Related to Item 141)
Determine what your priorities are now..mandarin: 明確當下的首要任務。區分「可控」與「不可控」的事物。將精力集中於可控的事，對於不可控的事物則應適時尋求外部支援與協助。
Determine what your priorities are now..taiwanese: 這馬上要緊的代誌是啥物，愛先想予清楚。愛分會「控制會著」佮「控制袂著」的代誌。氣力囥佇控制會著的代誌，控制袂著的，就愛看時機揣外口的人鬥相共。

Check your spelling before sending the e.english: Check your spelling and grammar (using tools like Google Translate or Grammarly) before sending emails. For urgent cases, writing in Mandarin directly is better than sending confusing English emails.
Check your spelling before sending the e.mandarin: 發信前務必檢查拼字與文法（可善用 Grammarly 等工具）。若是十萬火急的情況，直接寫中文也比發一封文法混亂、容易引起誤會的英文信來得妥當。
Check your spelling before sending the e.taiwanese: 批寄出去進前，一定愛檢查拼字佮文法（會使用 Grammarly 這類的工具）。若是火燒尻川的情形，直接寫中文，嘛較贏寄一張文法亂操操、予人誤會的英文批。

Make sure you learn something during the.english: Ensure you learn something from every project and document the knowledge. These accumulated skills and feedback will boost your career and add significant long-term value.
Make sure you learn something during the.mandarin: 確保自己能從每個專案中學到東西並記錄下來。這些累積的技能與反饋從長期來看，會成為提升自我價值的推進器。
Make sure you learn something during the.taiwanese: 逐个專案攏愛學著物件，閣愛記落來。這寡儉起來的本事佮回饋，長期來看，會變做提升家己價值的推進器。

Don't add your colleagues on social medi.english: Do not add colleagues to your personal social media, limit connections to LinkedIn. Keep emotions out of your posts and professional emails; use standard emojis like smileys to keep the tone light and friendly. (Related to Item 9)
Don't add your colleagues on social medi.mandarin: 除了 LinkedIn 外，不要加同事的私人社群媒體。撰寫貼文或信件時避免帶入過多情緒，適當使用笑臉符號保持語氣友善。
Don't add your colleagues on social medi.taiwanese: 除了 LinkedIn，同事私人的社群媒體莫去加。寫貼文抑是寫批的時陣，莫摻傷濟情緒，適當用笑面的符號，予口氣較友善。

Focus. Follow a course until you succeed.english: Maintain your focus and stay the course until you succeed. Do not give up before reaching your goal. Take a rest if you are tired, but never quit.
Focus. Follow a course until you succeed.mandarin: 保持專注。堅持到底直到成功，在達到目標前絕不輕言放棄。累了可以休息，但不要放棄。
Focus. Follow a course until you succeed.taiwanese: 愛專心。堅持到底，做到成功，目標猶未達成進前，絕對莫輕易放揀。忝矣會使歇睏，毋過毋通放棄。

What easier things can you do right now.english: Ask yourself: What is the simplest action I can take right now (even in 10 seconds) to advance my project or goal? Apply a "minimum viable product" (MVP) and "divide and conquer" mindset. Keep your communications brief, direct, and focused on key points.
What easier things can you do right now.mandarin: 問自己：現在（甚至在10秒內）能做些什麼最簡單的事來推進夢想或專案？（MVP 最小可行產品思維與分而治之法）。下次溝通時，嘗試用最簡單的關鍵字或短語直接切入主題。
What easier things can you do right now.taiwanese: 問家己：這馬（甚至十秒內）會當做啥物上簡單的代誌，來予夢想抑是專案向前行？（MVP 最小可行產品思維佮分而治之法）。後擺溝通的時陣，試看覓用上簡單的關鍵字抑是短句，直接講到重點。

Don’t over-reply to email discussions. T.english: Avoid over-replying in email threads. Streamline routine communication and set a specific time to review them periodically (similar to the "Six Times a Day" mindfulness practice).
Don’t over-reply to email discussions. T.mandarin: 避免在郵件討論中過度回覆。將例行任務與資訊整理模組化，並設定固定時間週期性地檢視與回覆（借鑒六時書的自我覺察習慣）。
Don’t over-reply to email discussions. T.taiwanese: 電子郵件討論莫回傷濟。例行的工課佮資訊整理愛做予模組化，閣設定固定的時間，定定提出來檢查、回覆（學六時書家己覺察的習慣）。

Do not interrupt others when his speech.english: Do not interrupt others while they are speaking. Maintain elegance and professional etiquette.
Do not interrupt others when his speech.mandarin: 在他人發言結束前切勿插話。保持優雅與職場基本禮儀。
Do not interrupt others when his speech.taiwanese: 別人話猶未講煞，千萬莫插喙。愛有風度，顧好職場基本的禮數。

Set up a routine in your calendar (your.english: Schedule a regular slot in your calendar (your personal "daily standup") to review your projects and life routine. Establishing this daily ritual saves decision-making energy and builds an expert mindset.
Set up a routine in your calendar (your.mandarin: 在行事曆上設定固定行程（給自己的每日站會），審視工作專案與生活常規。透過每日儀式感節省大腦的決策能量，建立專家思維。
Set up a routine in your calendar (your.taiwanese: 在行事曆排定固定時間（給家己的每日例會），審視工作專案佮生活步調。用每日的儀式感來省決策的氣力，建立專家思維。

Learn some remote work skills, potential.english: Master remote work skills, anticipate technical issues, and improve your presentation style (e.g., sharing slides while showing your camera to build trust). Maintain mobility, present a well-groomed appearance on camera, and control your speaking speed to communicate clearly without rushing.
Learn some remote work skills, potential.mandarin: 掌握遠距工作技巧、理解潛在問題並優化簡報模式（例如：分享 PPT 時同時開啟攝像頭以增加信任度）。提升行動力，視訊會議時儀容整潔，並控制說話速度，不急不徐地表達。
Learn some remote work skills, potential.taiwanese: 遠距工作的撇步愛學予會，會出啥物問題愛知影，報告的方式嘛愛改較好（比如：分享 PPT 的時陣，攝影機嘛開起來，予人較信任）。行動力愛提升，視訊會議的時陣穿插愛清氣，講話的速度愛控制，慢慢仔講、免趕。

When stating more than 3 or more situati.english: If an explanation requires discussing three or more complex situations, call the person directly instead of sending back-and-forth emails.
When stating more than 3 or more situati.mandarin: 當需要在信件中說明三種以上的複雜情境或狀況時，直接打電話溝通，而非用郵件來回拉扯。
When stating more than 3 or more situati.taiwanese: 若是批內底愛解說三款以上複雜的情境抑是狀況，就直接敲電話講，莫用電子郵件來來去去拖沙。

\"Say Yes\", ”you are correct.” don't us.english: Start with positive alignment like "Yes, I agree" or "You are correct." Avoid leading with defensive words like "but" or "however." Instead, use constructive prompts such as "What do you think?" or "What is your opinion?" to focus on problem-solving and progress.
\"Say Yes\", ”you are correct.” don't us.mandarin: 溝通時先以正面的「是的」、「你是對的」切入。避免一開口就使用「但是」、「然而」等否定詞。改用「你覺得呢？」或「你的看法是？」來引導，讓對話聚焦於解決問題與推進工作。
\"Say Yes\", ”you are correct.” don't us.taiwanese: 溝通的時陣，先用正面的「是」、「你講了著」開頭。莫一開喙就講「毋過」、「但是」這款反對的話。改用「你感覺按怎？」抑是「你的看法是？」來牽話，予講話的重點囥佇解決問題佮予工課向前行。

Set your status to \"Do Not Disturb\" in.english: Set your status to "Do Not Disturb" on communication channels when needed (e.g., Friday afternoons or during your sacred time). Use auto-replies, mark your calendar as "Occupied," and set boundaries for night calls from different time zones.
Set your status to \"Do Not Disturb\" in.mandarin: 在需要專注的時間（例如週五下午或個人神聖時間），將社群與通訊軟體狀態設為「請勿打擾」。善用自動回信、在行事曆上將時間標記為「忙碌中」，並為跨時區的夜間會議設定防線。
Set your status to \"Do Not Disturb\" in.taiwanese: 需要專心的時間（比如拜五下晡抑是家己的神聖時間），社群佮通訊軟體的狀態設做「請勿打擾」。自動回批愛會曉用，佇行事曆共時間標做「無閒中」，閣愛為跨時區的暗時會議設一條防線。

Sometimes you need to put your ass heavy.english: Sometimes you need to "sit tight" and move slowly. Avoid behaving over-proactively in every situation. For example, ignore emails asking you to perform unreasonable tasks outside your role; if you are not the DRI, do not reply.
Sometimes you need to put your ass heavy.mandarin: 有時候你需要「沉住氣」、以退為進。不要在所有事情上都表現得過度主動。例如：忽略那些要求你做不合理任務的信件；如果這不是你的職責（DRI），就不要急著回覆。
Sometimes you need to put your ass heavy.taiwanese: 有時陣你愛「沉會牢」，退一步才是進。莫逐項代誌攏表現甲傷過頭主動。比如：叫你做無合理工課的批，就莫插伊；若毋是你的責任（DRI），就莫急欲回。

Write down meeting minutes, even no one.english: Take meeting minutes even if not requested. This ensures traceability and allows you to reuse the information next time.
Write down meeting minutes, even no one.mandarin: 即使沒人要求，也主動寫下會議記錄。這不僅能建立良好的追溯機制，日後需要時還能重覆利用。
Write down meeting minutes, even no one.taiwanese: 就算沒人叫你做，嘛愛主動寫會議記錄。按呢做會使建立追溯機制，日後需要時擱會使重覆利用。

Try to speed up or automate your work. (.english: Aim to speed up or automate your tasks by 10x. Create templates, re-organize workflows, and continuously optimize. Maintain high-quality documentation and a professional, friendly voice tone.
Try to speed up or automate your work. (.mandarin: 致力於將工作速度提升十倍或自動化。建立範本、重組工作流程並持續優化。同時，保持文件的高水準與溝通時的良好語氣。
Try to speed up or automate your work. (.taiwanese: 拍拚共工作的速度提升十倍，抑是做予自動化。範本愛起造，工作流程愛重排閣一直改較好。同時，文件愛保持懸水準，溝通的口氣嘛愛好。

Document your work. It will help you a l.english: Document your work systematically; it will pay off in the future. Use tools like OneNote or XMind to link indices. (Note that email is a poor medium for documentation.) Move critical emails to OneNote, create structured folders, and categorize them.
Document your work. It will help you a l.mandarin: 有系統地為工作做文件記錄，這在未來會大有幫助。使用 OneNote 或 XMind 等工具連結知識索引（電子郵件並非合適的存檔載體）。將重要郵件導出至 OneNote，建立資料夾並做好分類。
Document your work. It will help you a l.taiwanese: 工課愛有系統咧做文件紀錄，以後會真有路用。用 OneNote 抑是 XMind 這款工具共知識的索引連起來（電子郵件毋是適合存檔的所在）。重要的批愛匯出去 OneNote，起資料夾，分類分予好。

Try to ignore some emails with inappropr.english: Ignore emails containing inappropriate or emotional language. Learn the difference between reacting immediately and giving a measured response. Treat these situations as opportunities to build mental resilience. Sometimes, simply ignoring it is best.
Try to ignore some emails with inappropr.mandarin: 學會忽略帶有不當情緒性字眼的電子郵件。修煉「刻意回應」而非「本能反應」的克制力。把這當作鍛鍊強大內心與心理韌性的好機會。有時，單純不予理會就是最好的回擊。
Try to ignore some emails with inappropr.taiwanese: 用字無妥當、帶情緒的電子郵件，愛學會莫插伊。愛練「刻意回應」，莫憑「本能反應」，彼款忍會住的功夫。共這當做練強大心肝佮心理韌性的好機會。有時陣，根本莫睬伊，就是上好的回擊。

Only check emails which mention your nam.english: Only check emails where you are directly mentioned or asked to reply (encourage others, including managers, to state clear requests). Categorize your inbox into projects, action items, archives, and trash.
Only check emails which mention your nam.mandarin: 只把精力花在有指名你或明確要求你回覆的郵件上（引導他人，包括主管，在來信時說明明確的請求）。將信件分類為：專案項目、待辦事項、歸檔與垃圾郵件。
Only check emails which mention your nam.taiwanese: 干焦共氣力開佇有指名你、抑是明確叫你回的批（嘛愛引導別人，包括主管，寄批的時陣共要求講清楚）。批愛分類做：專案項目、待辦事項、歸檔佮垃圾批。

Try to level up your skill. See item12..english: Constantly level up your skills to make work 10x faster and deeper. Document your knowledge, apply automation, lean, and agile scrum mindsets. Focus on core values, master your craft (know, master, specialize, teach), and adopt an expert or "company of one" mindset. (This is a lifelong journey)
Try to level up your skill. See item12..mandarin: 持續提升核心技能，追求十倍速的效率與更深的專業度。建立知識文件，導入自動化、精益（Lean）與敏捷（Scrum）思維。專注核心，做到「知、熟、精、通」並樂於指引他人。把自己當作「一人公司」來經營，這是一輩子的修煉。
Try to level up your skill. See item12..taiwanese: 核心的本事愛繼續提升，追求十倍速的效率佮閣較深的專業。起造知識文件，導入自動化、精益（Lean）佮敏捷（Scrum）的思維。專心佇核心，做到「知、熟、精、通」，閣歡喜牽成別人。共家己當做「一人公司」來經營，這是一世人的修行。

Try creating some templates. This will s.english: Create reusable templates to save time, and learn from other products to stay competitive. Implement automation for "autopilot" projects. Maintain a competitive yet win-win mindset. (Remember, you cannot create templates without understanding underlying theories first.) Do not be shy. "Fortune favors the bold."
Try creating some templates. This will s.mandarin: 打造標準工作範本以節省時間，借鑑其他產品的優點來保持競爭優勢。利用自動化推動「無人值守專案」。抱持競合（Win-Win）思維。（關鍵在於：若不理解背後的邏輯與理論，是無法做出好範本的。）不要膽怯。
Try creating some templates. This will s.taiwanese: 建立工作範本來省時間，學習別人的優點來維持競爭力。利用自動化予專案自動運作。維持雙贏（Win-Win）思維。若不理解理論是做不出好範本的。毋通怕醜：「驚驚袂著頂，敢的戛去配。」

Remember that failure always happens. It.english: Remember that failure is inevitable. Aim to "fail fast" and fix issues quickly; they will eventually pass. Failure is the nutrient of success. Conduct risk assessments for black swan events. If you never make mistakes, you will never learn; avoid the trap of crippling perfectionism. Embrace mental resilience and navigate the VUCA world (VUCA 2.0: Vision, Understanding, Courage, Adaptability) using pre-mortem analysis.
Remember that failure always happens. It.mandarin: 記住，失敗終會發生。透過「快速失敗」來快速修正，問題終會過去。失敗是成功的養分。針對黑天鵝事件做好風險評估。不犯錯就學不到東西，不要被完美主義綁架。培養心理韌性，用預前驗屍（Pre-mortem）做好壓力測試，來適應 VUCA 2.0 時代（願景、溝通、勇氣與適應力）。
Remember that failure always happens. It.taiwanese: 愛會記得，失敗早慢會發生。用「緊失敗」來緊修正，問題總會過去。失敗是成功的肥底。對黑天鵝事件愛先做好風險評估。無犯錯就學無物件，莫予完美主義縛咧。愛培養心理韌性，用事前驗屍（Pre-mortem）做好壓力測試，來適應 VUCA 2.0 時代（願景、溝通、勇氣佮適應力）。

Prepare questions in advance. Leave some.english: Prepare questions in advance. Leave buffer time in your schedule before meetings or presentations. Don't forget to write down a question list and actively ask them during calls. (Related to Items 3 and 7)
Prepare questions in advance. Leave some.mandarin: 提前準備好問題。為會議或簡報之間預留緩衝時間。務必寫下問題清單，並在通話或開會時主動發問。
Prepare questions in advance. Leave some.taiwanese: 問題愛先準備好。會議佮報告中間愛留緩衝的時間。一定愛共問題清單寫落來，敲電話抑是開會的時陣，家己主動問。

Schedule your resources / energy (Gantt.english: Manage your resources and energy systematically (like a Gantt chart). Avoid double-booking tasks and balance work with leaves. Mental energy is finite. Work-life balance is a dynamic trade-off; identify future key skills, take action, manage risks, and think probabilistically ("thinking in bets").
Schedule your resources / energy (Gantt.mandarin: 像甘特圖一樣規劃你的時間與能量。不要把多項行程塞在同一個時段，合理調配休假與工作。心智能力是有限的。工作與生活的平衡是動態調配的過程；思考未來需要學習的核心技能，擬定行動並控制風險，保持「以小博大、合理下注」的思維。
Schedule your resources / energy (Gantt.taiwanese: 照甘特圖來排好你的時間佮氣力。莫共濟濟行程擠佇仝一時段，休假調配好。心智氣力有限。工課佮生活是動態平衡；思考未來愛學啥物核心功夫，擬好步驟並顧好風險，保持理性下注思維（Thinking in bets）。

Use a timer to measure the time you spen.english: Use a timer to track the time spent on each task to improve your future effort estimations.
Use a timer to measure the time you spen.mandarin: 使用計時器記錄各項任務的實際耗時，這能幫助你未來更精準地估算工作量（Effort estimation）。
Use a timer to measure the time you spen.taiwanese: 用計時器記錄逐項工課實際開偌濟時間，按呢會當幫助你以後較準估算工作量（Effort estimation）。

Always have a good relationship with you.english: Always maintain positive relations with assistants, managers, and peers, whether local, foreign, or from other departments (e.g., Supply Chain, WPE, MPE, Assembly, Process Engineering, Quality, and Reliability). Always use a soft and professional tone.
Always have a good relationship with you.mandarin: 不論是本地或外籍同事，還是行政助理、直屬主管及跨部門窗口（如 Supply Chain、WPE、MPE、Assembly、Process Eng、Quality 等），都要維持良好的人際關係。說話語氣保持溫和理性。
Always have a good relationship with you.taiwanese: 無論是在地抑是外國同事，甚至是秘書、跨部門的窗口（親像 Supply Chain、WPE、MPE、Assembly、Process Eng、Quality 等），攏愛維持良好的關係。講話的口氣愛溫和且專業。

Make sure your presentation is free of l.english: Ensure your reports, presentations, and emails are free of low-level errors. If an error slips through, acknowledge it honestly and correct it in the next session. Make sure the same mistake never happens twice.
Make sure your presentation is free of l.mandarin: 確保你的簡報、郵件或報告中沒有低級錯誤（如錯字、格式混亂）。若真的出錯，坦然承認並在下一次討論中修正，絕不讓同樣的錯誤發生第二次。
Make sure your presentation is free of l.taiwanese: 你的簡報、批抑是報告，毋通有低級的錯誤（像錯字、格式亂操操）。若真正出差錯，就坦白承認，佇後一擺討論的時陣改正，仝款的錯絕對莫予伊發生第二擺。

Do write down his/her name in the email.english: Always address recipients by name in emails and express appreciation. Do the same in meetings to build mutual respect. (Prepare templates for "10 ways to say thank you" and "10 ways to politely say no," e.g., "I have other competing priorities.")
Do write down his/her name in the email.mandarin: 寫信時指名道姓地稱呼對方並真誠致謝。開會時也維持同樣的禮貌，這會為你贏得尊重。（可準備「10種道謝方式」與「10種優雅拒絕範本」，例如：「我目前手頭有其他優先級更高的任務。」）
Do write down his/her name in the email.taiwanese: 寫批的時陣，愛指名叫對方，閣真心共人講多謝。開會嘛仝款有禮貌，按呢會替你贏著尊重。（會使準備「10 種講多謝的講法」佮「10 種有風度拒絕人的範本」，比如：「我這馬手頭有別項較優先的工課。」）

Responsibility and accountability is abo.english: Responsibility and accountability are ultimately defined by your daily professional attitude.
Responsibility and accountability is abo.mandarin: 當責與負責，本質上展現的就是你的職業態度。
Responsibility and accountability is abo.taiwanese: 當責佮負責，講到底，展現的就是你做工課的態度。

Use latest SW or HW / save more time. Up.english: Utilize the latest software and hardware to save time. Keep your equipment upgraded (e.g., laptop, dual screens, larger RAM, and reliable cloud backups). Leverage AI tools and existing templates, and stand on the shoulders of giants.
Use latest SW or HW / save more time. Up.mandarin: 善用最新的軟硬體工具來節省時間。主動升級配備（如電腦、雙螢幕、更大記憶體與雲端備份）。積極尋找 AI 工具與他人做好的優秀範本，借力使力。
Use latest SW or HW / save more time. Up.taiwanese: 愛會曉用上新的軟硬體工具來省時間。家己主動共設備升級（像電腦、雙螢幕、較大的記憶體佮雲端備份）。拍拚去揣 AI 工具佮別人做好的好範本，借力使力。

Make sure you backup your file regularly.english: Ensure you back up your files regularly. Organize your system into permanent, fleeting, and literature notes, and sync them to the cloud for instant retrieval.
Make sure you backup your file regularly.mandarin: 養成定期備份檔案的習慣。參考卡片盒筆記法（卡片筆記、靈感筆記、文獻筆記）建構知識庫，同步至雲端以便在數秒內搜尋檢索。
Make sure you backup your file regularly.taiwanese: 培養定時備份的習慣。利用筆記分類法（卡片筆記、靈感筆記、文獻筆記）建立知識庫，同步到雲端，按呢日後才好搜尋。

Redo your task with half time ( double s.english: Challenge yourself to redo routine tasks in half the time. Turn them into modular scripts or templates (Related to Item 23). Deeply understand the background and theory behind the tasks.
Redo your task with half time ( double s.mandarin: 挑戰自己用一半的時間完成相同的例行工作。將其模組化或做成範本（參考第23條）。深入理解工作背後的物理本質與理論。
Redo your task with half time ( double s.taiwanese: 挑戰家己用一半的時間做好仝款的例行工課。共伊做予模組化抑是做成範本（參考第 23 條）。工課後壁的物理本質佮理論，愛深入了解。

Try to be a leader, for any task or proj.english: Act as a leader or owner, whether organizing a meeting or running a project. Learn to manage logically and analyze situations structurally to gain management experience and build professional visibility.
Try to be a leader, for any task or proj.mandarin: 不論是開會還是做專案，主動扮演領導者與召集人的角色。學習用邏輯和結構化分析進行管理，累積管理經驗並提升自身能見度（Visibility）。
Try to be a leader, for any task or proj.taiwanese: 不管是開會抑是做專案，主動出來做頭人、做召集人。學習用邏輯佮結構化分析來管理，累積經驗並提升家己的能見度。

Dare to say NO or refuse or fight with o.english: Dare to say "no," reject unreasonable requests, or defend your position using solid data and logical arguments. Refuse in a classy, respectful manner. (Mindset of boundary testing and energy management)
Dare to say NO or refuse or fight with o.mandarin: 勇於說「不」，拒絕不合理的要求。在有數據與事實支持的情況下理直氣壯地據理力爭，且要維持得體、優雅的口吻。（大膽測試邊界與做好能量管理）
Dare to say NO or refuse or fight with o.taiwanese: 愛敢講「毋」，拒絕無合理的要求。有數據佮事實撐腰的時陣，就理直氣壯、照理來爭，毋過口氣愛得體、有風度。（大膽測試界線，能量管理嘛愛做好）

Spend time asking questions about life a.english: Spend time discussing life with colleagues; try to find new perspectives and learn from their life experiences.
Spend time asking questions about life a.mandarin: 適度與同事聊聊生活，抱持好奇心去發現與學習別人工作以外的特長與人生智慧。
Spend time asking questions about life a.taiwanese: 適當佮同事開講生活，用好奇的心去發現、去學別人工課以外的專長佮人生智慧。

Add daily review for task progress, make.english: Set a daily calendar slot to review task progress, ensuring that statuses are rolled forward to prevent procrastination.
Add daily review for task progress, make.mandarin: 在行事曆上留出固定時間進行每日進度盤點，確保任務狀態維持滾動更新，防止拖延。
Add daily review for task progress, make.taiwanese: 佇行事曆留固定的時間，逐工盤點進度，予工課的狀態一直滾動更新，莫拖沙。

Try to read foreign colleague’s name cor.english: Make an effort to pronounce foreign colleagues' names correctly and associate them with their profile photos. This builds rapport and facilitates smoother communication.
Try to read foreign colleague’s name cor.mandarin: 努力唸準外籍同事的名字，並看著照片認清對方的長相。這能留下良好第一印象，讓後續跨國溝通事半功倍。
Try to read foreign colleague’s name cor.taiwanese: 拍拚共外籍同事的名讀予準，閣看相片共對方的面認予清楚。按呢會留落好的第一印象，後壁跨國溝通就會事半功倍。

To apply your work skillset into your li.english: Apply your professional workflows to your personal life to simplify routines and reduce stress. Remember that practice makes perfect; take small steps and avoid the trap of perfectionism.
To apply your work skillset into your li.mandarin: 將工作上的專案管理與效率工具應用在個人生活上，化繁為簡.熟能生巧，起步要小，不求一次到位。
To apply your work skillset into your li.taiwanese: 將工作上的專案管理與效率工具提來用佇個人生活，化繁為簡。熟能生巧，起步要小，毋免想講一次就要做到完美。

Be patient. Take deep breath when you fe.english: Be patient. When chaos hits, take a deep breath, drink hot tea, or listen to a song from your curated playlist. Limit coffee intake to avoid jitters. Sometimes, you just need to slow down to speed up.
Be patient. Take deep breath when you fe.mandarin: 保持耐心。當感到混難焦慮時，深呼吸、喝杯熱茶，或播放自己珍藏的歌單/電影來轉換心情。控制咖啡因攝取避免焦慮加劇。有時候你需要刻意放慢腳步。
Be patient. Take deep breath when you fe.taiwanese: 愛有耐心。心神不寧、焦慮的時，深呼吸、飲一杯熱茶，抑是聽一首心愛的歌來轉換心情。控制飲咖啡的量，避免焦慮。有時陣愛放慢步伐。

Use ORID (Objective/Reflective/Interpret.english: Apply the ORID focal conversation method (Objective, Reflective, Interpretive, Decisional) to analyze issues. Put emotions aside and maintain strict professionalism in your area of expertise.
Use ORID (Objective/Reflective/Interpret.mandarin: 運用 ORID 焦點討論法（客觀事實、主觀反應、詮釋分析、做出決策）來梳理問題。排除情緒化干擾，以專業視角冷靜處理。
Use ORID (Objective/Reflective/Interpret.taiwanese: 用 ORID 焦點討論法（客觀事實、主觀反應、詮釋分析、做出決定）來共問題理清楚。莫予情緒牽咧走，用專業的眼光冷靜處理。

Take a deep breath and smile when there.english: Take a deep breath and smile when facing challenges. Keep an open mind and welcome diverse opinions. (Related to Item 46)
Take a deep breath and smile when there.mandarin: 面對挑戰時，深呼吸並微笑面對。保持開放心態，傾聽並接納不同的意見。
Take a deep breath and smile when there.taiwanese: 拄著挑戰的時陣，吸一下大氣，面笑笑去面對。心胸愛開闊，聽人講，嘛愛接受無仝款的意見。

Ask why (3*5) Simon Sinek）黃金圈法則（Golden-C.english: Ask "Why" repeatedly (using Simon Sinek's Golden Circle concept) to understand the core motivation and meaning behind tasks. (Related to Item 46)
Ask why (3*5) Simon Sinek）黃金圈法則（Golden-C.mandarin: 重複追問「為什麼」（借鑒黃金圈法則 Golden Circle），找出任務背後的核心動機與真實意圖。
Ask why (3*5) Simon Sinek）黃金圈法則（Golden-C.taiwanese: 一直問「為啥物」（參考黃金圈法則 Golden Circle），共這項任務後壁上要緊的動機佮真正的用意揣出來。

Calculate probability of failure or win..english: Calculate the probability of success versus failure. If you cannot estimate it, identify what data you lack. Do stress testing to prevent catastrophic low-tech errors. Assess intrinsic value versus book value, and think in bets. (Related to Items 34, 125, and 297)
Calculate probability of failure or win..mandarin: 計算失敗與勝出的機率。若算不出來，思考還缺乏哪些關鍵數據？進行壓力測試以防止低級技術性失誤。評估事物的「內在價值」而非僅看表面帳面價值，學會理性下注（Thinking in bets）。
Calculate probability of failure or win..taiwanese: 共失敗佮贏面的機率算看覓。若算袂出來，就想看猶欠啥物關鍵的數據？做壓力測試，免得犯著粗淺的技術性錯誤。愛看物件的「內在價值」，毋通干焦看表面的帳面價值，學會理性落注（Thinking in bets）。

React quick for some cases due to opport.english: React quickly when opportunities arise (such as replying to your boss's critical emails), but "let the bullets fly" (wait and observe) for non-urgent matters. Focus on key items, avoid over-replying or over-delivering, and choose your battles wisely.
React quick for some cases due to opport.mandarin: 對高價值機遇（如老闆的關鍵郵件）要快速響應；但對某些一般事務則要「讓子彈飛一會兒」（靜觀其變）。專注於核心，避免過度回覆與瞎忙，選擇正確的戰場。
React quick for some cases due to opport.taiwanese: 價值懸的機會（親像頭家的關鍵電子郵件）愛隨回應；毋過一般的代誌，就「予銃子飛一時仔」（先看風勢）。顧上要緊的，莫回傷濟、無閒甲無頭神，愛揀著正確的戰場。

List down 3 main tasks for your KPI per.english: Identify and focus on 3 key tasks per day that directly align with your KPIs to steadily push your project to the next milestone.
List down 3 main tasks for your KPI per.mandarin: 每天列出 3 項與 KPI 核心指標直接掛鉤的關鍵任務，專注執行以推進至下個里程碑。
List down 3 main tasks for your KPI per.taiwanese: 逐工列出 3 項佮 KPI 核心指標直接相關的關鍵工課，專心做，共進度推到下一个里程碑。

Ask your boss how KPI measured and then.english: Clarify with your manager how success is measured before setting your KPIs. Input them in Workday, update progress monthly, and be mindful of workplace implicit rules.
Ask your boss how KPI measured and then.mandarin: 與主管對齊 KPI 的衡量標準後再進行設定。填入 Workday 系統，並每月滾動更新進度，這也是職場的重要潛規則。
Ask your boss how KPI measured and then.taiwanese: 佮主管對齊 KPI 的評估標準後再設定。填入 Workday 系統，並逐月滾動更新進度，這也是職場重要的潛規則。

Do not bother your boss unless it is nec.english: Avoid bothering your manager unless necessary. Search for answers (e.g., Google or internal wikis) before asking colleagues, respecting their time and concentration.
Do not bother your boss unless it is nec.mandarin: 除非必要，否則不要輕易打擾主管。向同事發問前，先自己查資料（如 Google 或內部維基），讓大家能專注做自己的工作。
Do not bother your boss unless it is nec.taiwanese: 若毋是必要，莫隨便去攪擾主管。欲問同事進前，先家己查資料（親像 Google 抑是公司內部的維基），予逐家會當專心做家己的工課。

Distinguish the role and responsibility.english: Clearly define the roles and responsibilities (R&R) among team members. (Related to Item 36)
Distinguish the role and responsibility.mandarin: 明確劃分團隊成員間的職責分工（Role & Responsibility, R&R），避免權責不清。
Distinguish the role and responsibility.taiwanese: 明確分清楚團隊成員之間的職責（Role & Responsibility, R&R），避免責任不明。

Train the capability to Predict the dire.english: Train yourself to predict event outcomes and anticipate the worst-case scenario. Conduct pre-mortem analysis to prepare defenses. (Related to Item 297)
Train the capability to Predict the dire.mandarin: 鍛鍊自己預測事件發展趨勢的能力。時常思考：最壞的情況是什麼？運用「預前驗屍（Pre-mortem）」分析，提前做好避險規劃。
Train the capability to Predict the dire.taiwanese: 愛練家己看代誌會按怎發展的本事。不時想看覓：上害的情形是啥物？用「預前驗屍（Pre-mortem）」來分析，提早做好避險的準備。

Rehearsal at least twice before presenta.english: Rehearse at least twice before any presentation. Practice makes perfect; engage in deliberate practice.
Rehearsal at least twice before presenta.mandarin: 簡報前至少排練兩次。熟能生巧，實行刻意練習。
Rehearsal at least twice before presenta.taiwanese: 做簡報進前，上少愛先練兩擺。練久就會熟，熟就會巧，愛刻意去練習。

Ask yourself potential questions others.english: Anticipate questions the audience might ask during your presentation. Prepare a Q&A list in advance (e.g., explaining schedule delays). (Related to Items 3 and 32)
Ask yourself potential questions others.mandarin: 設想聽眾在簡報時可能會問的問題。提前準備好問答清單（例如：為何進度延遲？），做好應對準備。
Ask yourself potential questions others.taiwanese: 先想看聽眾佇簡報的時陣可能會問啥物問題。問答清單愛先準備好（比如：進度為啥物延誤？），才袂臨時跤手慌。

Write down / breakdown task and set dead.english: Write down and break down tasks, then schedule deadlines on your calendar. Draw mind maps, process flows, or Gantt charts to visualize progress.
Write down / breakdown task and set dead.mandarin: 書寫並拆解任務，在行事曆上設定截止日期。繪製心智圖、流程圖或甘特圖來將工作進度視覺化。
Write down / breakdown task and set dead.taiwanese: 將任務寫下來、拆解清楚，且在行事曆設定截止時間。畫心智圖、流程圖抑是甘特圖來將工作進度視覺化。

Energy management and find the priority..english: Manage your energy and identify key priorities. Always tackle the most important tasks first (aligned with OKRs). Remember that willpower is limited; practice the rule of subtraction to reduce clutter.
Energy management and find the priority..mandarin: 管理個人能量並找出最核心的事。永遠先做最重要的事（與 OKR 目標對齊）。意志力是有限的資源；學會做減法，排除次要雜務。
Energy management and find the priority..taiwanese: 愛管理家己的能量，揣出上核心的代誌。永遠先做上要緊的（佮 OKR 目標對齊）。意志力是有限的，愛學會做減法，共無要緊的雜事排除。

Correlation does not imply causation. De.english: Remember that correlation does not imply causation. Apply deductive and inductive reasoning carefully, and avoid the trap of fragmentary reasoning.
Correlation does not imply causation. De.mandarin: 記住「相關性不等於因果關係」。謹慎運用演繹推理與歸納推理，避免陷入碎片化、片面的推理陷阱。
Correlation does not imply causation. De.taiwanese: 愛會記得「有相關毋代表有因果」。演繹推理佮歸納推理攏愛謹慎用，莫跋落去零零碎碎、看一爿無看一爿的推理陷阱。

Learn /be familiar with company culture.english: Understand and align with company culture and business metrics, as they matter to your manager (e.g., gross margin, targets, holding costs, and CAGR). Know your manager's concerns, competitor movements, and the schedules and reporting requirements of regular business reviews (like BBSC).
Learn /be familiar with company culture.mandarin: 熟悉公司的文化與核心商業指標，因為這是主管在意的重點（如毛利、營收目標、庫存持有成本、CAGR 複合年均增長率等）。掌握老闆的核心關切點、對手動態，以及定期會議（如 BBSC）的時程與報告要點。
Learn /be familiar with company culture.taiwanese: 公司的文化佮核心的商業指標愛摸予熟，因為這是主管上在意的（親像毛利、營收目標、庫存持有成本、CAGR 複合年均增長率等等）。頭家上關心啥物、對手的動態，佮定期會議（親像 BBSC）的時程佮報告重點，攏愛掌握予好。

Try to rephrase statement and re-plot in.english: Rephrase statements and simplify data visualizations by putting yourself in the audience's shoes. Make complex information simple and easy to understand. Practice empathy rather than just sympathy.
Try to rephrase statement and re-plot in.mandarin: 換位思考，重新調整你的說法與圖表呈現方式。力求資訊簡單明瞭、易於吸收。實踐職場的同理心（Empathy），而非單純的同情心（Sympathy）。
Try to rephrase statement and re-plot in.taiwanese: 換做對方的位置想看覓，重新調整你的講法佮圖表的做法。資訊愛簡單明白、予人一看就食會落。佇職場愛有同理心（Empathy），毋是干焦同情心（Sympathy）。

Have sense of CPK / statistic / probabil.english: Maintain a strong grasp of statistics, CPK, and probability; sometimes a structured table is more precise than a chart. Use inferential statistics (confidence levels and intervals), verify database integrity (checking for selection bias or time-domain constraints), and utilize tools like ANOVA, linear regression, normality checks, sigma levels, and %GRR.
Have sense of CPK / statistic / probabil.mandarin: 培養對 CPK（製程能力指數）、統計學與機率的敏感度；有時用表格呈現數據比圖表更精確。掌握推論性統計（信心水準與信賴區間），檢查資料庫是否有選擇性偏差或特定的時間限制，並善用 ANOVA（變異數分析）、線性回歸、常態性檢驗、西格瑪值與 %GRR（量具重複性與再現性）。
Have sense of CPK / statistic / probabil.taiwanese: 對 CPK（製程能力指數）、統計學佮機率愛有感覺；有時用表格排數據，比圖表閣較準。推論統計（信心水準佮信賴區間）愛會曉，愛檢查資料庫有選擇性偏差抑是特定時間限制無，閣愛會曉用 ANOVA（變異數分析）、線性回歸、常態性檢驗、西格瑪值佮 %GRR（量具重複性佮再現性）。

File naming / folder management / file b.english: Implement strict file naming conventions, folder structures, and regular backups. Use detailed naming patterns (e.g., `Product-Stage-SVN-Category-Issue-Version_DATE`) to identify job classifications instantly and facilitate retrieval in seconds as part of knowledge management.
File naming / folder management / file b.mandarin: 落實嚴格的命名規範、資料夾管理與定期備份。採用詳細且長檔名的命名結構（例如：產品-階段-SVN-分類-問題-版本_日期），以便在數秒內精確檢索與辨識，做好知識管理。
File naming / folder management / file b.taiwanese: 落實嚴格的檔案命名規範、資料夾管理佮定期備份。採用詳細且長檔名的命名結構（親像：產品-階段-SVN-分類-問題-版本_日期），按呢在幾秒鐘之內就能精確檢索與辨識，做好知識管理。

Take a walk or take a deep breath, Stret.english: When feeling stressed, take a walk, practice deep breathing, or do stretching exercises. Incorporate heavy weight training into your routine, or take a short leave to reset. (Related to Items 46 and 48)
Take a walk or take a deep breath, Stret.mandarin: 感到壓力大時，起立走走、深呼吸或做伸展運動。規律進行重量訓練，必要時請假休息以重新調整狀態。
Take a walk or take a deep breath, Stret.taiwanese: 壓力大的時陣，徛起來行行咧、吸一下大氣，抑是伸伸跤手。愛定定做重量訓練，有必要的時陣就請假歇睏，共狀態調轉來。

Try to quantize your task and effort in.english: Quantify your tasks and effort using completion percentages, status metrics, or visual indicators (like color coding or icons). Note that even if something cannot be easily quantified, it does not mean it is unimportant. Clear tracking is essential when leading a project.
Try to quantize your task and effort in.mandarin: 用完成百分比、進度指標或視覺標記（如顏色代碼或表情符號）將任務與付出量化。請記住，無法被輕易量化的事情並不代表它不重要。在領導專案時，這種進度追蹤非常關鍵。
Try to quantize your task and effort in.taiwanese: 用完成的百分比、進度指標，抑是看會著的記號（親像顏色代碼抑是表情符號）共任務佮付出量化。毋過愛會記得，袂當簡單量化的代誌，毋代表無要緊。帶專案的時陣，這款進度追蹤足要緊。

Data can be used to prove or cheat. Stat.english: Data can be used to prove facts or to mislead. Ensure the sample size is statistically significant before using data to back your arguments. Avoid relying on intuition or feeling, which can be misleading. Always ask where the data comes from to avoid causal fallacies, and watch out for large variations (sigma) or outliers that could lead to black swan events. (Related to Item 64)
Data can be used to prove or cheat. Stat.mandarin: 數據可以用來證明事實，也能用來蒙蔽真相。用數據支持論點前，確保樣本數足夠。直覺與感覺往往會誤導你。務必釐清數據的來源以避免因果謬誤；注意過大的變異（Sigma）或被忽略的極端值，防範黑天鵝風險。
Data can be used to prove or cheat. Stat.taiwanese: 數據會使提來證明事實，嘛會使提來騙人。用數據支持論點前，確保樣本數夠大。直覺與感覺往往會誤導你。務必釐清數據的來源，避免因果謬誤；注意過大的變異（Sigma）或被忽略的極端值，防範烏天鵝風險。

Don’t ask basic questions if you are not.english: Do not ask basic questions without preparation. However, keep in mind that sometimes asking basic questions is a strategic way to verify if everyone shares the same level of knowledge, recognition, and alignment.
Don’t ask basic questions if you are not.mandarin: 不要在毫無準備的情況下問基本問題。但也要明白，有時開會提出基本問題，是為了確認團隊是否在相同的資訊基礎、認知與共識水平上。
Don’t ask basic questions if you are not.taiwanese: 莫無準備就問基本的問題。毋過嘛愛知影，有時開會問基本問題，是欲確認團隊對資訊、認知佮共識是毋是佇仝一个基礎頂懸。

Keep principles and follow. Item 14..english: Establish clear working principles and adhere to them consistently. (Related to Item 14)
Keep principles and follow. Item 14..mandarin: 建立明確的工作原則並嚴格遵循。
Keep principles and follow. Item 14..taiwanese: 建立清楚的工作原則並嚴格遵循。

Use simple words to explain to others si.english: Explain concepts in simple terms, especially to busy executives who do not have time to digest complex details. (Related to Item 63)
Use simple words to explain to others si.mandarin: 用最簡單直白的話解釋事情，因為高階主管往往沒有時間去琢磨複雜的技術細節。
Use simple words to explain to others si.taiwanese: 解說代誌愛用上簡單、上直接的話，因為大主管定定無閒去鑽研複雜的技術細節。

don’t show hand till it is necessary. Do.english: Do not show your hand until it is necessary. Avoid pointing out others' faults unless they genuinely seek feedback to improve. Always save some diplomatic leverage ("save some bullets").
don’t show hand till it is necessary. Do.mandarin: 底牌不到關鍵時刻不要亮出來。除非他人真心求教以求改進，否則不要主動糾正別人的錯誤。在職場上要保留一些談判與外交籌碼。
don’t show hand till it is necessary. Do.taiwanese: 底牌無到關鍵時刻莫掀出來。除非別人真心來請教、想欲改進，若無莫主動去糾正人的錯誤。佇職場愛留一寡談判佮外交的籌碼。

If well prepared, then relax, don't make.english: If you are well-prepared, relax. Do not let anxiety overwhelm you; feeling a bit nervous is a positive sign that you care and are ready.
If well prepared, then relax, don't make.mandarin: 既然已經做足準備，就放寬心。不要給自己過度心理壓力；感到些許緊張是正常的生理反應，代表你重視這場戰役。
If well prepared, then relax, don't make.taiwanese: 既然準備攏做夠額矣，就共心放予開。莫予家己傷大的心理壓力；有淡薄仔緊張是正常的身體反應，代表你看重這場戰。

Do respect what you achieved and your ha.english: Respect your own achievements and hard work. Ignore harsh or dismissive comments from others. You know your own value and what you have accomplished; keep a detailed record of your achievements throughout the year to present when needed.
Do respect what you achieved and your ha.mandarin: 尊重並肯定自己的辛勞與成就。對於旁人隨意、刻薄的批評，不必放在心上。只有你最清楚自己付出了多少、做成了什麼；妥善記錄整年的工作成果，這才是你最有力的證明。
Do respect what you achieved and your ha.taiwanese: 愛尊重、肯定家己的辛苦佮成就。別人隨便講、尖酸刻薄的批評，免囥佇心肝頭。家己出偌濟力、做成啥物，只有家己上清楚；共規年的工課成果好好記錄落來，這才是你上有力的證明。

We all want to make life easier, however.english: We all want an easier life, but reality is full of challenges. Acceptance of occasional failure is essential; it is normal and often not your fault, especially when you are doing your best within a limited timeframe.
We all want to make life easier, however.mandarin: 我們都希望生活順遂，但現實總是充滿挑戰。接受偶爾的失敗，這很正常，且往往並非你的過錯，特別是在有限時間內你已經盡力了。
We all want to make life easier, however.taiwanese: 咱攏希望日子過了順序，毋過現實不時充滿挑戰。偶爾失敗愛接受，這真正常，而且定定毋是你的錯，尤其是佇有限的時間內你已經盡力矣。

Be honest to yourself and management tea.english: Be honest with yourself and the management team. Demonstrate integrity when making a mistake and adhere to the company's code of conduct, while remaining politically smart (never be clueless).
Be honest to yourself and management tea.mandarin: 對自己和管理層保持誠實。犯錯時展現誠信與擔當，遵循公司的行為準則；但同時要保持職場敏感度，切忌白目。
Be honest to yourself and management tea.taiwanese: 對家己佮管理層攏愛老實。犯錯的時陣愛有誠信、有擔當，照公司的行為準則行；毋過嘛愛有職場的敏感度，千萬莫白目。

And tell yourself you (or your colleague.english: Remind yourself and your team that you have done excellent work over the months. Do not let offhand comments affect your self-worth; put your ego aside and focus on facts.
And tell yourself you (or your colleague.mandarin: 告訴自己和團隊：過去幾個月來大家做得棒極了！不要因為某人的一句話就自我懷疑、看輕自己。放下無謂的自尊（Ego），用客觀事實看問題。
And tell yourself you (or your colleague.taiwanese: 告訴家己和同事：過去幾个月來大家做得棒極了！毋通因為某人的一句話就自我懷疑、看輕家己。放下無謂的自尊（Ego），用客觀事實看問題。

Your priorities are not your boss priori.english: Remember that your priorities may not align with your manager's or your colleagues' priorities. Focus on aligning them.
Your priorities are not your boss priori.mandarin: 始終記住：你眼中的首要任務，在主管或同事眼裡可能並非第一優先。要主動與他們對齊優先順序。
Your priorities are not your boss priori.taiwanese: 愛不時會記得：你看做第一要緊的代誌，佇主管抑是同事的眼中可能毋是上優先的。愛主動佮個對齊優先順序。

And most important things is clean your.english: Ensure your own work is flawless and your responsibilities are fully met before you attempt to criticize or correct others. (Related to Items 88 and 234)
And most important things is clean your.mandarin: 在想管別人的閒事或糾正他人之前，先確保自己手頭的工作沒有紕漏、責任已完全盡到。
And most important things is clean your.taiwanese: 想欲管別人的閒仔事抑是糾正別人進前，先確定家己手頭的工課無漏洞、責任攏有盡到。

And do not expect they say thank you or.english: Do not expect others to thank you or return favors. Treat your work and contributions as professional duties or steps toward your own career goals.
And do not expect they say thank you or.mandarin: 不要指望別人會對你心懷感激或給予回報。把你所做的一切當作專業職責，或是實現個人目標的累積。
And do not expect they say thank you or.taiwanese: 莫向望別人會感恩你抑是有啥物報答。你所做的一切，就當做專業的本分，抑是為著家己的目標一點一滴咧累積。

try to commit to your mistake and say so.english: Acknowledge your mistakes and apologize when necessary. Even when you think a task is complete, minor oversights can happen. Utilize peer reviews, feedback, and checklists to ensure quality. Establish regular self-reflections, keep updating your checklists, and focus on continuous iterative improvement (kaizen).
try to commit to your mistake and say so.mandarin: 勇於承認錯誤並適時道歉。即使自認完工，偶爾也可能發生疏忽。藉助同儕審查（Peer review）、他人反饋與檢查清單來查漏補缺。定期自我審視，更新檢查表，以任務為導向、持續反思優化（Kaizen），追求漸進式的成長。
try to commit to your mistake and say so.taiwanese: 敢做敢當，做毋著愛甘願認閣會曉會失禮。就算掠準做好了，三不五時嘛可能落勾。借同仁互相審查（Peer review）、別人意見佮檢查清單來掠漏補縫。定定自省兼翻新檢查表，以工課為重、持續反思改善（改善精神 Kaizen），步步踏實來求進步。

Do not input many information in one tim.english: Avoid dumping too much information—especially bad news—on your manager at once; balance it with positive updates. Use the "delayed delivery" feature in Outlook to send finished emails at a more strategic time rather than sending them immediately.
Do not input many information in one tim.mandarin: 不要向主管回報過多繁雜的資訊，特別是壞消息；報告時應夾帶好消息。利用 Outlook 的「延遲發送」功能，在更適當的時間發送已寫好的郵件，避免在非工作時間或敏感時刻打擾主管。
Do not input many information in one tim.taiwanese: 毋通一次向主管回報過多繁雜的資訊，特別是壞消息；報告時應夾帶好消息。利用 Outlook 的「延遲發送」功能，在更適當的時間發送已寫好的郵件，避免在非工作時間或敏感時刻打擾主管。

Try to take a leave for 2-3 days even lo.english: Regularly take 2-3 days of leave (aligned with family schedules like Mother's Day, birthdays, or holidays) to recharge. Use this time to reflect on your achievements and learning. Even booking a 2-hour window on your calendar for a mental break and quiet reflection can help build resilience. Keep a steady pace ("let the bullets fly") and remember that setbacks are part of life. (Related to Item 46)
Try to take a leave for 2-3 days even lo.mandarin: 定期安排 2-3 天的假（配合家人的行程，如母親節、生日、清明或年假）來充電。利用這段時間沉澱、回顧工作成果並學習新事物。即使在行事曆上單純保留 2 小時放空或靜下心來回顧都大有幫助。沉住氣、拉長思考維度，把挫折視為常態，培養心理韌性。
Try to take a leave for 2-3 days even lo.taiwanese: 定期安排 2-3 天的假（配合家人的行程）來充電。利用這段時間沉澱、回顧工作成果並學習新事物。即使在行事曆上單純保留 2 小時放空或靜下心來回顧都大有幫助。沉住氣、拉長思考維度，把挫折視為常態，培養心理韌性。

Challenges and failure always happen and.english: Challenges and failures are normal. Reflecting on past achievements will help you realize that current difficulties are manageable. Focus on solutions and progress rather than emotion; concentrating on problem-solving naturally reduces emotional anxiety. Future you will thank you for not giving up. (Related to Item 75)
Challenges and failure always happen and.mandarin: 挑戰與失敗是家常便飯。回頭看看自己過去克服的困難與成就，你會發現眼前的難關其實不算什麼。將精力集中於尋找解決方案與推進進度，當你聚焦於解決問題時，焦慮情緒自然會消退。未來的你會感謝現在堅持下去的自己。
Challenges and failure always happen and.taiwanese: 挑戰佮失敗是四常的代誌。斡頭看家己過去拍贏的困難佮成就，你會發現目前這關其實無算啥。共氣力囥佇揣解決的辦法、共進度推前，你專心咧解決問題的時陣，煩惱自然就會消退。未來的你會感謝這馬硬挺落去的家己。

Do not make low tech mistake. Item 50. W.english: Avoid low-tech, careless mistakes that may be irreversible. Perform pre-mortem analysis: ask what the consequences are if we fail, and evaluate the real-world impact to prevent regret. (Related to Item 50)
Do not make low tech mistake. Item 50. W.mandarin: 嚴防那些無法挽回的低級技術性錯誤。開展預前驗屍（Pre-mortem）：思考如果這件事搞砸了會怎樣？不去做會帶來什麼實質處罰或後悔？提前築好防線。
Do not make low tech mistake. Item 50. W.taiwanese: 嚴防遐的無法度挽回的粗心大意錯誤。做預前驗屍（Pre-mortem）：想看覓若是這項代誌用摵去會按怎？若無做會帶來啥物實質處罰抑是後悔？提前共防線築好。

Your report is your product / brand. ( c.english: Treat your reports and presentations as your personal product and brand. Always check the logic, wording, numbers, paragraph structure, charts (ensuring they aren't blurry), spelling, and links. Be highly mindful of what you say and write in both public and private forums.
Your report is your product / brand. ( c.mandarin: 你的報告與簡報就是你的個人產品與招牌。送出前務必反覆檢查：邏輯是否通順、文字表達、數據對齊、段落順序、圖表解析度（是否模糊）以及超連結是否失效。無論在公開場合還是私下溝通，都要對自己的言論高度負責。
Your report is your product / brand. ( c.taiwanese: 你的報告佮簡報就是你個人的產品佮招牌。寄出去進前一定愛反覆檢查：邏輯順無、文字表達、數據有對齊無、段落的順序、圖表的解析度（有霧霧無）佮超連結有失效無。毋管是公開抑是私底下的溝通，家己講出去的話攏愛負責。

Try to apologize for your mistake and th.english: Acknowledge your mistakes and apologize sincerely without excuses. Accept that human errors happen, and focus on corrective actions. (Related to Item 81)
Try to apologize for your mistake and th.mandarin: 犯錯時誠實道歉，不找藉口。人非聖賢孰能無過，關鍵在於誠實面對並立即採取補救措施。
Try to apologize for your mistake and th.taiwanese: 犯錯就老實會失禮，莫揣藉口。人毋是聖賢，啥人無過失，上要緊的是老實面對，隨去補救。

Do not correct your colleague's fault or.english: Avoid correcting your colleagues' mistakes unless they ask for your help, or it directly impacts your deliverables. Treat their slip-ups as learning opportunities and document them privately to ensure you never make the same mistakes. (Related to Item 234)
Do not correct your colleague's fault or.mandarin: 除非同事主動要求幫忙，或該錯誤已實質影響到你的工作，否則不要好為人師去糾正別人。將這些案例當作前車之鑑記錄下來，確保自己不會犯同樣的錯。
Do not correct your colleague's fault or.taiwanese: 除非同事家己開喙請你鬥相共，抑是彼个錯誤已經實際影響著你的工課，若無莫愛做人的先生去糾正人。共這寡例記落來做前車之鑑，確定家己袂犯仝款的錯。

Try to set up firewall to protect yourse.english: Build defensive "firewalls" to protect yourself from others' mistakes. Document everything carefully (e.g., archiving emails, saving meeting minutes, and obtaining CCB approvals).
Try to set up firewall to protect yourse.mandarin: 建立防衛性「防火牆」，避免同事犯錯時波及到你。落實工作留痕與文件化（例如：保存郵件備份、詳細的會議記錄、CCB 變更審查審核記錄）。
Try to set up firewall to protect yourse.taiwanese: 起一座防衛性的「防火牆」，避免邊仔人做毋著連累著家己。落實做代誌留底稿佮留紀錄（像保存郵件備份、詳細會議紀錄、CCB 變更審查審核記錄），留步顧後壁。

Make yourself irreplaceable. Build up a.english: Make yourself irreplaceable by building deep, specialized skills and documenting your achievements on your resume and LinkedIn. Focus on learning future-proof skills independently to stay aligned with the latest industry trends. (Related to Item 129)
Make yourself irreplaceable. Build up a.mandarin: 透過建立深厚的專業技能與實戰經驗，讓自己無可替代。定期更新簡歷與 LinkedIn，確保自己的技能組合符合市場未來趨勢。保持主動自學，與業界最新技術和動態對齊。
Make yourself irreplaceable. Build up a.taiwanese: 用深厚的專業技術佮實戰經驗，予家己無人通替代。履歷佮 LinkedIn 愛定期更新，確定家己的本事有綴會著市場未來的趨勢。愛主動家己學，佮業界上新的技術佮動態對齊。

Go to the detail per stage in one projec.english: Dive into the details of each project phase. Do not hesitate to ask questions in public without fear of embarrassment; this is the most effective way to step out of your comfort zone and grow competency and mindset. (Related to Item 100)
Go to the detail per stage in one projec.mandarin: 深入了解專案每個階段的細節。不要怕丟臉，在公開會議中勇於提問；這是跳出舒適圈、磨練專業能力與強健心態的必經之路。
Go to the detail per stage in one projec.taiwanese: 專案逐个階段的眉角攏愛摸予清楚。莫驚見笑，佇公開的會議嘛愛敢問；這是跳出舒適圈、磨專業本事佮練心肝穩的必經之路。

Focus and Don't get distracted on non-p.english: Maintain focus and avoid getting distracted by low-priority tasks. Constantly ask yourself: "Why am I doing this?" (Related to Item 14)
Focus and Don't get distracted on non-p.mandarin: 保持專注，不被非核心的雜務分心。時常拷問自己：「我做這件事的目的是什麼？它能帶來核心價值嗎？」
Focus and Don't get distracted on non-p.taiwanese: 保持專注，莫予非核心的雜務抐去。時常自問：「我做這項代誌的目的到底是為著啥物？敢會帶來核心價值？」

Explain your data by a physical eye. And.english: Interpret your data through the lens of physical laws and scientific thinking rather than relying on mathematical calculations alone. (Related to Item 40)
Explain your data by a physical eye. And.mandarin: 從物理本質出發來原理解釋數據，並運用科學思維進行邏輯推導，而非盲目信奉純數學計算。
Explain your data by a physical eye. And.taiwanese: 對物理的本質出發來解說數據，用科學的頭腦一步一步推理，毋通戇戇仔干焦信純數學的計算。

When seeing the issues, list down potent.english: When issues arise, list potential problems, categorize them, identify links, filter out noise, and prioritize. Always ask: "What is my top priority today?"
When seeing the issues, list down potent.mandarin: 面對問題時，先列出所有潛在疑點，進行分類、過濾與關聯分析，最後排定優先順序。每天早上問自己：「今天最重要的優先任務是什麼？」
When seeing the issues, list down potent.taiwanese: 拄著問題的時陣，先共所有可疑的所在攏列出來，分類、過濾、看個彼此的關係，上尾才排先後。逐工早起問家己：「今仔日上要緊的代誌是啥物？」

Leverage previous notes for works or oth.english: Leverage your historical notes and others' documentation. Dedicate regular blocks of time to summarize your work for future reference. (Related to Item 38)
Leverage previous notes for works or oth.mandarin: 善用自己過去累積的筆記與他人的經驗文件。因此，必須定期抽空總結自己的工作心得，轉化為日後可隨時調用的知識庫。
Leverage previous notes for works or oth.taiwanese: 善用家己過去累積的筆記與他人的經驗文件。因此，必須定期抽空總結家己的工作心得，轉化為日後可隨時調用的知識庫。

To estimate the time and effort per task.english: Strive to estimate the time and effort required for each task accurately. Developing this skill takes time and experience; avoid running on autopilot like a machine, and try to enjoy the process. (Related to Item 32)
To estimate the time and effort per task.mandarin: 努力精確評估每項任務所需的時間與精力。這項能力的養成需要時間與經驗累積；不要像機器人一樣盲目重置運作，學會在工作中尋找掌控感與樂趣。
To estimate the time and effort per task.taiwanese: 認真共逐項工課需要偌濟時間佮氣力算予準。這款本事愛靠時間佮經驗慢慢儉；莫像機器人仝款戇戇仔重開機一直做，愛會曉佇工作內底揣出掌握感佮趣味。

Not give too many comments or suggestion.english: Avoid overwhelming colleagues with too many comments or suggestions at once. Do not volunteer advice spontaneously unless asked. (Related to Items 82 and 88)
Not give too many comments or suggestion.mandarin: 不要一次給同事提太多意見或建議。除非對方主動詢問，否則不要隨意提供未經請求的建議。
Not give too many comments or suggestion.taiwanese: 莫一擺共同事提傷濟意見抑是建議。人無主動問，就莫烏白去予人建議。

You may not be that important than you t.english: Remember that you may not be as indispensable as you think. The world keeps spinning without you; put your ego aside and stay humble.
You may not be that important than you t.mandarin: 你可能沒有自己想像的那麼無可替代。地球少了誰都一樣轉動；放下不必要的自尊心與包袱，踏實前行。
You may not be that important than you t.taiwanese: 你凡勢無你想的遐爾無人通替。地球少了啥人嘛是照輪；無必要的面子佮包袱放落來，跤踏實地向前行。

Try to learn from past experience, from.english: Learn from past experiences and emulate high-performing colleagues. Read books to leverage others' life lessons. Rely on science, mathematics, statistics, and objective facts rather than opinions. Keep a curated list of reference books for future problem-solving. (Related to Item 93)
Try to learn from past experience, from.mandarin: 從過去的經驗與他人身上學習，這些教訓都是有代價的。閱讀書籍以借鑑前人的智慧。信賴科學、數學與統計學數據，讓事實說話。平時整理幾本工具書作為參考書單，以備不時之需。
Try to learn from past experience, from.taiwanese: 對過去的經驗佮他人身上學習，遮的教訓攏是有代價的。閱讀書籍來借鏡別人的智慧。信賴科學、數學與統計學數據，予事實講話。平時整理幾本工具書當作參考書單，準備無常之需。

Find out when or what you want to procra.english: Identify your procrastination triggers and tackle the hardest task first ("eat the frog"). Do not hide in your comfort zone; step into your learning zone. Focus on acquiring new skills and generating tangible outputs to build a portfolio of achievements.
Find out when or what you want to procra.mandarin: 找出自己會在何時、對何事拖延。先解決最棘手、最不想做的事（吃青蛙）。不要躲在舒適圈，勇於躍入學習圈。確保自己學到實質新事物並產生具體產出，逐步累積成就。
Find out when or what you want to procra.taiwanese: 找出家己會咧何時、對何事拖延。先解決最棘手、最無想做的事（食青蛙）。毋通匿佇舒適圈，勇於跳入學習圈。確保家己學到實質新代誌並產生具體產出，逐步累積成就。

Try to write down procedure ( detail) as.english: Develop the habit of documenting detailed procedures and workflows. This will allow you to reuse and continuously refine your way of working (WoW) in the future. (Related to Items 38 and 95)
Try to write down procedure ( detail) as.mandarin: 養成將工作細部流程與步驟記錄下來的習慣。日後再次遇到時可直接調用並持續優化工作方法（WoW）。
Try to write down procedure ( detail) as.taiwanese: 養成共工作的細部流程佮步數記落來的習慣。後擺閣拄著，就會當直接提出來用，閣繼續共工作方法（WoW）改予較好。

“I will do my best.” Are you happy / sat.english: Use constructive and positive phrasing, such as: "I will do my best," "Are you satisfied with this outcome?" "Do you have any comments or concerns?" and "Thank you for joining the review and for your valuable contribution." Embrace feedback and believe we can always improve.
“I will do my best.” Are you happy / sat.mandarin: 使用積極正面的職場對話術，例如：「我會全力以赴」、「您對這個結果滿意嗎？」、「是否有任何建議或疑慮？」以及「感謝參與審查會議，謝謝您的貢獻與反饋」。擁抱所有反饋，相信事情總能做得更好。
“I will do my best.” Are you happy / sat.taiwanese: 用積極正向的職場話術，親像：「我會盡全力」、「你對這个結果滿意無？」、「有啥物建議抑是煩惱無？」佮「多謝你來參加審查會議，感謝你的貢獻佮回饋」。所有的回饋攏歡喜收，相信代誌一定閣有法度做較好。

What boost you to finish this? And why?.english: Analyze what motivates or blocks you in finishing a task (e.g., recognition, achievement, pressure, financial reward, passion, survival, or simple reality). Understanding your underlying motivation is key. (Related to Item 46)
What boost you to finish this? And why?.mandarin: 分析推動你完成任務或阻礙你前行的動力是什麼？（是成就感、生存壓力、經濟因素、熱情還是現實的職責？）。看清核心動機，有助於調整自身能量與狀態。
What boost you to finish this? And why?.taiwanese: 分析推動你完成工課抑是阻擋你向前行的動力到底是啥物？（是成就感、生存壓力、經濟因素、熱情抑是現實的責任？）。看清楚心底核心動機，按呢才調得順家己的氣力佮狀態。

Don't say anything above your level/posi.english: Avoid making statements that exceed your organizational authority or level. Speak and dress decently in public. Practice public speaking to build confidence and overcome the fear of embarrassment.
Don't say anything above your level/posi.mandarin: 說話分寸要符合自己的職級與授權範圍，切忌越權表態。在公開場合言談得體、穿著得體。平時多練習公開表達，直到能從容應對、不怕丟臉。
Don't say anything above your level/posi.taiwanese: 講話的分寸愛合家己的職級佮授權範圍，千萬莫超過權限烏白表態。佇公開場合講話愛得體、穿插嘛愛得體。平常時多練習佇人面前講話，練到會當從容應對、毋驚見笑。

Some people may use his/her power/ autho.english: Be aware that people may use their power or authority to mislead others, intentionally or unintentionally, especially when facing intense pressure regarding customer requirements, quality issues, or market deadlines.
Some people may use his/her power/ autho.mandarin: 保持警惕，有些人會刻意或無意間利用權威來誤導他人，特別是當面臨無法滿足客戶需求、品質危機或市場時效壓力時。
Some people may use his/her power/ autho.taiwanese: 愛會曉提防，有的人會刻意抑是無意中用權威來騙人、誤導別人，尤其是拄著客戶的需求做袂到、品質出問題，抑是市場時間咧趕的時陣。

Don’t criticize. Check if you have this.english: Avoid criticizing others. Instead, reflect on whether you have made similar mistakes or oversights. Focus on learning how to complete tasks faster and easier. Write down your insights immediately to prevent forgetting them, and review them regularly.
Don’t criticize. Check if you have this.mandarin: 不要急著批評別人。先反思自己是否也犯過類似錯誤或有疏漏。將心力放在如何優化工作，使其更快速、更容易。隨手記錄心得，並定期複習。
Don’t criticize. Check if you have this.taiwanese: 莫急欲批評別人。先反省家己敢捌犯過仝款的錯抑是有漏洞。共心力囥佇按怎共工作改予較緊、較簡單。有心得就隨手記落來，定期提出來溫習。

Leave someone’s question if they may was.english: Politely disengage from questions that waste your time or fail to respect your expertise and feedback, even if you know the answers. Protect your passion and manage your energy wisely. (Related to Item 114)
Leave someone’s question if they may was.mandarin: 如果某些提問只是在浪費時間，且絲毫不尊重你的專業與反饋，即使你知道答案，也請選擇忽視或不回應。別讓他們消磨你的工作熱情，這是能量管理的關鍵。
Leave someone’s question if they may was.taiwanese: 若是有的問題干焦咧了時間，閣一點仔嘛無尊重你的專業佮回饋，就算你知影答案，嘛會使免插伊、莫應伊。莫予個共你做工課的熱情磨了了，這是管理精神氣力的關鍵。

Remember to protect yourself ( interest).english: Protect your personal interests and learn to keep your mouth shut. Avoid playing the teacher or giving unsolicited advice unless explicitly asked. (Related to Item 88)
Remember to protect yourself ( interest).mandarin: 學會保護自身利益並適時保持沉默。別人在沒主動請教的情況下，不要好為人師去指點別人。
Remember to protect yourself ( interest).taiwanese: 學會保護自身利益並適時保持安靜。人無主動請教的時陣，毋通做別人的老師指點別人。

Open-minded to accept other’s comments /.english: Maintain an open mind and be receptive to others' comments and suggestions. (Related to Item 48)
Open-minded to accept other’s comments /.mandarin: 保持開放胸懷，樂於接納他人的建議與意見。
Open-minded to accept other’s comments /.taiwanese: 心胸開闊，歡喜接受別人的建議佮意見。

Dare to disagree with solid evidence and.english: Dare to voice disagreement, backed by solid evidence and logic. Keep disagreements focused strictly on the task, never the person. Prepare structured ways to express dissenting opinions. (Related to Item 41)
Dare to disagree with solid evidence and.mandarin: 在有扎實證據與充分理由的支持下，勇敢表達不同意見。辯論應「對事不對人」。學習用優雅得體的方式闡述你的反對立場。
Dare to disagree with solid evidence and.taiwanese: 佇有扎實證據佮充足理由的支持下，勇敢表達無仝的意見。辯論愛「對事不對人」。學習用體面的方式說明你的反對立場。

Do not stay in original / location for l.english: Avoid remaining stagnant for too long without taking action (although waiting is sometimes necessary). Push yourself and your projects to the next stage. Act quickly, fail fast, correct immediately, and learn new skills to drive change.
Do not stay in original / location for l.mandarin: 不要長期停留在原地毫無作為（雖然等待有時是必要的）。主動推動自己與專案邁向下個階段。快速行動、快速失敗並立即修正，學習新技能以尋求突破。
Do not stay in original / location for l.taiwanese: 莫長期待佇原地啥物攏無做（雖然有時陣等待是必要的）。主動共家己佮專案推向下一个階段。緊行動、緊失敗、隨改正，學新的本事來揣突破。

Collect template / Report/ tarshiro, one.english: Collect professional report templates and problem-solving tools (e.g., one-page reports, fishbone diagrams, 8D reports, FMEA, 5 Whys, low-yield mind maps, and CQC analysis). Master data analytics tools (e.g., Office, PowerBI, R-script, Python, JMP) and apply these structured methodologies to your personal life as well.
Collect template / Report/ tarshiro, one.mandarin: 廣泛收集實用的報告範本與分析工具（如一頁式報告、魚骨圖、8D 報告、FMEA 失效模式分析、5 Whys、低良率分析心智圖等）。熟練數據與腳本工具（如 Office、PowerBI、R-script、Python、JMP），並將這些結構化思維應用到個人生活中。
Collect template / Report/ tarshiro, one.taiwanese: 四界收集好用的報告範本佮分析工具（像一頁式報告、魚骨圖、8D 報告、FMEA 失效模式分析、5 Whys、低良率分析心智圖等等）。數據佮腳本工具（像 Office、PowerBI、R-script、Python、JMP）愛用甲熟手，閣共這款有結構的思考方式用佇家己的生活。

Try to rehearsal every presentation you.english: Rehearse every presentation you deliver. Reorganize your talking points to ensure they are simple, clear, and easy for the audience to follow. (Related to Item 71)
Try to rehearsal every presentation you.mandarin: 每一次上台簡報前都要進行排練。重新調整你的發言架構與說法，確保表達清晰、通俗易懂。
Try to rehearsal every presentation you.taiwanese: 逐擺欲上台報告進前，攏愛先練習。重新調整你講話的架構佮講法，予人聽會清楚、聽有懂。

Self-distancing, Digital Minimalism to f.english: Practice self-distancing and digital minimalism to maintain focus on your core priorities. Distance yourself from negative people (those with fixed mindsets), toxic news, and distractions. (Related to Item 14)
Self-distancing, Digital Minimalism to f.mandarin: 實踐「自我抽離（Self-distancing）」與「數位極簡主義」，以便專注於首要任務。遠離消極的人（特別是固定思維者）、負面新聞與無謂雜務。
Self-distancing, Digital Minimalism to f.taiwanese: 實踐「自我抽離（Self-distancing）」佮「數位極簡主義」，才有法度專心做上要緊的工課。離消極的人（尤其是固定思維的人）、負面新聞佮無意義的冗雜代誌較遠咧。

Wear headphones to isolation the noisy e.english: Wear headphones to block out noise in a busy office environment. This prevents distractions and serves as a visual cue that you are focused and do not wish to be disturbed.
Wear headphones to isolation the noisy e.mandarin: 在吵雜的辦公環境中戴上耳機。這能隔絕噪音，同時向旁人釋放「我正專注工作，請勿打擾」的視覺訊號。
Wear headphones to isolation the noisy e.taiwanese: 佇吵雜的辦公環境戴上耳機。這能隔絕噪音，嘛同隔壁的人報講「我咧專注做代誌，毋通相打擾」。

Don’t tend to throw wet blankets everywh.english: Avoid discouraging others or "throwing wet blankets" on their ideas. If you must offer critical feedback, do it with humor, decency, and gentleness.
Don’t tend to throw wet blankets everywh.mandarin: 不要隨意給別人潑冷水。若必須指出問題，嘗試用幽默、得體且溫和的方式表達。
Don’t tend to throw wet blankets everywh.taiwanese: 莫烏白共人淋冷水。若一定愛點出問題，試看覓用趣味、得體閣溫和的方式來講。

Take a deep breath and count 1 to 10. It.english: When feeling overwhelmed, take a deep breath and count slowly from 1 to 10. Focus on your breathing and observe the airflow to ground yourself. (Related to Item 46)
Take a deep breath and count 1 to 10. It.mandarin: 焦慮時，深呼吸並默默數到10。將注意力集中在呼吸上，感受氣體的流動，讓自己冷靜下來。
Take a deep breath and count 1 to 10. It.taiwanese: 煩惱心急的時陣，深深仔吸一口氣，恬恬仔算到10。共心神囥佇喘氣，感覺空氣的流動，予家己冷靜落來。

Put a “Soft reminder” in the email when.english: Use gentle phrases like "Soft reminder" or "Friendly reminder" when following up on pending email comments or feedback.
Put a “Soft reminder” in the email when.mandarin: 在催請同事回覆意見或郵件時，使用「溫馨提醒（Soft reminder）」等溫和字眼。
Put a “Soft reminder” in the email when.taiwanese: 催同事回覆意見抑是電子郵件的時陣，用「溫馨提醒（Soft reminder）」這款較溫和的字眼。

What is your biggest day for you company.english: Map out the critical milestones of your corporate calendar to optimize your career and financial rewards. Key dates include: KPI reviews (Feb/Jun), AIP annual bonuses (Apr/Oct), ESPP enrollment (Feb/Aug), RSU vesting schedules (Oct), salary reviews (Apr), and dividend dates. Proactively request workday feedback when tasks finish. Complete your self-assessment in Workday by October 10—well ahead of November alignments—to give your manager strong ammunition before December promotion lists are finalized. Focus on high-value, highlightable projects, and understand benefits like leave policy and sick leave pay.
What is your biggest day for you company.mandarin: 牢記公司各項權益與績效考核的關鍵日程，這是財務與職涯管理的重點：包括 KPI 審查（2、6月）、AIP 年度獎金發放（4月）、ESPP 員工認股（2、8月底）、RSU 股票解禁與新發放（10月）、調薪通知（4月）等。平時任務完成即在 Workday 主動要求回饋。最遲在 10/10 前完成 Workday 自我評估並整理成果送交主管，搶在 11 月團隊排名（Ranking）與 12 月晉升討論前做好準備。專注於能被量化亮點的實質專案，並釐清年假與病假等福利。
What is your biggest day for you company.taiwanese: 愛記好公司各項權益佮績效考核的關鍵日期：包含 KPI 審核（2、6月）、AIP 年度獎金（4月）、ESPP 員工認股（2、8月底）、RSU 股票解禁（10月）、調薪通知（4月）等。任務完成即在 Workday 主動要求回饋。最晚佇 10/10 前做完 Workday 自我評定並送給主管，搶在 11 月團隊 Ranking 與 12 月晉升討論前做好準備。專注在可以量化成果的專案，搞清楚年假佮病假等福利。

Avoid your colleagues' work shift to you.english: When raising issues or putting questions on the table, be careful that colleagues do not shift their workload or responsibilities onto you. Protect your boundaries.
Avoid your colleagues' work shift to you.mandarin: 在會議中主動提出問題時，要提防同事趁機將相關工作或責任推回給你（接刀）。守好防線，保護自己。
Avoid your colleagues' work shift to you.taiwanese: 佇會議主動提出問題的時陣，愛防同事趁機會共相關的工課抑是責任推轉來予你（接刀）。家己的防線顧予好，保護家己。

Begin with the end in mind. Working back.english: Begin with the end in mind. Practice reverse thinking and backward engineering to plan your steps.
Begin with the end in mind. Working back.mandarin: 以終為始。學會利用逆向工程（Reverse engineering）從最終目標倒推執行步驟。
Begin with the end in mind. Working back.taiwanese: 以終為始。學會用逆向工程（Reverse engineering），對上尾的目標倒轉來推出做法的步數。

Put your ass heavy, you don’t need to re.english: Practice "sitting tight" (putting your ass heavy); you do not need to reply to every email or message instantly, even if people walk up to your desk. Give yourself a buffer (margin of safety) to see if the situation resolves itself. Ask yourself: "What will happen if I do nothing?" (Related to Item 21)
Put your ass heavy, you don’t need to re.mandarin: 沉得住氣（放重底），你不需要秒回每封郵件或訊息，即使對方直接走到你桌前也一樣。留出觀察緩衝期（安全邊際），看看事情是否會隨時間產生變化。問自己：「如果我什麼都不做，會有什麼實質影響？」
Put your ass heavy, you don’t need to re.taiwanese: 沉牢氣（放重底），你毋免秒回每封郵件抑訊息，就算對方直接行到你桌仔前嘛仝款。留出緩衝期（安全邊際），看覓代誌敢會隨時間起變化。問家己：「若準我啥物代誌攏無做，敢會有啥物實質影響？」

Ask for promotion with solid achievement.english: Bravely ask for promotion, backed by solid achievements. Practice "working out loud" to make your contributions visible, maintain clear documentation, and proactively collect positive feedback from colleagues.
Ask for promotion with solid achievement.mandarin: 拿實力說話，大膽爭取晉升。學會「高調工作（Work out loud）」讓主管看見貢獻，做好成果記錄，並主動收集同事的正面反饋作為佐證。
Ask for promotion with solid achievement.taiwanese: 提實力出來講話，大膽去爭取升官。學會「高調做工課（Work out loud）」，予主管看著你的貢獻，成果紀錄做予好，閣主動收集同事正面的回饋做證據。

Ask yourself what’s your expertise and l.english: Regularly ask yourself: "What is my core expertise, and what is my long-term career plan?" Define clear goals and timelines. Build the resolve to accomplish monumental tasks (e.g., running 100 marathons, writing a 100,000-word novel, or completing a 100-task list).
Ask yourself what’s your expertise and l.mandarin: 定期自我審視：「我的核心專長是什麼？我的長期規劃是什麼？」設定清晰目標與時間線。培養完成一件宏大目標的決心與毅力（例如：挑戰100場馬拉松、寫一本10萬字的小說，或執行你的100項任務清單）。
Ask yourself what’s your expertise and l.taiwanese: 定期家己檢討：「我上專門的本事是啥物？我長期的規劃是啥物？」目標佮時間線愛設予清楚。培養完成一件大目標的決心佮耐性（親像：挑戰100場馬拉松、寫一本10萬字的小說，抑是做完你的100項任務清單）。

Image when project / life running is not.english: Anticipate when projects or life might not go smoothly. Acknowledge that black swans and outlier events will eventually occur. Enter "sandbox mode" to simulate different scenarios, conduct stress tests, and prepare your response to difficult situations (e.g., reacting to rude remarks).
Image when project / life running is not.mandarin: 提前預想專案或生活不順遂時的應對。認清黑天鵝與極端異常值終會出現。切換到「沙盒模式（Sandbox mode）」進行情境模擬與壓力測試，思考應對策略（例如：面對無禮言論時該如何冷靜且專業地回應）。
Image when project / life running is not.taiwanese: 提早預想專案抑是生活不順時的應對。認清烏天鵝佮極端異常情況定會出現。切換到「沙盒模式（Sandbox mode）」做情境模擬佮壓力測試，思考應對策略（例如：面對無禮的話該按怎冷靜專業地回答）。

Try to learn how your colleague work the.english: Observe how successful colleagues manage their projects; identify structural methodologies you can replicate and adapt. This learning is free, but you must take the initiative to ask. Identify the best mentors around you. (Related to Item 42)
Try to learn how your colleague work the.mandarin: 觀察優秀同事是如何推進專案的，找出他們身上可複製的結構化方法論。這種學習是免費的，但你需要主動開口請教。隨時思索：我身邊有誰是值得學習的對象？
Try to learn how your colleague work the.taiwanese: 看優秀的同事是按怎推專案的，揣出個身上會當學起來的結構化方法。這款學習免錢，毋過你愛家己開喙去請教。隨時想看覓：我身軀邊有啥人是值得學的？

Difficulties will pass away , just be p.english: Setbacks will eventually pass; practice patience and wait. Sometimes, we need time to allow results to unfold before making the next decision. Remember, you cannot jump from step A to C without going through B. (Related to Items 46, 75, 84, and 131)
Difficulties will pass away , just be p.mandarin: 難關終究會過去，保持耐心。很多時候我們需要時間讓結果明朗，才能做出下一步的明智決策。你無法不經歷 B，就直接從 A 跳到 C。
Difficulties will pass away , just be p.taiwanese: 難關總是會過去，吞忍耐心等待。真濟時陣咱著需要時間等局勢明朗，按呢才做得出下一步的明智決定。你無法度無經過 B，就直接對 A 跳到 C。

Before starting meeting, ask people how.english: Before starting a meeting, engage in warm-up conversations (e.g., asking about holidays, family, kids, or the weather). Effective icebreaking builds rapport and facilitates smoother collaboration; prepare a few casual topics or global news in advance.
Before starting meeting, ask people how.mandarin: 在會議正式開始前，主動聊家常（例如詢問週末過得如何、家庭、小孩或天氣）。良好的破冰有助於建立融洽氣氛，讓溝通更順暢。平時可以準備一些全球新聞或輕鬆話題作為素材。
Before starting meeting, ask people how.taiwanese: 在會議正式開始前，主動開講聊日常（親像問週末按怎、家庭、囡仔抑是天氣）。好的破冰有助於氣氛和諧，讓溝通更順暢。平時會使準備一寡話題作為素材。

Build up a capability with mobility and.english: Focus on building competencies that offer high mobility (portable skills) and strong professional relationships. (Related to Item 90)
Build up a capability with mobility and.mandarin: 著力於培養具備高流動性的個人能力（帶得走的專業技能）與穩固的人際關係網絡。
Build up a capability with mobility and.taiwanese: 用心培養會當紮咧走的個人本事（帶會走的專業技能）佮穩固的人際關係網。

To develop mental stability, mental resi.english: Strive to develop mental stability, emotional balance, resilience, and an antifragile mindset.
To develop mental stability, mental resi.mandarin: 致力於修煉內心的穩定、情緒的平衡、心理韌性與反脆弱（Antifragile）心態。
To develop mental stability, mental resi.taiwanese: 認真修練內心的穩定、情緒的平衡、心理的韌性佮反脆弱（Antifragile）的心態。

Difficulties shall pass. Encourage yours.english: Hardships will pass. Encourage yourself constantly. Remember that humans naturally tend to worry about worst-case scenarios that rarely happen. (Related to Items 127 and 151)
Difficulties shall pass. Encourage yours.mandarin: 困難總會過去。不斷給自己積極心理暗示。人類大腦容易過度預想那些幾乎不會發生的最壞狀況（杞人憂天），別被想像的恐懼嚇倒。
Difficulties shall pass. Encourage yours.taiwanese: 困難總是會過去。愛定定共家己鼓勵、予家己正向的暗示。人的頭殼真愛想傷濟，去煩惱彼寡幾乎袂發生的上歹情形（杞人憂天），莫予想出來的驚惶共你嚇驚。

Write down key items which to be checked.english: Before leaving for a holiday, write down a clear checklist of items to follow up on when you return (and make sure you don't forget your laptop password!). Maintain a secure list of passwords and key tasks to minimize post-holiday complexity.
Write down key items which to be checked.mandarin: 休長假前，寫下收假後要立即追蹤的待辦清單（也別忘了電腦密碼！）。妥善管理你的一張流帳戶與密碼清單，將收假後的複雜度與混亂降到最低。
Write down key items which to be checked.taiwanese: 休長假前，寫下收假後要立即處理的清單（嘛毋通忘記電腦密碼！）。管理好帳戶密碼，將收假後的混亂減到最低。

Do you clearly know what’s big priority.english: Are you clear about your top priorities for this week, this month, this year, and the next 5 to 10 years? Reflect on your life timeline (how many weeks do you have left?), your retirement plan, and your bucket list. (Related to Item 124)
Do you clearly know what’s big priority.mandarin: 你是否清楚知道自己這週、下個月、今年、未來5年甚至10年的核心目標是什麼？（人生只有短暫的幾千個星期）。認真規劃你的退休藍圖與人生清單（Bucket list）。
Do you clearly know what’s big priority.taiwanese: 你敢清楚知影家己這禮拜、下個月、今年、未來5年甚至10年的核心目標是啥物？（人生干焦短短仔幾千个禮拜）。認真規劃你的退休藍圖佮人生清單（Bucket list）。

Try to understand which term for each fi.english: Make an effort to understand specialized terminology in different domains and take notes. Maintain curiosity about industry trends, global news, and market shifts.
Try to understand which term for each fi.mandarin: 努力理解跨領域的專業術語並做筆記。對新知識保持好奇心，隨時關注全球新聞、行業動態與市場趨勢。
Try to understand which term for each fi.taiwanese: 認真去理解跨領域的專業術語，閣做筆記。對新的知識保持好奇心，隨時注意全世界的新聞、行業的動態佮市場的趨勢。

You cannot copy other’s life, but you ca.english: You cannot replicate someone else's life, but you can adopt their high-performance habits (e.g., exercise, waking up early, communication styles, and structured thinking). Invest in certifications and skillsets like AI/ML, Six Sigma Black Belt, or PMP.
You cannot copy other’s life, but you ca.mandarin: 你無法完全複製別人的成功人生，但可以借鑑他們的優秀習慣（如運動、早起、言談舉止、思維模型）。積極考取高價值證照，如 AI/機器學習、六標準差黑帶（Black belt）或 PMP 專案管理師。
You cannot copy other’s life, but you ca.taiwanese: 別人成功的人生你無法度完全複製，毋過會當學個的好習慣（像運動、早起、講話佮行儀、思考的模型）。積極去考有價值的證照，像 AI／機器學習、六標準差黑帶（Black belt）抑是 PMP 專案管理師。

What’s the worse situation / scenario /.english: Define the absolute worst-case scenario and your bottom line. Conduct a mental stress test: Is the negative impact temporary or permanent? If failure occurs, what is the actual financial or career loss? (Related to Items 50 and 125)
What’s the worse situation / scenario /.mandarin: 定義最壞的狀況與你的底線。給自己做一場心智壓力測試：這個衝擊是暫時的還是永久的？如果真的搞砸了，實質的損失與影響是什麼？
What’s the worse situation / scenario /.taiwanese: 先掠最歹的局面佮你的底線。共家己做壓力測試：這个衝擊是暫時抑是永久的？若準真正用摵去，實質的損失佮影響到底是啥物？

Imagine what is the future skill / knowl.english: Anticipate what hard and soft skills will be required in the future market. Practice patience, keep observing market trends, and adapt ahead of time.
Imagine what is the future skill / knowl.mandarin: 洞察未來市場最需要的硬實力與軟實力是什麼。保持耐心，緊跟市場潮流並提早布局學習。
Imagine what is the future skill / knowl.taiwanese: 看予清未來的市場上需要啥物硬實力佮軟實力。愛有耐性，綴牢市場的潮流，提早布局去學。

Try to co-work with people who you don’t.english: Learn to collaborate effectively with people you dislike. Speak to them in a soft, steady, and professional tone. Practice empathy (putting yourself in their shoes) rather than sympathy. Focus strictly on processes, workflows (WoW), and outcomes to sharpen your collaboration skills. (Related to Items 2 and 153)
Try to co-work with people who you don’t.mandarin: 學習與你不喜歡的人共事。說話保持溫和、冷靜且理性的聲音。修煉同理心（Empathy），站在對方的立場思考，而非流於同情心（Sympathy）。將注意力完全放在工作流程（WoW）與產出結果上，磨練協作能力。
Try to co-work with people who you don’t.taiwanese: 學習佮你不討喜的人鬥做代誌。講話保持溫和、冷靜專業的態度。修煉同理心（Empathy），企佇對方的角度來想，而非只是同情心。將注意力放在工作流程（WoW）與產出上，磨練協作能力。

To promote yourself (capability-hard/so.english: Promote your capabilities (both hard and soft skills) proactively. "Work out loud" and demonstrate your contributions using metrics like KPIs, OKRs, and the OGSM (Objectives, Goals, Strategies, Measures) strategic framework.
To promote yourself (capability-hard/so.mandarin: 主動推廣自己的軟硬實力。高調展現你的工作成果，用 KPI、OKR 與 OGSM（目的、目標、策略、衡量指標）等策略管理架獲來量化證明你的價值。
To promote yourself (capability-hard/so.taiwanese: 主動推銷家己的軟硬實力。高調展現工作成果，用 KPI、OKR 佮 OGSM 等管理架構來數據證明你的價值。

Leader statement: ( for meeting) I repea.english: Use structured "Leader Statements" during meetings: "Let me repeat what we agreed upon," "Allow me to confirm my understanding of your points," and "I appreciate the team's dedication and support." Clearly define next steps: "When is the next discussion, and what is the agenda?" "What is our ultimate goal, and can we meet the deadline?" "Why are we doing this?" Use frameworks like PAR (Purpose, Action, Result) and ORID. Know your limits: "My current skillset or role is not suited for this specific discussion." Challenge yourself: run a marathon, deliver a new speech, or write a book. Broaden your horizons.
Leader statement: ( for meeting) I repea.mandarin: 開會時善用「領導者聲明」：例如「我重新確認一下會議達成的共識」、「請容我確認一下我對您發言的理解是否正確」、以及「非常感謝團隊的協助與付出」。明確下一步行動：「下次討論是什麼時候？議程為何？」、「我們的終極目標是什麼？能否如期完成？」、「我們做這件事的目的是什麼？」。採用 PAR（目的-行動-結果）與 ORID 架構。合理示弱：「我目前的技能組合或崗位職責不適合主導此項討論。」自我挑戰：挑戰一場馬拉松、一場新演講或寫一本新書，拓寬你的視野。
Leader statement: ( for meeting) I repea.taiwanese: 開會時陣善用「主管發言」：親像「我重新確定一下會中逐家的共識」、「容我確認一下我聽到的意思敢有著」、閣有「真多謝團隊逐家的鬥相共佮付出」。落實下一步行動：「後回開會是啥物時陣？題目是啥？」、「咱的終極目標到底是啥物？敢有法度照起工準時完成？」、「咱做這項代誌到底為著啥物？」。善用 PAR 佮 ORID 架構。適當講明家己的限制：「我目前的功夫抑職責無合適主導這个討論。」挑戰以前無做過的事：走一場馬拉松、辦一場新演講抑寫一本新書，開闊你的視野。

watch out economic environment and indus.english: Monitor the economic environment and industry trends. Your active income (salary) is the foundation of your retirement plan. Ask for a promotion if your achievements are solid and recognized; if not, re-evaluate. Ensure your annual salary increment outpaces inflation (typically 3%) to protect your purchasing power. Finally, rebalance your asset allocation regularly and stay focused without worrying excessively about short-term market noise.
watch out economic environment and indus.mandarin: 密切關注經濟環境與產業趨勢。你的薪資收入是退休規劃的最重要基石。若成果豐碩且獲得主管認可，就主動爭取晉升；若時機未成熟則先沉澱。確保年度調薪幅度高於通貨膨脹率（如 3%），防範購買力縮水。定期進行資產配置再平衡，按部就班，不必為市場短期波動過度焦慮。
watch out economic environment and indus.taiwanese: 密切注意經濟環境與產業趨勢。你的薪資收入是退休規劃的最要緊基石。若成果好且獲得主管認可，就主動爭取晉升；若時機未成熟就先沉澱。確保年度調薪幅度高於通貨膨脹率，防範購買力縮水。定期進行資產配置再平衡，按部就班，毋免為市場波動過度焦慮。

Understand welfare policy, any compensat.english: Fully understand company benefits and welfare policies: food allowances, leave allowances (14–22 days depending on rank), childcare benefits, LTIP, AIP bonuses, RSU vesting, ESPP, health screenings, and business travel policies. Know how to apply and qualify for these. This knowledge is key for financial management and serves as a benchmark when evaluating new job offers.
Understand welfare policy, any compensat.mandarin: 徹底搞懂公司的各項福利與補償政策：伙食津貼、年假（依職級約 14-22 天）、育兒津貼、長期激勵計畫（LTIP）、年度激勵金（AIP）、RSU 股票、ESPP 員工認股、健檢與差旅補助等。掌握申請管道與資格，這不僅是財務管理的一環，也是日後跳槽或離職談判的重要基準。了解在家工作（WFH）的彈性額度（如每年最多20天）。
Understand welfare policy, any compensat.taiwanese: 規氣將公司的各項福利佮補償規定摸透透：飯包津貼、年假（照職級約 14-22 天）、育兒補助、長期激勵（LTIP）、年度獎金（AIP）、RSU 股票、員工買股票（ESPP）、健檢佮出差貼補。摸清申請門路佮資格，這毋但顧荷包，嘛是以後跳槽抑離職講條件的重要本錢。知曉佇厝做工課（WFH）的彈性額度（親像每年最多 20 天）。

Try to train yourself to look into someo.english: Train yourself to make eye contact when speaking to others, or focus on a specific point on their face to communicate confidence. (Related to Item 207)
Try to train yourself to look into someo.mandarin: 訓練自己說話時看著對方的眼睛，或注視對方臉部特定位置（如兩眼中間）以傳遞自信。
Try to train yourself to look into someo.taiwanese: 練習講話的時陣看對方的目睭，抑是看對方面頂某一个所在（親像兩蕊目睭的中央），予人感覺你有自信。

when you feel frustrated and disappointe.english: When frustrated or disappointed, be patient and take a deep breath. Remind yourself that you did a good job; avoid burnout. Focus strictly on what you can control and let the rest go. Life is not fair, but you must keep moving forward and growing—for yourself, not for the company or colleagues. Life is a struggle to support family and pursue ideals, but stay positive and take it one day at a time. The future you will thank you for trying.
when you feel frustrated and disappointe.mandarin: 感到沮喪和失望時，保持耐心，深呼吸。告訴自己你已經做得很好了，別讓自己燃燒殆盡。專注於你能控制的事，放手那些你無法控制的事。生活確實不公平，但你仍須前行，為了自己（而非公司或同事）持續成長。生活固然辛苦，需要養家糊口並兼顧理想，但請保持積極心態。很多事情在時機成熟前是沒有答案的；努力活出更好的自己，多年後你會深深感謝現在的自己。
when you feel frustrated and disappointe.taiwanese: 心情若失志落魄的時陣，吞忍一口氣，大大吐出來。共家己講你已經做甲足好矣，莫予家己燒甲虛累累。專心顧好你管得到的代誌，放手遐的你管袂到的代誌。世間本成就無公平，但你猶著向前行，為著家己（毋是為公司抑同事）精進成長。日子固然辛酸，討賺養家顧囡仔閣愛顧理想，毋過心態愛正向。真濟代誌在時機成熟進前是無答案的；拼出一个閣較讚的家己，濟年後你會真感謝這馬的家己。

What do you want to achieve?.english: Clearly define your core objectives: What is it that you truly want to achieve?
What do you want to achieve?.mandarin: 明確界定你的核心目標：你真正想要達成的是什麼？
What do you want to achieve?.taiwanese: 共你上核心的目標講予明：你真正想欲達成的是啥物？

Do you spend time on it/them? What is th.english: Are you dedicating enough time to your core goals? Focus on outcomes and measure your achievements periodically. (Related to Item 306)
Do you spend time on it/them? What is th.mandarin: 你是否把時間花在你的核心目標上？堅持結果導向，定期檢視產出與成就。
Do you spend time on it/them? What is th.taiwanese: 你的時間敢有開佇你的核心目標頂面？愛看結果，定定檢查家己做出啥物、成就了啥物。

What are you doing right now? is it alig.english: Ask yourself daily: "What am I doing right now, and is it aligned with my long-term goals?"
What are you doing right now? is it alig.mandarin: 每天自我詰問：「我現在正在做的事，是否與我想要達成的終極目標一致？」
What are you doing right now? is it alig.taiwanese: 逐工反省問家己：「我這馬當咧做的代誌，敢有佮我上想欲達成的終極目標行佇仝一條路頂？」

“I’m glad you brought it up. Is there an.english: Use open, welcoming phrases in meetings, such as: "I am glad you brought that up. Is there anything else we need to cover?"
“I’m glad you brought it up. Is there an.mandarin: 開會時使用引導性話術：「很高興你提出這個問題。還有其他我們需要討論的細節嗎？」
“I’m glad you brought it up. Is there an.taiwanese: 開會的時陣用引導的講法：「真歡喜你提出這个問題。猶閣有啥物細節咱愛討論的無？」

If you find your sleep less than 6 hours.english: If you sleep less than 6 hours, be cautious: sleep deprivation severely impairs judgment, making you prone to verbal slips or mistakes. Prioritize sleep as part of energy management.
If you find your sleep less than 6 hours.mandarin: 如果睡眠時間少於 6 小時，務必提高警覺：睡眠不足會嚴重損害判斷力，極易在工作中出錯或說錯話。將睡眠視為能量管理的最優先級。
If you find your sleep less than 6 hours.taiwanese: 若睏無夠 6 點鐘，就愛特別細膩：睏無飽會害判斷力真嚴重，做代誌真簡單出差錯、講毋著話。睏眠愛當做管理精神氣力上優先的代誌。

Using bcc, send “ FYI” email, just in ca.english: Use BCC (Blind Carbon Copy) strategically when sending "FYI" emails to keep stakeholders informed without exposing them to unnecessary "Reply All" threads or odd questions.
Using bcc, send “ FYI” email, just in ca.mandarin: 寄送「FYI 僅供參考」郵件時，巧妙使用密件副本（BCC），既能讓利害關係人知情，又不會讓他們被捲入往後無謂的「回覆所有人」信件轟炸中。
Using bcc, send “ FYI” email, just in ca.taiwanese: 寄「FYI 予你參考」的批，愛巧巧仔用密件副本（BCC），利害關係人知影，閣袂予個捲入後壁彼寡無路用的「回覆所有人」批信轟炸。

Do the right thing vs do the things boss.english: Learn to balance "doing the right thing" (objective value) versus "doing what your manager perceives as right" (alignment).
Do the right thing vs do the things boss.mandarin: 學會權衡「做正確的事（客觀價值）」與「做老闆認為正確的事（觀念對齊）」。
Do the right thing vs do the things boss.taiwanese: 愛學會秤看覓「做著的代誌（客觀的價值）」佮「做頭家感覺著的代誌（想法對齊）」。

Too busy to think how to do better and f.english: Beware of the busyness trap—being too busy executing to think about how to optimize or find a better solution.
Too busy to think how to do better and f.mandarin: 警惕「忙碌陷阱」：不要因為忙於應付眼前工作，而抽不出時間思考如何優化流程或尋找更好的解決方案。
Too busy to think how to do better and f.taiwanese: 愛防「無閒的陷阱」：莫為著應付目前的工課，煞無時間想看覓流程按怎改較好，抑是揣較好的解決辦法。

After grabbing low hanging fruit, what i.english: Once you have harvested the "low-hanging fruit" (easy wins), plan ahead for the next high-value, complex challenges.
After grabbing low hanging fruit, what i.mandarin: 在收割完「低垂的果實」（簡單且易見效的事務）之後，提早規劃下一步高價值的攻堅任務。
After grabbing low hanging fruit, what i.taiwanese: 「低垂的果子」（簡單閣緊看著效果的代誌）收成了後，就愛提早拍算下一步較有價值、較歹拍的硬戰。

Face the uncertainty and ambiguity. ( VU.english: Build the mental capacity to face uncertainty and ambiguity in a complex, fast-changing environment (VUCA).
Face the uncertainty and ambiguity. ( VU.mandarin: 培養面對不確定性與模糊空間的心智能力，以適應快速變遷的複雜職場環境。
Face the uncertainty and ambiguity. ( VU.taiwanese: 愛共面對無確定、霧霧的狀況的頭腦能力練起來，才會當適應變甲足緊、足複雜的職場。

Be careful of tunnel vision effect, bein.english: Beware of tunnel vision—becoming so hyper-focused on a single goal that you fail to notice broader side effects or risks.
Be careful of tunnel vision effect, bein.mandarin: 警惕「隧道視野（Tunnel vision）」效應：不要因為過度專注於單一目標，而忽略了外圍的副作用或系統性風險。
Be careful of tunnel vision effect, bein.taiwanese: 愛防「隧道視野（Tunnel vision）」：莫為著傷專心佇一个目標，煞無看著外口的副作用抑是規个系統的風險。

Quick learn / collect the latest informa.english: Develop a method for quick learning and capturing industry trends using structured digital note-taking.
Quick learn / collect the latest informa.mandarin: 建立一套利用數位筆記快速學習與收集未來市場最新資訊的工作方法。
Quick learn / collect the latest informa.taiwanese: 建立一套用數位筆記隨手速學、收集未來市場最新情報的手路。

How does you contribute for this project.english: How are you contributing to this project? Always look for ways to quantify your contribution and demonstrate your value clearly to stakeholders.
How does you contribute for this project.mandarin: 自問：你對這個專案的實質貢獻是什麼？隨時思索如何用量化的數據向團隊及主管證明你的價值。
How does you contribute for this project.taiwanese: 問家己：你對這个專案實際的貢獻是啥物？時時想看覓，欲按怎用數字證明你的價值予團隊佮主管看。

You can't always be in the best conditio.english: Acknowledge that you cannot always be in peak condition, and life is finite. Knowing this, do not let hesitation or shyness hold you back from pursuing your goals.
You can't always be in the best conditio.mandarin: 接受自己不可能永遠處於完美狀態，且生命是有限的。既然如此，就大膽去追求你的理想，別因為害臊或猶豫而裹足不前。
You can't always be in the best conditio.taiwanese: 接受家己毋是永遠攏會當完美，人的性命嘛有限。既然按呢，就大膽去追你的理想，莫因為歹勢抑是躊躇就徛咧毋敢行。

Last but not least, read those principle.english: Last but not least, review these working principles routinely. Reflect on your achievements, and determine what needs to be added, modified, or enhanced.
Last but not least, read those principle.mandarin: 最後但同樣重要的一點：定期溫習這些工作原則。結合當下的成就與痛點，思考有哪些條款需要增補、修正或強化。
Last but not least, read those principle.taiwanese: 上尾，猶毋過仝款要緊：這寡工作原則愛定定提出來溫習。綴這馬的成就佮痛處，想看覓有佗幾條愛加添、修改，抑是加強。
