Call for help if it is needed. Ask for c.english: Do not hesitate to call for help when needed. Seek consultation and suggestions, and surround yourself with trusted mentors and alignment peers (your "tribe").
Call for help if it is needed. Ask for c.mandarin: 需要支援時絕不逞強，勇於開口。向專家諮詢，並在職場中找到能互相扶持的導師與志同道合的夥伴（你的「族人」）。
Call for help if it is needed. Ask for c.taiwanese: 需要人鬥相共的時陣，絕對莫硬撐，愛勇敢開喙。去請教專家，佇職場揣會當互相扶持的導師佮志同道合的伙伴（你的「族人」）。

Avoid to be an asshole. Be nice to peopl.english: Avoid behaving unprofessionally; be polite and cooperative with everyone you meet. Be friendly, but establish clear professional boundaries.
Avoid to be an asshole. Be nice to peopl.mandarin: 別做令人反感的同事。對遇到的每個人都保持友善與微笑，但必須劃定清楚的專業邊界。
Avoid to be an asshole. Be nice to peopl.taiwanese: 莫做予人厭𤺪的同事。拄著啥人攏愛友善、面笑笑，毋過專業的界線一定愛劃予清楚。

Practice how to ask a good questions. Ma.english: Practice how to ask high-quality questions. Rehearse your delivery, control your speaking speed, and back your context with what you have achieved.
Practice how to ask a good questions. Ma.mandarin: 練習如何提出好問題。提前列出大綱、控制說話速度，並在提問時適當帶入已有成果的上下文。
Practice how to ask a good questions. Ma.taiwanese: 愛練習按怎問好問題。大綱先列出來、講話的速度愛控制，問的時陣嘛愛適當共已經有的成果佮前後文紮入去。

To bring yourself to another higher leve.english: To elevate your career to the next level, build a broad safety net (expanding your circle of competence). Avoid trying to prepare everything at once, which will only burn out your energy.
To bring yourself to another higher leve.mandarin: 為了將自己提昇到更高的層次，必須拓展能力圈（如同購買保險增加防護網）。避免試圖一次準備所有事情，這只會燒光你的精力。
To bring yourself to another higher leve.taiwanese: 欲共家己提升到較懸的層次，就愛共能力圈拓予闊（親像買保險加一層防護網）。莫想欲一擺共所有代誌攏準備好，按呢只會共你的氣力燒了了。

Check when big boss visit your departmen.english: Track when senior executives visit your department. Prepare a thoughtful question list or have review-ready documents on hand.
Check when big boss visit your departmen.mandarin: 掌握高階主管巡視部門的時程。提前準備好提問清單，或備妥隨時可供審閱的亮點成果報告。
Check when big boss visit your departmen.taiwanese: 摸清大頭主管巡視部門的走馬時程。提早款好欲請教的問題清單，抑是備好隨時會使予人過目展現成果的報告。

Leverage The outcomes from others and sh.english: Leverage existing outcomes from other projects/teams, adapt them, and share the insights with your own team, departments, and stakeholders.
Leverage The outcomes from others and sh.mandarin: 學會借鑑並站在別人的成果上，加以優化後分享給自己的團隊、跨部門窗口或利害關係人，促進共贏。
Leverage The outcomes from others and sh.taiwanese: 愛學會參考、徛佇別人的成果頂懸，共改較好了後分享予家己的團隊、跨部門的窗口抑是利害關係人，逐家攏有賺。

Set a deadline or expected time to chec.english: Set clear deadlines and follow-up checkpoints for task outcomes. Evaluate the required effort versus the value generated, and track milestones on your calendar.
Set a deadline or expected time to chec.mandarin: 為每項任務設定明確的截止日期與結果檢視時點。評估投入的精力與產出價值是否合乎比例，並在行事曆上做記錄。
Set a deadline or expected time to chec.taiwanese: 每項工課攏愛訂出清清楚楚的截止期限佮驗收時限。算看覓開落去的氣力佮收成的價值敢有合算，並佇行事曆頂面記好勢。

Does your boss really need your personal.english: Evaluate if your manager truly wants your personal opinion or deep technical expertise. Determine if the project requires a team decision based on scientific, statistical data, or if it is ultimately guided by manager intuition.
Does your boss really need your personal.mandarin: 判斷主管此時究竟需要你的個人主觀意見，還是深度技術專業？釐清該專案是需要基於事實與科學數據的團隊決策，還是實際上僅憑主管的直覺決定？
Does your boss really need your personal.taiwanese: 愛判斷主管這陣到底是需要你個人主觀的意見，抑是深度的技術專業？閣愛摸清楚這个專案是需要根據事實佮科學數據的團隊決策，抑是實際上干焦憑主管的直覺咧決定？

What is possible strategies and tactics.english: Use structured thinking to define the strategies (what to do) and tactics (how to do it) needed to achieve your goals. Break down the execution details.
What is possible strategies and tactics.mandarin: 運用結構化思維擬定達成任務的策略與戰術。將細節逐層拆解落地。
What is possible strategies and tactics.taiwanese: 用結構化的思維擬定完成任務的策略佮戰術。細節愛一層一層拆予開、落地實行。

Many people only asking or questioning w.english: Many people only ask questions or complain without taking action. Ask yourself: "Am I just a thinker, or am I a doer?"
Many people only asking or questioning w.mandarin: 許多人只會提出質疑或嘴上抱怨，卻沒有半點行動。問自己：你究竟是一個空想者，還是起而行之的行動者？
Many people only asking or questioning w.taiwanese: 真濟人干焦會懷疑、喙念念，煞無半點仔行動。問家己：你到底是一个干焦咧空想的人，抑是講做就做的行動者？

Learn how to learn..english: Master the meta-skill of learning how to learn, allowing you to acquire new knowledge rapidly.
Learn how to learn..mandarin: 掌握「學習如何學習」的元學習能力，這是讓你快速切入任何新領域的核心基石。
Learn how to learn..taiwanese: 愛學會「學習按怎學習」的元學習本事，這是予你緊緊切入任何新領域的核心基礎。

be careful the time you spent on which t.english: Be highly disciplined about how you allocate your time. Keep a prioritized list and ensure you tackle high-priority items first.
be careful the time you spent on which t.mandarin: 對時間的分配保持高度自律。列出優先級清單，確保第一時間處理最高優先順序的要務。
be careful the time you spent on which t.taiwanese: 時間的分配愛足自律。列出優先清單，確定上優先的要緊代誌頭一時間就處理。

Question list for the one you admire or.english: Prepare questions for mentors or leaders you admire: "What failures have you experienced, and how did you conquer communication issues?" "What career and financial plans brought you to your current level?" and "What feedback do you have for me?" Use the SBI (Situation-Behavior-Impact) model to structure feedback.
Question list for the one you admire or.mandarin: 為你欣賞或值得學習的導師準備提問清單：「您過去經歷過什麼失敗，又是如何克服跨國溝通障礙的？」、「您是如何規劃職涯與財務以達到今天的成就？」以及「對我目前的觀察有什麼反饋？」使用 SBI（情境-行為-影響）模型來具體化建議。
Question list for the one you admire or.taiwanese: 替你欣賞抑是值得學習的導師準備問題清單：「你過去捌拄著啥物失敗，閣是按怎拍破跨國溝通的阻礙？」、「你是按怎規劃職涯佮財務，才有今仔日的成就？」閣有「對我這馬的表現有啥物回饋？」用 SBI（情境-行為-影響）模型共建議講予具體。

Each task has DRI, schedule, bottleneck,.english: Ensure every task has a designated DRI, clear timeline, identified bottlenecks, and a list of required approvals or support resources.
Each task has DRI, schedule, bottleneck,.mandarin: 確保每項任務都明確列出：負責人（DRI）、時間表、潛在瓶頸、需要哪些審批授權，以及需要什麼資源支持。
Each task has DRI, schedule, bottleneck,.taiwanese: 逐項任務攏愛清楚列出：負責人（DRI）、時間表、可能的瓶頸、愛啥物審批授權，佮需要啥物資源支持。

To have a long-term problem-solving atti.english: Adopt a long-term problem-solving attitude and a growth mindset. Remain patient, slow down when needed, and cultivate resilience and antifragility.
To have a long-term problem-solving atti.mandarin: 秉持長期主義的解決問題態度與成長型思維。保持耐心、適度放慢腳步，修煉韌性與反脆弱能力。
To have a long-term problem-solving atti.taiwanese: 用長期主義的態度佮成長型思維來解決問題。愛有耐性、跤步適度放慢，修練韌性佮反脆弱的本事。

Don’t’ give up to find a better solution.english: Do not give up on finding optimized solutions for critical tasks, even if it is a long journey. However, recognize when a solution is "good enough for now" to avoid over-engineering.
Don’t’ give up to find a better solution.mandarin: 對於關鍵任務，不要放棄尋找更佳解，這可能是一場持久戰。但對於次要任務，要懂得適可而止、接受「目前夠用就好」，避免過度設計。
Don’t’ give up to find a better solution.taiwanese: 關鍵的任務，莫放棄揣閣較好的解法，這可能是一場久長的戰。毋過次要的任務，就愛知影適可而止、接受「這馬夠用就好」，莫設計甲傷過頭。

Let your colleagues and boss do their jo.english: Allow your colleagues and manager to do their jobs without crossing boundaries. Learn to speak their language and use their professional terminology.
Let your colleagues and boss do their jo.mandarin: 放手讓同事和主管做他們該做的事，不要越俎代庖。學會用他們的語言與專業術語溝通，減少隔閡。
Let your colleagues and boss do their jo.taiwanese: 放手予同事佮主管做個該做的代誌，莫插手替人做。學會用個的語言佮專業術語溝通，減少隔閡。

You cannot say no for tasks related to b.english: Recognize that you cannot easily reject tasks that are critical to business-level priorities or corporate strategy.
You cannot say no for tasks related to b.mandarin: 認清現實：對於與公司業務層面、核心戰略直接相關的任務，你沒有說「不」的權力。
You cannot say no for tasks related to b.taiwanese: 看清現實：碰著牽連公司業務核心、公司大方向的重大代誌，你無說「袂使」的權利，只有承擔頂起去。

No pursuit fairness in the office..english: Do not waste energy chasing absolute fairness in the office; focus instead on managing your outcomes and value.
No pursuit fairness in the office..mandarin: 別在職場上盲目追求絕對的公平，這不現實；將精力集中在你能掌控的成果與價值創造上。
No pursuit fairness in the office..taiwanese: 莫佇職場青盲牛仝款追求絕對的公平，這無現實；共氣力囥佇你控制會著的成果佮價值創造頂懸。

No one can stop your learning..english: Remember that no matter the environment, no one can stop you from learning and growing.
No one can stop your learning..mandarin: 記住：無論環境多惡劣，都沒有人能阻止你持續學習與自我提升。
No one can stop your learning..taiwanese: 愛會記得：毋管環境偌惡劣，攏無人會當擋你繼續學習、提升家己。

Evaluate the value of your tasks. In sh.english: Regularly evaluate the value of your tasks from both short-term and long-term perspectives. Aim to extract transferable experience from everything you do.
Evaluate the value of your tasks. In sh.mandarin: 從短期與長期的雙重維度評估你手頭任務的價值。致力於從做過的每件事中吸取能帶得走的實戰經驗。
Evaluate the value of your tasks. In sh.taiwanese: 從眼前佮長遠的雙重角度來秤看手頭工課的份量。認真對做過的逐項代誌汲取經驗，練出誰嘛提袂走的真本事。

People attend to think in a negative way.english: Acknowledge that people naturally tend to overthink or gravitate toward negative scenarios; protect your mindset from this bias. (Related to Item 131)
People attend to think in a negative way.mandarin: 意識到人們天生容易悲觀過度或想太多。學會保護自己不受這種集體負面情緒的影響。
People attend to think in a negative way.taiwanese: 愛知影人天生就較會想傷悲觀、想傷濟。學會保護家己，莫予這款規陣人的負面情緒影響著。

More discussions is good ( if not diverg.english: More collaborative discussion is beneficial as long as it does not diverge from the agenda. Learn actively from others' inputs.
More discussions is good ( if not diverg.mandarin: 只要不發散失焦，多討論交流是件好事。積極從他人的觀點中吸取營養。
More discussions is good ( if not diverg.taiwanese: 只要毋是講甲走精、失焦，加討論交流是好代誌。愛積極對別人的觀點吸收養分。

Speak out, you are occupied by other bus.english: Bravely speak up and declare when your bandwidth is fully occupied by other priority business.
Speak out, you are occupied by other bus.mandarin: 當你的工作頻寬已被其他優先專案占滿時，坦誠且明確地說出來。
Speak out, you are occupied by other bus.taiwanese: 你工課的頻寬若已經予其他優先的專案佔滿，就愛老實、清楚講出來。

To be an expert in your field.english: Commit to becoming a true, recognized subject-matter expert in your specific field.
To be an expert in your field.mandarin: 深耕自己所在的領域，立志成為無可替代的行業專家。
To be an expert in your field.taiwanese: 佇家己的領域深耕，立志做一个無人通替代的行業專家。

Choose OKR / OGSM / KPI. The important t.english: Use frameworks like OKRs, OGSM, or KPIs to filter your workload. Always tackle the most important things first and focus on your top 3 daily actions.
Choose OKR / OGSM / KPI. The important t.mandarin: 善用 OKR、OGSM 或 KPI 架構篩選任務。永遠先做最重要的事，每天聚焦於推進前 3 大關鍵行動。
Choose OKR / OGSM / KPI. The important t.taiwanese: 好好用 OKR、OGSM 抑是 KPI 架構來篩選任務。永遠先做上要緊的，逐工專心推前 3 大關鍵行動。

Secure your field ( territory) first an.english: Secure your own professional territory first before expanding. Protect your passion and manage your mental energy.
Secure your field ( territory) first an.mandarin: 先站穩並鞏固你自己的業務領地，再圖擴張。保護好你的工作熱情，做好能量管理。
Secure your field ( territory) first an.taiwanese: 先站穩並鞏固你家己的業務領地，再圖擴張。保護好你的工作熱情，做好能量管理。

Reserved your time for exercise, family,.english: Reserve non-negotiable blocks of "sacred time" on your calendar for exercise, family, and learning. Let low-priority tasks go; less is often better.
Reserved your time for exercise, family,.mandarin: 在行事曆上為運動、家人與自學預留不可妥協的「神聖時間」。果斷捨棄次要雜務，越簡單越有力。
Reserved your time for exercise, family,.taiwanese: 佇行事曆頂面為著運動、照顧厝裡佮自學進修，留出無妥協的「神聖時間」。無要緊的雜務愛敢放手，愈單純愈有氣力。

You won’t work in this company till reti.english: Acknowledge that you will not stay at your current company until retirement. Maintain a backup plan, and define the future roadmap for both your products and your career. (Related to Item 328)
You won’t work in this company till reti.mandarin: 認清現實：你不可能在這家公司工作到退休。隨時準備好備用生存計畫，明確你所負責產品的市場前景與你個人的職涯路線圖。
You won’t work in this company till reti.taiwanese: 愛認清現實：你無可能佇這間公司做到退休。愛隨時準備好備用的生存計畫，你負責的產品佇市場的前景，佮你個人的職涯路線圖，攏愛清楚。

Do you have any list for travel, or any.english: Maintain a personal bucket list of travel destinations and activities to keep your personal life inspiring and separate from work.
Do you have any list for travel, or any.mandarin: 為自己列一張旅行與想體驗活動的清單，確保生活豐富多彩，不被工作完全綁架。
Do you have any list for travel, or any.taiwanese: 替家己列一張想欲去旅行、想欲體驗的活動清單，予生活豐富多彩，莫予工課規个縛牢咧。

Prepare an inspiring song list for the d.english: Prepare an inspiring playlist of music to boost your mood during career setbacks or downturns.
Prepare an inspiring song list for the d.mandarin: 準備一份能激勵人心的專屬歌單，在遭遇職場挫折或低潮時用以自我療癒。
Prepare an inspiring song list for the d.taiwanese: 準備一份會當激勵人心的專屬歌單，佇職場拄著挫折抑是心情落底的時陣，提來療癒家己。

Always to challenge yourself for being b.english: Always challenge yourself to pursue excellence. Strive to improve just a little bit every single day.
Always to challenge yourself for being b.mandarin: 永遠抱持挑戰自我、追求卓越的心態。不求一日千里，但求每天都有微小的進步。
Always to challenge yourself for being b.taiwanese: 隨時抱著自我挑戰、求好心切的心情。毋免一日千里，但求逐工攏有一屑仔微小的進步。

What’s takeaways for this meeting / disc.english: Always summarize the key takeaways, action items, and owners at the end of every meeting or discussion.
What’s takeaways for this meeting / disc.mandarin: 開會結束前，務必重申本次會議的關鍵結論（Takeaways）、行動方案與負責人。
What’s takeaways for this meeting / disc.taiwanese: 會議欲結束進前，一定愛閣再講一擺這擺會議的關鍵結論（Takeaways）、行動方案佮負責人。

Pay attention to the anchoring effect wh.english: Beware of the anchoring effect when setting schedules or estimates. Always build in a reasonable safety margin.
Pay attention to the anchoring effect wh.mandarin: 制定時程或估算工時時，警惕「錨定效應」（被最初的估計綁死）。務必預留合理的彈性邊際。
Pay attention to the anchoring effect wh.taiwanese: 排時程抑是估工時的時陣，愛注意「錨定效應」（予上早的估計縛死）。一定愛留合理的彈性空間。

Antifragile, prepare resign letter and u.english: Maintain antifragility: draft a resignation letter and keep your resume updated with the latest industry keywords to attract headhunters. Understand your circle of competence, and maintain contact with recruiters to track market opportunities.
Antifragile, prepare resign letter and u.mandarin: 落實反脆弱思維：寫好一份預備辭職信，並定期更新履歷表（加入最新的業界關鍵字，方便獵頭檢索）。認清自己的能力圈，與獵頭保持定期聯絡以掌握市面上的好機會。
Antifragile, prepare resign letter and u.taiwanese: 落實反脆弱思維：寫好一份預備辭職信，並定期更新履歷表（加入最新的業界關鍵字，方便獵頭檢索）。認清家己的能力圈，與獵頭保持定期聯絡以掌握市面上的好機會。

Reserve/book coffee breaks between conse.english: Block out buffer times or "coffee breaks" between consecutive meetings to prevent back-to-back scheduling. Aim for no more than 3 intense meeting sessions per day.
Reserve/book coffee breaks between conse.mandarin: 在連續的會議之間，刻意在行事曆上預約「咖啡時間」以作緩衝。每天高強度會議盡量不超過 3 場。
Reserve/book coffee breaks between conse.taiwanese: 連紲幾若場會議中間，刻意佇行事曆預約「咖啡時間」做緩衝。逐工高強度的會議盡量莫超過 3 場。

Spend time on reviewing what you achieve.english: Dedicate regular time to review your achievements, update documentation, and check in on your mental well-being (weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annually) to prepare for performance reviews. (Related to Item 331)
Spend time on reviewing what you achieve.mandarin: 定期抽出時間盤點自己的成就、整理知識文檔，並關照自己的心智狀態（每週、每月、每季、每年）。這不僅是為了年度考評做好充足準備，也是一種自我對話。
Spend time on reviewing what you achieve.taiwanese: 愛定期撥時間盤點家己的成就、整理知識文件，閣愛關心家己的心智狀態（逐禮拜、逐個月、逐季、逐年）。這毋但是為著年度考核準備予夠額，嘛是一種佮家己的對話。

CAGR, EBIT, understand financial terms..english: Familiarize yourself with core business and financial terms, such as CAGR (Compound Annual Growth Rate) and EBIT (Earnings Before Interest and Taxes). (Related to Item 62)
CAGR, EBIT, understand financial terms..mandarin: 熟悉核心商業與財務術語，如 CAGR（複合年均增長率）、EBIT（息稅前利潤）等，這有助於你理解高層的財務視角。
CAGR, EBIT, understand financial terms..taiwanese: 熟悉核心商業佮算帳術語（親像 CAGR、EBIT），這會鬥相共你了解高層主管的算盤佮財務眼光。

Don’t be perfect, don’t need to finish t.english: Do not strive for instant perfection or try to finish everything at once. Understand the difference between "perfect" and "good enough for the situation." Be patient and move step by step. (Related to Item 7)
Don’t be perfect, don’t need to finish t.mandarin: 不求一步登天與瞬間完美，也毋須試圖一次完成所有事。理解「完美」與「在此時此境夠用就好」的區別。保持耐心，循序漸進。
Don’t be perfect, don’t need to finish t.taiwanese: 莫想欲一步登天、一下就完美，嘛免想欲一擺共所有代誌攏做了。愛分會清「完美」佮「佇這个時陣、這个場面夠用就好」的無仝。愛有耐性，一步一步來。

Care about your instinct, what does it f.english: Listen to your gut instinct and what it is trying to tell you. However, always prioritize objective, scientific data to guide your final decisions.
Care about your instinct, what does it f.mandarin: 重視你的直覺，傾聽它想傳遞給你的警訊。然而，最終決策仍應以客觀、科學的數據為依歸。
Care about your instinct, what does it f.taiwanese: 照重你的第六感，聽伊欲提醒你的警報。毋過最後拍算決定，猶是愛以客觀、科學的數字根據為準。

Go around when tired in front of laptop.english: When feeling fatigued sitting in front of your laptop, stand up and walk around. Find a colleague who seems stressed and offer a word of encouragement; helping others boosts your own mood.
Go around when tired in front of laptop.mandarin: 在電腦前坐累了，就起身走走。若看到顯得焦慮的同事，主動給予鼓勵，關懷他人也能為自己注入正能量。
Go around when tired in front of laptop.taiwanese: 在電腦前坐累了，就起身走走。若看到顯得焦慮的同事，主動給予鼓勵，關懷他人也能為家己注入正能量。

Be proactive when no one realize what yo.english: Be proactive in highlighting your contributions when they go unnoticed. Communicate your value autonomously; this prompts leadership to recognize your worth, helps others learn from you, and earns you professional respect.
Be proactive when no one realize what yo.mandarin: 若發現自己的努力與貢獻沒被看見，主動且得體地在報告或會議中呈現出來。高調證明價值，讓主管看重你的貢獻，也能贏得同事的尊重。
Be proactive when no one realize what yo.taiwanese: 若發現家己的努力與貢獻沒被看見，主動且得體地在報告或會議中呈現出來。高調證明價值，讓主管看重你的貢獻，也能贏得同事的尊重。

Make a good report template for regular.english: Develop high-quality report templates for regular reviews and specific issues (e.g., 8D reports, one-page summaries, and yield tracking).
Make a good report template for regular.mandarin: 為例行性會議或特定主題開發高質量的報告範本（例如：8D 報告、一頁紙總結、良率追蹤表）。
Make a good report template for regular.taiwanese: 為平常開會抑專案題目，開發出高水準的報告範本（例如：8D 報告、一張紙重點、良率追蹤表）。

You don't need to comment for everything.english: You do not need to comment on every issue. Keep your silence when appropriate. Maintain boundaries between work and life, even though it is difficult. Remember: no reply is also a reply.
You don't need to comment for everything.mandarin: 你不需要對每件事都發表意見。學會保持沉默。儘管不易，仍要努力畫分工作與生活的邊界。記住：不回覆本身也是一種回覆。
You don't need to comment for everything.taiwanese: 你毋免逐項代誌攏揷喙發表意見。學會得恬恬。就算無簡單，猶是愛盡力畫分工課佮生活的界線。記牢：無回覆本身就是一種回覆。

Focus on 3 key tasks per day. Don’t exce.english: Focus on 3 key tasks per day. Avoid trying to handle more than 3 major objectives at once. (Related to Item 52)
Focus on 3 key tasks per day. Don’t exce.mandarin: 每天聚焦於 3 項關鍵任務。重要事務一天不超過 3 件，以確保執行質量。
Focus on 3 key tasks per day. Don’t exce.taiwanese: 逐工專心佇 3 項關鍵任務。要緊的代誌一工莫超過 3 件，做出來的品質才顧會著。

Don’t need to finish task in one time. B.english: Do not feel pressured to complete massive tasks in a single session. Break them down, be patient, and adopt a long-term mindset. (Related to Item 7)
Don’t need to finish task in one time. B.mandarin: 無須急著一次把龐大的工作啃完。拆解成步驟、維持耐心，抱持長期主義心態。
Don’t need to finish task in one time. B.taiwanese: 免急欲一擺共大範的工課食了了。拆做一步一步、愛有耐性，用長期主義的心態來面對。

Do high value-added work. Separate high/.english: Focus your energy on high-value-added work. Categorize tasks into high-value versus low-value, but never neglect the foundational knowledge that supports them.
Do high value-added work. Separate high/.mandarin: 專注做高附加價值的工作。學會辨識高低價值任務的區別，但切勿輕視並忘卻支撐這些任務的底層基礎知識。
Do high value-added work. Separate high/.taiwanese: 專心做價值懸的工課。學會得分清好空佮雜碎事的差別，毋過千萬莫看輕亦莫袂記扶持這寡工課的底層根基功夫。

Taking statistics, it may cheat by perce.english: When analyzing statistics, be alert to manipulation through percentages, absolute versus relative numbers, varying baselines, and unit fallacies.
Taking statistics, it may cheat by perce.mandarin: 檢視統計數據時，保持警惕：數據常透過百分比、絕對值與相對值的操弄、基準點的變更，以及單位謬誤來誤導人。
Taking statistics, it may cheat by perce.taiwanese: 審核統計數字時陣，眼睛愛擘予金：數字定定會用百分比、絕對值佮相對值偷換觀念、換起頭基準、抑是借單位糊弄人。

Improve yourself while you are waiting f.english: Focus on self-improvement while waiting for external conditions or the work environment to get better. However, manage your pace to avoid burning yourself out.
Improve yourself while you are waiting f.mandarin: 在靜待外部大環境或職場環境改善的同時，專注於自我提升。但要注意節奏，別把自己逼得太緊。
Improve yourself while you are waiting f.taiwanese: 等外口大環境抑是公司環境變好的這段時間，先顧好家己、加減充實。毋過步數愛有節奏，莫共家己逼甲傷絚。

Perfection may kill you in some cases. S.english: Perfectionism can be paralyzing. Focus on making small, consistent steps daily to achieve massive long-term results. (Related to Item 356)
Perfection may kill you in some cases. S.mandarin: 過度追求完美有時會拖垮你。每天進步一點點，持續的小步伐最終能累積成巨大的成就。
Perfection may kill you in some cases. S.taiwanese: 傷過頂真、凡事欲求十全，有時陣煞會共家己拖死。一工進步一屑仔就好，細步細步一直行，路尾會積做大成就。

Digest big information / date in short p.english: Train yourself to digest massive amounts of information and data in a short time. This skill requires practice and time; utilize modern digital tools to assist.
Digest big information / date in short p.mandarin: 訓練自己在極短時間內消化吸收海量資訊與數據的能力。這需要長期練習，並積極善用最新的數位工具輔助。
Digest big information / date in short p.taiwanese: 共家己練甲會當佇真短的時間內，共規大堆的資訊佮數據食落、消化好勢。這款功夫愛長期練，閣愛勢用上新的數位工具來鬥相共。

Don’t over think too much. Just do and e.english: Avoid overthinking. Take action, execute, observe the results, and adjust your approach dynamically.
Don’t over think too much. Just do and e.mandarin: 不要過度空想。動手做、去執行，觀察反饋後隨時動態調整。
Don’t over think too much. Just do and e.taiwanese: 莫一直坐咧空想。先出手做、去行動，看反應按怎，才隨時調整。

PDCA, finish cycle. Accept uncertainty,.english: Complete the PDCA (Plan-Do-Check-Act) cycle. Accept uncertainty as a constant, and focus on building a stronger mindset day by day on this long journey.
PDCA, finish cycle. Accept uncertainty,.mandarin: 落實 PDCA（計畫-執行-查核-行動）的閉環管理。擁抱不確定性，在這條漫長的職場馬拉松中，讓自己的內心一天比一天強大。
PDCA, finish cycle. Accept uncertainty,.taiwanese: PDCA（計畫－執行－查核－行動）的圓箍仔愛確實行予透。毋通驚無確定的代誌，佇職場這條長長的馬拉松路，予家己的心一工比一工較在。

Don’t overlook every small step you walk.english: Never underestimate the value of small steps. Consistency is the key to compound progress.
Don’t overlook every small step you walk.mandarin: 不要輕視你跨出的每一個小腳步。持之以恆的規律累積是巨大複利的前提。
Don’t overlook every small step you walk.taiwanese: 莫看輕家己行出去的逐細步。有恆心、照起工一直積，才有後來的大複利。

A simple talks may ease some tension sit.english: Engaging in casual small talk (e.g., discussing the weather or sports) can effectively diffuse tense situations and build rapport.
A simple talks may ease some tension sit.mandarin: 在氣氛緊張時，聊聊日常話題（如天氣或運動）能有效緩解緊繃氣氛、拉近人際距離。
A simple talks may ease some tension sit.taiwanese: 佇氣氛硬梆梆的時陣，開喙講講日常閒話（像天公氣色抑運動球賽），上會解圍鬆筋、拉近逐家的距離。

Make fun for your job. Find new things..english: Find ways to bring fun and curiosity into your work. Discovering new learning points keeps your mind active and growing.
Make fun for your job. Find new things..mandarin: 設法在日常工作中尋找樂趣與好奇心。主動學習新知識，以此刺激心智成長。
Make fun for your job. Find new things..taiwanese: 想辦法佇平時的工課中揣趣味佮好玄的心情。主動學新知，按呢大腦才袂生菇，心智持續成長。

Set a one-minute goal. ( MVP).english: Set one-minute micro-goals (similar to MVP thinking) to build momentum and overcome procrastination.
Set a one-minute goal. ( MVP).mandarin: 設定「一分鐘微目標」（MVP 最小可行思維），降低起動阻力以克制拖延。
Set a one-minute goal. ( MVP).taiwanese: 設「一分鐘微目標」（MVP 最小可行起頭），降低落手門檻來治好拖延的病根。

Spend time on your goal and spend more t.english: Keep your eyes on your long-term goals, but spend the majority of your time on relentless, daily execution.
Spend time on your goal and spend more t.mandarin: 將目標了然於心，但將大部分精力花在實打實的日常執行上。
Spend time on your goal and spend more t.taiwanese: 目標囥佇心肝內就好，大部分的氣力愛開佇逐工實實在在的做工課。

Stop telling people more than they need.english: Avoid over-sharing. Stop volunteering information beyond what stakeholders need to know.
Stop telling people more than they need.mandarin: 適度留白。不要主動向旁人透露超出他們需要知道的過多資訊。
Stop telling people more than they need.taiwanese: 喙角愛有度，適度留白。莫主動共邊仔人講甲過頭冗雜，別人毋免知影的秘密佮細節，恬恬就好。

=> don't reply email after 3:00 PM if it.english: Avoid replying to non-urgent emails late in the afternoon (e.g., after 3:00 PM). Instead, reserve that time for deep focus, producing tangible outputs, documenting work, or learning. Adopt positive language like "It's fine" or "Looking good."
=> don't reply email after 3:00 PM if it.mandarin: 下午 3:00 後如無迫切必要，避免回信。將這段時間留給深度產出、整理文檔或自學新事物。保持正向口吻，多說「這沒問題」、「一切順利」。
=> don't reply email after 3:00 PM if it.taiwanese: 下晝三點過後若無火燒菇，盡量莫閣回批。將這段時間留予深度產出、整頓檔案抑進修新功夫。講話維持正向口氣，濟講「這無問題」、「攏真順利」。

I am driving this activity with low prio.english: Use diplomatic phrasing for priority negotiation: "I am currently tracking this task with lower priority on my backlog, aiming for completion by late September. Could you share more background on this request so I can evaluate if we need to adjust priorities?"
I am driving this activity with low prio.mandarin: 優雅談判優先順序話術：「我目前將此項任務排在待辦清單中較低優先級，預計在九月底前完成。能否請您提供更多背景資訊，以便我評估是否需要調整目前的任務優先順序？」
I am driving this activity with low prio.taiwanese: 會曉好禮仔佮人喬先後的話術：「這項工課我這馬排佇待辦清單較後壁，預計九月尾進前會做好。敢會使請你加講淡薄仔背景予我知，我才看覓工課的先後敢愛調整？」

always ready to leave Your current posit.english: Always be prepared to leave your current position. Master portable survival skills that allow you to work anywhere, and prioritize paying yourself first (investing in your capability and assets).
always ready to leave Your current posit.mandarin: 隨時做好離職的準備。掌握不管到哪裡都能生存的核心硬技能，永遠優先投資自己（個人能力與資產防線）。
always ready to leave Your current posit.taiwanese: 隨時做好離職的準備。掌握不管到哪裡都能生存的核心硬技能，永遠優先投資家己（個人能力與資產防線）。

Prepare 1 min actions. As part of sense.english: Prepare simple, one-minute start-up tasks to establish a sense of ritual and smoothly ease into your focus mode.
Prepare 1 min actions. As part of sense.mandarin: 準備好一些可在「一分鐘內完成」的小動作，作為開工儀式，幫助自己順暢進入專注狀態。
Prepare 1 min actions. As part of sense.taiwanese: 準備好一些可在「一分鐘內完成」的小動作，作為開工儀式，幫助家己順暢進入專注狀態。

Learn read financial report from top man.english: Learn to read corporate financial reports and annual earnings summaries. This helps you assess job security, understand upcoming corporate KPIs, evaluate company performance, and judge whether your products have a sustainable market life cycle.
Learn read financial report from top man.mandarin: 學習閱讀高階主管的財務報告與公司的年度財務報表。這能幫助你評估工作保障度、理解明年的 KPI 目標、判斷公司的經營狀況，並審視你負責的產品在市場中的生命週期。
Learn read financial report from top man.taiwanese: 學看大老闆的財務報告佮公司的年度算帳報表。這會鬥相共你推測頭路敢穩當、知曉明年的 KPI 目標、看清公司的經營好歹，並且盤查你顧的產品佇市場上的壽命。

Don’t hesitate to use new tool or afraid.english: Do not hesitate to adopt new tools (such as ChatGPT, Obsidian, or other digital note-taking apps). Establish a systematic way to retrieve information quickly when needed.
Don’t hesitate to use new tool or afraid.mandarin: 勇於嘗試並使用新工具（如 ChatGPT、數位筆記）。同時，要建立清晰的資訊檢索邏輯，確保下次需要時能快速找到。
Don’t hesitate to use new tool or afraid.taiwanese: 大膽試用新工具（像 ChatGPT、數位筆記）。仝時愛起好清楚的找揣邏輯，保證後回要用的時陣會當隨揣著。

don’t ask if you may know possible feedb.english: Do not ask questions if you already know the answers or can predict the feedback; avoid wasting valuable communication bandwidth.
don’t ask if you may know possible feedb.mandarin: 如果你已經知道答案或能預測對方的反饋，就別開口詢問，不要浪費多餘的溝通頻寬。
don’t ask if you may know possible feedb.taiwanese: 若是你早就知影答案，抑是料會著對方會按怎應，就莫閣開喙問，免得白白浪費溝通的時間佮氣力。

Reduced email communication, talk direct.english: Minimize email communication; pick up the phone or speak directly to resolve issues faster. (Related to Item 18)
Reduced email communication, talk direct.mandarin: 減少來回的電子郵件溝通。必要時直接通話或當面討論以提高效率。
Reduced email communication, talk direct.taiwanese: 電子批莫來來去去寫規堆。有需要就直接敲電話抑是當面講，較緊閣較有效率。

Secure circle of power and extent it. Re.english: Consolidate your core circle of competence (power of circle) first, then expand it. Review your skill matrix periodically.
Secure circle of power and extent it. Re.mandarin: 先鞏固好你的核心技能圈與影響力邊界，再逐步對外擴張。定期檢視你的個人技能矩陣。
Secure circle of power and extent it. Re.taiwanese: 先共家己核心本事的範圍佮影響力的地盤顧予在，才一步一步向外擴。定定掀開家己的技能矩陣看覓。

Keep silence till you meet your goal. Ke.english: Keep your plans quiet and remain silent until you reach your goal.
Keep silence till you meet your goal. Ke.mandarin: 在達成目標之前，保持絕對的低調與沉靜，少說多做。
Keep silence till you meet your goal. Ke.taiwanese: 目標猶未達成進前，愛足低調、恬恬仔，較少講、加做。

To calm and have grown mindset when rece.english: Remain calm and maintain a growth mindset when receiving critical or constructive feedback.
To calm and have grown mindset when rece.mandarin: 面對批評或改進意見時，保持冷靜並抱持成長型思維，將其視為進化的養分。
To calm and have grown mindset when rece.taiwanese: 人共你批評抑是提改進的意見，心愛定，用成長的心態去看，共伊當做予家己進步的肥底。

What do you learn from the past and how.english: Regularly ask yourself: "What lessons have I learned from the past, and how can I apply them to improve in the future?"
What do you learn from the past and how.mandarin: 時常審視：「我從過去中汲取了什麼教訓？未來該如何改進？」
What do you learn from the past and how.taiwanese: 定定問家己：「我對過去學著啥物教示？以後欲按怎改較好？」

Would you like to make an announcement o.english: Before making an announcement or offering suggestions, run this filter: 1. Do you have a viable solution ready? 2. Do you understand the required resources, effort, and impact? 3. Does this maintain decorum and build positive relations? If none are true, keep silent.
Would you like to make an announcement o.mandarin: 在公開發言或提建議前，先進行三重過濾：1. 你手頭是否有可行的解決方案？2. 你是否清楚所需的資源、付出與影響？3. 這是否合乎職場體統與禮儀（Decorum）？如果答案都是否定的，請保持沉默。
Would you like to make an announcement o.taiwanese: 佇公開發言抑是提建議進前，先過三重篩：1. 你手頭有可行的解決辦法無？2. 你敢清楚需要啥物資源、愛了偌濟工、會有啥物影響？3. 這敢有合職場的體統佮禮數（Decorum）？若三項攏毋是，就恬恬莫講。

Reserve some time to think, read and lea.english: Reserve uninterrupted "sacred time" daily to think, read, learn, and write.
Reserve some time to think, read and lea.mandarin: 每天為自己留出一段不受干擾的「神聖時間」，專注於思考、閱讀、學習與寫作。
Reserve some time to think, read and lea.taiwanese: 逐工共家己留一段無人攪擾的「神聖時間」，專心思考、讀冊、學習佮寫作。

Be mysterious, don’t comment on everythi.english: Maintain professional mystery; do not comment on every issue. Exercise patience when waiting for feedback and allow situations to evolve before reacting.
Be mysterious, don’t comment on everythi.mandarin: 保持某種職場神秘感，不隨意發表言論。耐心等待別人的反饋，靜待局勢產生變化後再做應對。
Be mysterious, don’t comment on everythi.taiwanese: 佇職場愛保留一寡神祕感，莫烏白發表意見。耐心等別人的反應，看局勢有變化才出手應付。

Prey for what you hard work..english: Trust in the compounding value of your hard work, and let the results speak for themselves.
Prey for what you hard work..mandarin: 深信自己辛勤付出的價值，靜待時間複利結出果實。
Prey for what you hard work..taiwanese: 相信家己認真拍拚的價值，等時間的複利慢慢仔結果。

carry the ball to boss..english: Know when to escalate decisions and delegate complex issues to your manager ("pass the ball to the boss") rather than carrying unreasonable burdens alone.
carry the ball to boss..mandarin: 學會踢回皮球。當遇到超出職權範圍或需要高層定奪的事物時，適時呈報主管（將球傳給老闆），不要自己強扛責任。
carry the ball to boss..taiwanese: 愛會曉共球踢轉去。拄著超過家己職權、愛高層做主的代誌，就看時機報予主管知（共球傳予頭家），莫家己硬擔。

What is current market trend and how man.english: Observe the current market trends and study how executives and leaders respond to these changes.
What is current market trend and how man.mandarin: 密切觀察當前的市場趨勢，並學習主管及高階主管面對這些變革時的應對之策。
What is current market trend and how man.taiwanese: 目睭金金看這馬市場的趨勢，嘛學主管佮高階主管面對這寡變化是按怎應付。

When was the last time you are in the fl.english: Reflect on your working habits: When was the last time you entered a deep, productive state of "flow"? How can you replicate that environment?
When was the last time you are in the fl.mandarin: 回顧自我狀態：你上一次進入心無旁騖的「心流（Flow）」狀態是什麼時候？該如何重新複製那樣的專注環境？
When was the last time you are in the fl.taiwanese: 回頭看家己的狀態：你頂一擺入去專心甲袂分心的「心流（Flow）」是當時？欲按怎共彼款專心的環境閣再做出來？

developing Surviving skill, try to cook.english: Build basic survival and life skills, such as learning to cook your own meals to maintain physical health.
developing Surviving skill, try to cook.mandarin: 培養基本的自主生活技能，例如學會自己下廚準備三餐，這是維持身體健康的基礎。
developing Surviving skill, try to cook.taiwanese: 培養基本的自主生活技能，例如學會家己下廚準備三餐，這是維持身體健康的基礎。

do not talk about negative things to you.english: Avoid sharing negative thoughts with colleagues. Focus on positive milestones; this encourages respect and establishes your authority. Complaining or sharing vulnerabilities in the office can cause others to perceive you as weak. Understand that workplace survival requires strategic self-presentation.
do not talk about negative things to you.mandarin: 避免在同事面前流露消極想法。多談論正面、有建設性的事，這能建立你的專業自信並贏得尊重。相反地，頻繁抱怨只會讓旁人質疑你的能力。認清現實：職場是一場表演，為了生存，你必須展現專業與實力。
do not talk about negative things to you.taiwanese: 莫佇同事面前顯出洩氣話。濟講正面、有建設性的代誌，按呢會起造你的專業自信兼受人敬重。若愛怨東怨西，只會予人質疑你的本事。看清現實：職場本成是一場戲齣，為著顧飯碗，你著愛展現出專業佮實力。

Do right thing? What is right? Who to ju.english: Reflect on what it means to "do the right thing." Who defines what is right in this context, and do you possess the authority or power to execute it?
Do right thing? What is right? Who to ju.mandarin: 思考何謂「做正確的事」。在目前的職場環境中，究竟由誰定義正確？而你是否有足夠的權限與力量去推動它？
Do right thing? What is right? Who to ju.taiwanese: 想看覓啥物號做「做著的代誌」。佇這馬的職場環境，到底是啥人咧定啥物是著的？你敢有夠額的權限佮力量去推？

ask directly for better solution. It is.english: Ask directly for feedback and advice to find a better solution. Accept that getting things "first-time-right" is rare; focus on iterative improvements.
ask directly for better solution. It is.mandarin: 直接向專家或主管請教更好的解決方案。認清很少有人能「一次就做對」的事實，重點在於快速迭代改進。
ask directly for better solution. It is.taiwanese: 直接去請教專家抑是主管，揣較好的解決辦法。愛認知真少人會當「一擺就做著」，重點是緊緊改、一直改予較好。

Try to adaptive the thing you cannot cha.english: Adapt to the constraints you cannot alter, or choose to walk away. Be highly selective and choose your battles. (Related to Item 141)
Try to adaptive the thing you cannot cha.mandarin: 對於無法改變的既定環境，學會適應它，或者果斷抽身離場。選擇正確的戰場。
Try to adaptive the thing you cannot cha.taiwanese: 碰著無塊好改的大環境，學會得適應順應，無就煞煞抽身離場。揀對戰場才去拚。

any accumulate knowledge or credit or ex.english: Evaluate if your current project or position is helping you accumulate valuable knowledge, industry credit, or transferable experience.
any accumulate knowledge or credit or ex.mandarin: 盤點目前的專案或崗位，是否能為你累積帶得走的專業知識、業界信譽（Credit）或實戰經驗？
any accumulate knowledge or credit or ex.taiwanese: 算看覓這馬的專案抑是位置，敢會當予你積著紮會走的專業智識、業界的信用（Credit）抑是實戰經驗？

People didn't lie but they didn't tell a.english: Be aware that people rarely lie outright, but they often omit key details. These fragmented facts can easily mislead; always seek the complete picture.
People didn't lie but they didn't tell a.mandarin: 保持警覺：人們很少直接撒謊，但往往會隱瞞部分真相。這種碎片化的事實更容易誤導人；務必主動還原完整全貌。
People didn't lie but they didn't tell a.taiwanese: 愛有警覺：人真少直接講白賊，毋過定定會藏一部分的真相。這款一角一角的事實，閣較容易共人騙去；一定愛家己主動共規个全貌拼轉來。

when making a decision, what will happen.english: When making critical decisions, evaluate their consequences across three timelines: What will happen in 10 days, 10 months, and 10 years? (Rule of 10-10-10)
when making a decision, what will happen.mandarin: 做決策前，運用「10-10-10 原則」審視後果：這決定在 10 天後、10 個月後以及 10 年後會帶來什麼影響？
when making a decision, what will happen.taiwanese: 做決定進前，用「10-10-10 原則」看後果：這个決定佇 10 工後、10 個月後佮 10 冬後，會有啥物影響？

Don't put 100% load capacity, any incide.english: Never operate at 100% load capacity; always leave a buffer to handle unexpected emergencies. Use your sacred time to refresh your mind, and schedule time for writing, reading, and traveling.
Don't put 100% load capacity, any incide.mandarin: 工作絕不要排滿 100% 的極限頻寬，務必預留緩衝以應對突發狀況。利用神聖時間沉澱心靈，妥善安排寫作、閱讀與旅行的生活日程。
Don't put 100% load capacity, any incide.taiwanese: 工課絕對莫排甲百分之百滇滇，一定愛留一寡空縫通應付臨時的狀況。用神聖時間予心沉澱，共寫作、讀冊佮旅行的生活日程排予好勢。

a template for meeting minutes, agenda..english: Create a standardized template for meeting agendas and minutes, utilizing the PAR (Problem, Action, Result) or PAR (Purpose, Action, Result) structured format.

a template for meeting minutes, agenda..taiwanese: 打造規矩的會議議程佮紀錄範本，導入 PAR（問題-行動-結果 抑 目的-行動-結果）的骨架格式。

Check if you are the DRI for the questio.english: When receiving an email, verify if you are the DRI (Directly Responsible Individual). If not, you do not need to reply. Have the courage to decline or cancel meetings that lack clear value, stating your reasons politely.

Check if you are the DRI for the questio.taiwanese: 收到郵件時，先確認你是否為該任務的直接負責人（DRI）。若毋是，你無須搶著回信。勇敢拒絕或取消無價值的會議，並禮貌地說明理由。

Yearly review and plan for next year. (.english: Conduct an annual performance review and plan for the next year. Align your roadmap with your manager's expectations; if they lack a plan for you, draft one yourself. Clarify your motivation: Why are you pursuing these goals?
Yearly review and plan for next year. (.mandarin: 做好年度總結與明年的計畫。主動與主管對齊路線圖，若主管對你的職涯沒有清晰規劃，你就自己寫一份提案。明確核心動機：你為什麼要完成這些目標？這也是能量管理的一環。
Yearly review and plan for next year. (.taiwanese: 年度總結佮明年的計畫愛做予好。主動佮主管對路線圖，若主管對你的前途無清楚的安排，你就家己寫一份提案。核心的動機愛清楚：你是為啥物欲完成這寡目標？這嘛是管理家己精神氣力的一環。

Do we have a agreement on this?.english: Confirm alignment at the end of key discussions: "Do we have an agreement on this next step?"
Do we have a agreement on this?.mandarin: 在討論結束時，與團隊再次確認：「關於這個下一步，我們達成共識了嗎？」
Do we have a agreement on this?.taiwanese: 會議收尾時陣，佮團隊眾人確認好勢：「針對這个下一步，咱逐家敢有一致的共識？」

No reply is a reply.english: Remember that in professional communication, no response is still a form of response; analyze the silence. (Related to Item 361)
No reply is a reply.mandarin: 記住：在職場溝通中，「沒有回覆」本身也是一種表態。
No reply is a reply.taiwanese: 愛會記得：佇職場溝通，「無回應」本身嘛是一種表態。

Don’t let negative thing or people easil.english: Do not allow negative events or toxic people to occupy your mind. Your mental energy and focus are finite resources; protect them.
Don’t let negative thing or people easil.mandarin: 絕不讓消極的人或負面的爛事輕易侵佔你的心智。你的精力和注意力是有限的，必須嚴防死守。
Don’t let negative thing or people easil.taiwanese: 絕對莫予消極的人抑是負面的䆀代誌，輕輕鬆鬆就占去你的心神。你的精神佮注意力有限，愛顧甲絚絚。

Ask yourself if there is any takeaway fo.english: Ask yourself before or during a meeting: "What is my key takeaway from this discussion? If there is none, why am I participating?"
Ask yourself if there is any takeaway fo.mandarin: 開會時自問：「這場會議對我有何實質收穫？若毫無價值，我為什麼要坐在這裡浪費時間？」
Ask yourself if there is any takeaway fo.taiwanese: 開會的時陣問家己：「這場會議對我有啥物實在的收穫？若一點仔價值嘛無，我是坐佇遮浪費時間創啥？」

Be aware of the holiday of foreign colle.english: Be aware of the national holidays of your foreign colleagues. Remember to express gratitude when they send holiday greetings.
Be aware of the holiday of foreign colle.mandarin: 留意跨國外籍同事所在國家的國定假日。當他們發來節日祝賀時，務必禮貌回謝。
Be aware of the holiday of foreign colle.taiwanese: 心內愛知影外國同事當地的放假日。若是人有心送來過節祝賀，著愛照禮數共人講多謝。

What is the way to say no ？ and what is.english: Master the professional ways to say "no." Understand when and how to defend your position with logic and data.
What is the way to say no ？ and what is.mandarin: 掌握優雅說「不」的職場話術。明確在什麼情境下需要為自己的立場辯護，以及如何用邏輯與數據進行防禦。
What is the way to say no ？ and what is.taiwanese: 愛會曉好禮仔講「毋」的職場話術。愛清楚佇啥物情形愛為家己的立場辯護，閣愛按怎用邏輯佮數據來守。

choose your battle.english: Choose your battles wisely; do not waste energy on low-value conflicts. (Related to Item 410)
choose your battle.mandarin: 選擇對你真正重要的戰場，不要把寶貴精力浪費在低價值的衝突上。
choose your battle.taiwanese: 揀對家己真正重要的主戰場才去拚，莫共寶貴的氣力開佇無要緊的冤家衝突頂高。

Practice and improve your skill set ever.english: Practice and refine your professional skillset at every opportunity you get.
Practice and improve your skill set ever.mandarin: 抓住每一個實戰機會，反覆練習並精進你的專業技能包。
Practice and improve your skill set ever.taiwanese: 抓住每一个實戰機會，反覆練習並精進你的專業技能包。

Try to learn new things but not for ever.english: Be open to learning new things, but stay focused on your core domain. Challenge yourself to do one unique, milestone activity every year that you have never done before.
Try to learn new things but not for ever.mandarin: 保持學習新事物的心態，但必須專注於你的核心能力圈。自我要求每年去挑戰一件從未做過的特殊大事，打破常規。
Try to learn new things but not for ever.taiwanese: 保持學新代誌的心胸，毋過愛鎖定佇家己的核心本事圈。自我要求每年去衝一件未曾做過的特殊大事，跳出舊模仔。

Non player characteristic /分人 / save you.english: Adopt a "Non-Player Character" (NPC) mindset when dealing with workplace drama (detachment) to save your energy.
Non player characteristic /分人 / save you.mandarin: 冷眼旁觀職場紛擾，開啟「非玩家角色（NPC / 分人）」心態，以保存自身精神能量。
Non player characteristic /分人 / save you.taiwanese: 冷眼看職場紛紛擾擾，啟動「非玩家角色（NPC / 分人）」心態，留好精神氣力顧家己。

No more email reply during weekend. Clos.english: Stop replying to emails during weekends. Turn off email notifications on your phone.
No more email reply during weekend. Clos.mandarin: 週末不再回覆任何工作郵件。關閉手機上的郵件即時警報通知。
No more email reply during weekend. Clos.taiwanese: 禮拜六日絕不再回任何工課批信。共手機頂頭的郵件通知鈴聲通通關掉。

You don't need to take everything on you.english: Remember that you do not need to carry the weight of every team problem on your shoulders.
You don't need to take everything on you.mandarin: 認清界限：你不需要把團隊的所有問題都一個人扛在肩上。
You don't need to take everything on you.taiwanese: 界線愛認予清：團隊所有的問題，毋免你一个人家己擔佇肩胛頭。

GET BACK UP! It's time to take control o.english: GET BACK UP! Take control of your life and buy your time back. Use "If-Then" scenario planning to prepare for crises (e.g., earthquakes, policy changes, economic shifts). Establish clear contingency rules: If you receive an emotional email, delay your reply. If someone criticizes you, put your ego aside. If schedule is delayed, focus on solutions. If stressed or unhappy, go for a run. If people don't get your point, rephrase using simple words.
GET BACK UP! It's time to take control o.mandarin: 站起來！重新掌控你的人生，買回你的時間。運用「如果…就…（If-Then）」進行情境模擬，防範各類危機（如政策突變、地震、颱風、停電、經濟危機）。為日常狀況設定自動應對程序：若收到情緒化郵件，就延遲發信；若遭遇惡意批評，就放下自尊不予理會；若專案延遲，就聚焦解決方案；若感到鬱悶，就去跑步；若他人聽不懂你的話，就改用最簡單的話語解釋。
GET BACK UP! It's time to take control o.taiwanese: 爬起來！共家己的人生主導權提倒轉來，買回寶貴的時間。用「若是按呢…著按怎…（If-Then）」來演練心智模擬，防範逐款危機（像政策變卦、地動、風颱、停電、景氣崩盤）。為平時狀況設好自動應對步驟：收到情緒化信件，著延後回覆；受人惡意抹黑，著莫理面子無免插伊；專案若延誤，著專注揣解法；心內若欻鬱，著去跑步流汗；別人若聽無，著換上淺白的話講予伊明。

Play with fun,.english: Approach your work and hobbies with a playful, fun-loving spirit.
Play with fun,.mandarin: 保持玩心，在工作與生活中尋找樂趣。
Play with fun,.taiwanese: 抱著緣投趣味佮歡喜的心來看待挑戰；代誌就算無簡單，猶是值得盡心來試看覓。

Invest your interest no matter spending.english: Invest time and money in your hobbies and interests. Strive to build them to a professional level of competence.
Invest your interest no matter spending.mandarin: 大膽投資你的個人興趣（不論是投入時間還是金錢）。努力將其鑽研到具備某種專業水準。
Invest your interest no matter spending.taiwanese: 大膽投資家己的趣味嗜好（不管開時間抑是開銀兩）。煞猛共伊鑽研到有一套專門的水準。

Spend time to be alone, scared time for.english: Dedicate time to be alone. Reserve sacred, uninterrupted slots during both work and private hours to focus on what you want or to develop secondary skills.
Spend time to be alone, scared time for.mandarin: 留出獨處的時間。無論在工作還是私人生活中，都要確保有不受干擾的「神聖時間」去做你想做的事，或發展第二專長。
Spend time to be alone, scared time for.taiwanese: 留出孤單一人的時段。無論工課抑是私底下，攏愛確保有一段無人抐擾的「神聖時間」，去做你愛做的事，抑是練就第二專長。

What if you got fired, how soon you can.english: Ask yourself: "If I were laid off today, how quickly could I secure another job?" Ensure your achievements are documented and portable. Do you have a safety margin? How long can your assets support you, and what resources can you tap into?

What if you got fired, how soon you can.taiwanese: 居安思危問家己：「若是今仔日予人開除，我敢有法度隨揣著下份工課？」平常時著愛共戰績成就留底備份。你的生活安全邊際敢有夠？手頭的本錢敢有法度予你頂得過？你閣有啥物人脈佮資源會使調動？

Spend time on other field / your favorit.english: Dedicate time to fields outside of work and hobbies to relieve stress (using the SPIRE wellness framework), and strive to achieve solid, measurable results.
Spend time on other field / your favorit.mandarin: 將時間投在工作以外的興趣領域以排解壓力（參考 SPIRE 身心靈平衡指標），並努力取得具體、有成就感的結果。
Spend time on other field / your favorit.taiwanese: 將時間投資佇工課以外的嗜好天地來消解壓力（參考 SPIRE 身心靈平衡指標），兼煞猛拼出具體、有歡喜成就感的成績。

Increase the mobility. Use cellphone to.english: Increase your work mobility. Master cloud tools and mobile access to retrieve key information instantly from anywhere.
Increase the mobility. Use cellphone to.mandarin: 提升行動力。善用雲端工具與行動裝置，確保在任何地方都能迅速獲取所需資訊。

Don’t tell your boss whom you don’t like.english: Never tell your manager about colleagues you dislike; managers will intuitively sense the negativity, which reflects poorly on you.

You can speak frankly, in only your posi.english: You can speak frankly, but ensure your statements are framed strictly within the scope and perspective of your current position.
You can speak frankly, in only your posi.mandarin: 你可以直言不諱，但務必確保發言立場嚴格限定在你自己崗位的職責與視角範圍內。

Learn the way manager talks.english: Observe and emulate the communication style, tone, and strategic phrasing used by experienced managers.

How many leaves and floating leaves / ye.english: Keep track of your annual leave and floating holidays, and plan your time-off schedule early in the year.

Find your battle.english: Identify where your true passions and competitive advantages lie; choose your battles carefully. (Related to Item 424)

Find your battle.taiwanese: 揣出真正屬於你的主戰場，佇家己上內行、占贏面的所在集中氣力拚突破。

Plot template, table template, automatio.mandarin: 整理並建立常用的圖表與表格範本，以實現數據視覺化與報告撰寫的自動化。

What is the skill to be needed?.english: Identify what skills will be required to develop or support the next generation of products.

What is the skill to be needed?.taiwanese: 眼睛放遠思考：為著迎接後一代的新產品佮技術變化，家己到底需要提前款好啥物功夫？

BUILD UP CREDIT and relationship.english: Actively build up your professional credit (reliability) and foster strong, long-term relationships across teams.
BUILD UP CREDIT and relationship.mandarin: 用心經營你在職場的信譽（信用度、靠譜度），並建立跨部門的深厚信任關係。
BUILD UP CREDIT and relationship.taiwanese: 用心經營你佇職場的信譽（信用度、靠譜度），並建立跨部門的深厚信任關係。

Don’t sent the results out before releas.english: Never distribute raw data or preliminary results to wider stakeholders before they are officially reviewed and released.
Don’t sent the results out before releas.mandarin: 在數據未經最終確認與正式審批發佈前，絕不私自發送給外部或跨團隊利害關係人。
Don’t sent the results out before releas.taiwanese: 數字資料在猶未正式複驗、審批核准發布進前，萬萬袂使私自偷送予外口抑是別組人馬。

Skip the work/email what suddenly throw.english: Avoid getting distracted by sudden, non-urgent tasks or emails thrown at you. Prioritize and complete your planned work first.
Skip the work/email what suddenly throw.mandarin: 對於突然砸過來、非緊急的突發工作或信件，先予以擱置。專心先完成你既定的核心任務。
Skip the work/email what suddenly throw.taiwanese: 面對突然掞過來、無要無緊的插隊工課抑批信，先共擲一邊。專心先做好家己排好的核心代誌。

Don’t stop your colleague learning by th.english: Do not rob colleagues of their learning opportunities; avoid over-assisting them so they can learn to solve problems independently.
Don’t stop your colleague learning by th.mandarin: 不要剝奪同事的學習機會。適度給予空間，不要過度熱情幫忙，讓他們學會獨立解決問題。
Don’t stop your colleague learning by th.taiwanese: 莫搶走同事學習的機會。愛予伊淡薄仔空間，莫傷熱心共人鬥做，予個學會家己解決問題。

Can you gain new things from this assign.english: Can you gain new insights from this assignment? Always seek to re-invent yourself and build multiple professional identities to adapt to future market demands (inspired by Yuval Noah Harari). Acquire new knowledge, embrace changes, and formulate fresh thoughts. Be a writer, a runner, or adopt a new identity.
Can you gain new things from this assign.mandarin: 你能從這次的任務中學到新東西嗎？永遠尋求自我重塑，並建立多元身分以適應未來的市場需求（借鑒哈拉瑞思維）。學習新知識、擁抱改變並激發新思維。去成為作家、跑者，或是探索其他全新身分。
Can you gain new things from this assign.taiwanese: 這擺的任務你敢有學著新物件？永遠愛想辦法共家己重新塑造，建立濟濟款的身份，綴會著未來市場的需要（參考哈拉瑞的思維）。學新知識、歡喜接受改變，激發新的想法。去做作家、做跑者，抑是去探索別款全新的身份。

“Father, give us courage to change what.english: “Father, give us courage to change what must be altered, serenity to accept what cannot be helped, and the insight to know the one from the other.” (Related to Item 10, Stoicism)
“Father, give us courage to change what.mandarin: 「主啊，賜給我勇氣去改變應該改變的事，請賜給我寧靜去接受不可改變的事，並賜給我智慧去分辨兩者的區別。」（借鑒斯多葛主義，對照第10條）
“Father, give us courage to change what.taiwanese: 「主啊，求你賜我勇氣去改變應該改變的代誌，賜我平靜去接受袂當改變的代誌，閣賜我智慧去分別這兩項的無仝。」（參考斯多葛主義，對照第10條）

Always do reverse thinking. If you don’t.english: Always practice reverse thinking: What will happen if you don't do this? Re-examine assumptions and anti-facts. Assess the cost, effort, and impact. Do less but achieve more. Save your bandwidth for the most critical priorities. (Related to Item 122)
Always do reverse thinking. If you don’t.mandarin: 永遠保持逆向思考：如果不做這件事，會發生什麼？重新審視與事實相反的情境、成本影響與所需精力。少做一點但要更有效率，把精力保留給最重要的核心任務。（對照第122條）
Always do reverse thinking. If you don’t.taiwanese: 定定愛反向思考：假使無做這件事，會按怎？重新審查成本的影響佮付出的氣力。代誌做少一寡但愛有效益，共心力留予尚要緊的任務。（對照第122條）

Try to get some training lesson if your.english: Take advantage of free training lessons offered by your company, even if you are required to act as a seed trainer later. This will boost your visibility with tangible achievements. Use platforms like Workday to train in areas you are unfamiliar with.
Try to get some training lesson if your.mandarin: 積極爭取公司提供的免費培訓課程，即使日後需要擔任種子講師也值得。這能用具體成果提升你的曝光度。利用 Workday 等平台學習你還不熟悉的領域。
Try to get some training lesson if your.taiwanese: 公司提供的免費培訓課程愛積極去爭取，就算後來愛做種子講師嘛值得。按呢會當用具體的成果予你較有曝光。用 Workday 這款平台，去學你猶無熟的領域。

Don’t try to be smarter than your boss..english: Never try to appear smarter than your manager. Sometimes it is wiser to play dumb, keep silent, and maintain a low profile. Do not brag even when you achieve your goals.
Don’t try to be smarter than your boss..mandarin: 切忌在主管面前表現得比他聰明。有時「大智若愚」是生存之道，保持沉默與低調，即使達成了目標也無須張揚。
Don’t try to be smarter than your boss..taiwanese: 千萬莫佇主管面前展甲比伊較巧。有時「大智若愚」才是生存之道，惦惦、低調，就算目標達成矣嘛免四界展風神。

Try to introduce yourself with 3, 10 min.english: Practice introducing yourself in 3, 10, or 30 minutes, tailored for professional, private, or round-table settings. Be ready to cover your experience, industry tenure, personal achievements (e.g., marathons, writing historical/political novels), and current projects (product types, use cases, applications, testing methods, challenges).
Try to introduce yourself with 3, 10 min.mandarin: 準備好 3 分鐘、10 分鐘及 30 分鐘的自我介紹，適用於職場、私人聚會或圓桌會議。內容應涵蓋工作經歷、產業資歷、個人興趣（如馬拉松、撰寫歷史與政治小說）以及當前專案（產品類型、用途、應用、測試方法與面臨的問題等）。
Try to introduce yourself with 3, 10 min.taiwanese: 愛準備好 3 分鐘、10 分鐘佮 30 分鐘的自我介紹，佇職場、私人聚會抑是圓桌會議攏用會著。內容愛包括工作經歷、產業資歷、個人興趣（親像走馬拉松、寫歷史佮政治小說），閣有目前的專案（產品類型、用途、應用、測試方法佮拄著的問題等等）。

Learn to do a long-term project. Item 12.english: Learn to manage long-term projects with patience, treating them with the same care as planning for your retirement (e.g., in terms of investing and continuous learning). (Related to Item 124)
Learn to do a long-term project. Item 12.mandarin: 學習操作長期專案，保持耐心，就像規劃自己的退休生活一樣（投資、持續學習等）。（對照第124條）
Learn to do a long-term project. Item 12.taiwanese: 愛學會操作長期的專案，有耐性，就親像咧規劃家己的退休生活仝款（投資、繼續學習等等）。（對照第124條）

Root cause vs proximate cause, root caus.english: Distinguish between root causes and proximate causes. Develop strong root cause analysis and problem-solving skills, leveraging tools like BCG thinking and the Six Thinking Hats.
Root cause vs proximate cause, root caus.mandarin: 釐清「根本原因」與「表面原因」的區別。培養根本原因分析技能與問題解決能力（運用 BCG 思維與六頂思考帽）。
Root cause vs proximate cause, root caus.taiwanese: 分清楚「根本原因」同「表面原因」的無仝。訓練根本原因分析的能力佮解決問題的技巧（用 BCG 思維、六頂思考帽）。

Although busy, there is a cycle, like ma.english: Though busy, recognize that everything runs in cycles, much like the market. You won't fail forever. Any setback, as long as you can get back up, serves as valuable fuel for the future. Failures happen; let go of your ego.
Although busy, there is a cycle, like ma.mandarin: 即使忙碌，也要明白世事如市場般皆有週期循環，你不會一直失敗。任何打擊只要你還站得起來，都是未來的養分。失敗是常態，放下自尊心。
Although busy, there is a cycle, like ma.taiwanese: 就算真無閒，嘛愛知影世間代誌就親像市場仝款有起有落，你袂一直失敗。毋管啥物拍擊，只要你閣徛會起來，攏是未來的養分。失敗是四常，共面子放落。

Can you / how can you restart when fail?.english: Evaluate if and how you can restart after a failure. Know your survival margin (e.g., if you got fired or lost in the mountains). Could you find a job in a completely different domain? Identify what new hard or soft skills you need to acquire.
Can you / how can you restart when fail?.mandarin: 思考當失敗發生時，你能否以及如何重頭開始？評估你的生存極限（例如：被解雇或在深山迷路時能支撐多久）。你能到不同領域找到新工作嗎？你需要為未來學習哪些新的硬技能與軟實力？
Can you / how can you restart when fail?.taiwanese: 想看覓若是跋倒失敗，你敢有法度重頭閣起？評估你的生存極限（比方講予人裁員抑是在深山迷路）。你敢有法度跨到無仝領域揣工課？你閣需要為未來學啥物新的軟硬實力？

Make sure your energy is full? Sleep eno.english: Ensure your energy is fully charged: sleep at least 6 hours, eat nutritious foods, and build mental resilience. Take a nap after lunch. It is critical to listen to your body and admit when you are tired.
Make sure your energy is full? Sleep eno.mandarin: 確保自己能量充沛：每天睡眠至少 6 小時以上、攝取營養飲食、鍛鍊強健的心智。午餐後至少小憩片刻。學會自我察覺並承認自己累了，這非常重要。補充足夠營養。
Make sure your energy is full? Sleep eno.taiwanese: 愛顧予家己精神飽足：逐工上少睏 6 點鐘以上、食有營養、共心智練予勇。食晝了後上少愛小歇睏一下。學會察覺家己、承認家己忝矣，這足要緊。營養愛補予夠。

Learn to encourage yourself, treat yours.english: Learn to encourage yourself and treat yourself well. Understand the mechanics of your body and mind. (Related to Item 75)
Learn to encourage yourself, treat yours.mandarin: 學會自我鼓勵、善待自己。深入理解自己的身心運作機制。（對照第75條）
Learn to encourage yourself, treat yours.taiwanese: 愛學會家己共家己鼓勵、好好仔對待家己。愛深入了解家己的身體佮心理是按怎咧運作。（對照第75條）

Make your habit and behavior consistent.english: Align your habits and behaviors between life and work. Keep your personal and professional calendars synchronized and integrated.
Make your habit and behavior consistent.mandarin: 讓生活與工作上的習慣和行為保持一致。落實行事曆的整合與對齊。
Make your habit and behavior consistent.taiwanese: 予生活佮工課的習慣佮行為保持一致。行事曆愛整合、對齊。

“Most Respectful Interpretation” (MRI) i.english: "Most Respectful Interpretation" (MRI) is a powerful approach where you assume the best of others. It suggests interpreting every communication in the kindest and most helpful way, and responding only to that positive version. Alternatively, ask clarifying questions politely and curiously to understand their true intent.
“Most Respectful Interpretation” (MRI) i.mandarin: 「最善意詮釋」（MRI）是個絕佳的溝通法門，意即凡事先假設他人是出於好意。MRI 建議你在面對任何溝通時，只採用最正面、最溫和、最有建設性的解讀方式，並以此做出回應。或者，帶著好奇與禮貌多問問題，以理解對方的真實意圖。
“Most Respectful Interpretation” (MRI) i.taiwanese: 「最善意詮釋」（MRI）是一个足好的溝通法門，意思是凡事先假設對方是出於好意。MRI 建議你毋管拄著啥物溝通，攏用上正面、上溫和、上有建設性的方式去解讀，才按呢來回應。抑是，用好奇佮有禮貌的態度加問寡問題，去了解對方真正的意思。

Prepare lists of songs, movies and passa.english: Prepare lists of comforting songs, movies, passages, and books to help you navigate through tough times. (Related to Item 46)
Prepare lists of songs, movies and passa.mandarin: 平時準備好能撫慰心靈的歌單、電影、句子或書單，作為度過艱難時刻的心理補給。（對照第46條）
Prepare lists of songs, movies and passa.taiwanese: 平常時就愛準備好會當安慰心靈的歌單、電影、句子抑是冊單，做度過艱難時陣的心理補給。（對照第46條）

Done is better than perfect. For some, m.english: Done is better than perfect. However, for certain low-value tasks, choosing not to start them at all might be the best decision.
Done is better than perfect. For some, m.mandarin: 完成勝過完美。但對於某些低價值的事，選擇根本不開始或許才是更好的決定。
Done is better than perfect. For some, m.taiwanese: 做好贏過完美。但對一寡低價值的代誌，選擇根本毋通開始，可能才是卡好的決定。

Dress, speak and behave decently. Item 1.english: Maintain decent dress, speech, and behavior (Related to Item 104). Every year, introduce small changes and step out of your routine: e.g., read books on unfamiliar topics, run at different speeds or routes, or talk to people outside your usual circle.
Dress, speak and behave decently. Item 1.mandarin: 言談、穿著與舉止要得體（對照第104條）。每年主動做些改變，嘗試不同事物：例如閱讀全新領域的書籍、嘗試不同的跑步速度與路線、與不熟或不認識的人交談等。
Dress, speak and behave decently. Item 1.taiwanese: 講話、穿著佮舉止愛得體（對照第104條）。每年主動做一寡改變，試看覓無仝的代誌：親像讀無熟手領域的書、試無仝的慢跑速度佮路線、佮不認識的人開講等。

Your weak teammate will help you learn m.english: Collaborating with a weaker teammate will force you to take more ownership, help you learn more, and accelerate your path to becoming an expert.
Your weak teammate will help you learn m.mandarin: 實力較弱的隊友會迫使你承擔更多責任，進而幫助你學習更多，加速成為專家。
Your weak teammate will help you learn m.taiwanese: 實力卡弱的隊友會強迫你擔更多責任，進而幫助你學更多，加速成做專家。

Buy your collogues a drink or coffee. To.english: Treat your colleagues to a drink or coffee occasionally to show appreciation. Express your gratitude sincerely.
Buy your collogues a drink or coffee. To.mandarin: 偶爾請同事喝杯飲料或咖啡，展現你的關心。隨時將「謝謝」掛在嘴邊。
Buy your collogues a drink or coffee. To.taiwanese: 定定請同事啉杯茶抑是咖啡，展現你的關心。隨時將多謝講出喙。

No coffee after 11:00 AM, 3 cups top per.english: Avoid caffeine after 11:00 AM, and limit your daily coffee intake to a maximum of 3 cups.
No coffee after 11:00 AM, 3 cups top per.mandarin: 早上 11 點後不再喝咖啡，每天最多以 3 杯為限，避免影響睡眠品質。
No coffee after 11:00 AM, 3 cups top per.taiwanese: 早上十一點後無喝咖啡，逐天最多三杯，避免影響睡眠品質。

Is there any better choices for this sit.english: Ask yourself: Are there better choices in this situation? Write them down, review your principles, rules, and notes, and engage in anti-fact thinking.
Is there any better choices for this sit.mandarin: 自我提問：面對這種情況，是否有更好的選擇？寫下來，檢視你的原則、規則與筆記，進行反事實思考（Anti-fact thinking）。
Is there any better choices for this sit.taiwanese: 問家己：拄著這款情形，敢有較好的選擇？寫落來，檢視你的原則、規則佮筆記，做反事實思考（Anti-fact thinking）。

Check what kind of skills or tools or kn.english: Identify what skills, tools, or knowledge will be in demand in the coming years (Related to Item 12). List potential learning tasks and milestones for next year.
Check what kind of skills or tools or kn.mandarin: 評估未來幾年需要哪些新技能、工具或知識（對照第12條）。列出明年需要開展的潛在任務與學習清單。
Check what kind of skills or tools or kn.taiwanese: 評估未來幾年需要啥物新技能、工具抑是知識（對照第12條）。列出明年愛做的工作目標與學習清單。

Do not talk privacy or complain in socia.english: Do not share private matters or vent complaints on social media (e.g., Facebook). Stay away from gossipy people and steer clear of office politics.
Do not talk privacy or complain in socia.mandarin: 切勿在社群媒體（如臉書）上公開私生活或抱怨工作。遠離喜歡散布謠言的人，避開辦公室政治的漩渦。
Do not talk privacy or complain in socia.taiwanese: 千萬莫佇社群媒體（親像臉冊）公開私生活抑是怨嘆工課。愛散布風聲的人愛閃予遠，辦公室政治的捲螺仔風莫去插。

First time right, zero defect and be per.english: Strict slogans like 'first time right', 'zero defect', or 'perfection' should never block us from moving forward. Getting started is always the hardest part; focus on progress over perfection.
First time right, zero defect and be per.mandarin: 「一次到位」、「零缺失」或「追求完美」不應成為阻礙我們前進的枷鎖。萬事起頭難，先動起來再持續修正。
First time right, zero defect and be per.taiwanese: 「一擺到位」、「零缺失」抑是「追求完美」，毋通變做縛跤縛手、予咱袂當向前的枷。萬事起頭難，先振動，才沿路修正。

When you open your mouth and don't think.english: Do not speak without thinking. If you don't know how your words will be received, keep silent. Avoid being clueless (tactless); always choose your audience and words carefully.
When you open your mouth and don't think.mandarin: 不要說話不經大腦。如果不知道話說出口會造成什麼後果，就先保持沉默。切忌白目（缺乏眼色），與任何人對話都要謹慎。
When you open your mouth and don't think.taiwanese: 講話莫無經頭殼。若毋知話講出喙會有啥物後果，就先恬恬。千萬莫白目（無目色），佮啥人講話攏愛謹慎。

Principles and order in life make you su.english: Principles and order in life build the foundation for success. Establish your rules and stay the course consistently.
Principles and order in life make you su.mandarin: 生活中的原則與秩序是成功的基石。建立你的生活常規，並堅定不移地貫徹下去。
Principles and order in life make you su.taiwanese: 生活中的原則佮秩序是成功的基礎。建立你的生活規律，堅定照咧行，莫半途而廢。

Get into office earlier. This may impres.english: Arriving at the office earlier helps build good working habits and projects a positive attitude. Typically, senior executives arrive early; aligning with this routine can leave a strong impression.
Get into office earlier. This may impres.mandarin: 提早一點到辦公室。這有助於培養良好的工作習慣與積極態度，同時給人留下深刻印象。通常，高階主管都習慣提早到班。
Get into office earlier. This may impres.taiwanese: 較早淡薄仔到辦公室。按呢會當養成好的工作習慣佮積極的態度，嘛會予人留落深刻的印象。一般來講，大主管攏慣勢較早來上班。

Practice some old (hard or soft) skills.english: Continuously practice and refine your existing hard and soft skills. Try to teach others to consolidate your own understanding, adopting an expert mindset to master your craft.
Practice some old (hard or soft) skills.mandarin: 複習並熟練已掌握的硬技能與軟實力。嘗試透過教導他人來深化自我理解，以專家思維引領自己成為大師。
Practice some old (hard or soft) skills.taiwanese: 已經學會的硬技術佮軟實力愛溫習、練予熟。試用教別人的方式來加深家己的理解，用專家的思維引導家己變做大師。

Don’t be shy to ask feedback to whom wor.english: Do not hesitate to request feedback from past colleagues, collaborators, or managers. Honest feedback is a resource you deserve for your professional growth.
Don’t be shy to ask feedback to whom wor.mandarin: 勇於向過去共事過的同事或主管尋求反饋。這是你理所應得的成長資源，無須感到不好意思。
Don’t be shy to ask feedback to whom wor.taiwanese: 愛勇敢去問以早做伙做過代誌的同事抑是主管討回饋。這是你應該得著的成長資源，免歹勢。

Once you get bored at work, find interes.english: When work feels boring, search for new meanings or interesting challenges within the project or your personal life. Reflect on past achievements. Documenting your daily insights helps you recall progress and brainstorm ways to speed up, automate, or mitigate risks.
Once you get bored at work, find interes.mandarin: 一旦對工作感到厭倦，主動從中尋找新樂趣與意義，不論是來自專案還是個人生活。回顧已完成的成就，並記錄當下的感受以利日後檢視。思考如何把事情做得更好、更快、更自動化，並預防潛在風險。
Once you get bored at work, find interes.taiwanese: 若是對工課感覺厭𤺪，就主動對內底揣新的趣味佮意義，毋管是對專案抑是個人生活。回頭看已經完成的成就，共這馬的感受記落來，以後好檢視。想看欲按怎共代誌做了閣較好、較緊、較自動，閣共可能的風險先防起來。

Don't see trifles as evil. Sometimes thi.english: Do not treat tedious daily chores as evils; they are often unavoidable in any job. Adopt a task-oriented mindset, automate them whenever possible, and aim to execute them 10x faster.
Don't see trifles as evil. Sometimes thi.mandarin: 不要將繁瑣雜務視為洪水猛獸，這是職場中不可避免的一部分。保持任務導向思維，嘗試將其自動化，以提升十倍速為目標快速解決它們。
Don't see trifles as evil. Sometimes thi.taiwanese: 莫共瑣瑣碎碎的雜事看做洪水猛獸，這是職場內底閃袂過的一部份。愛用任務導向的思維，試共伊自動化，以十倍速做目標，緊緊共處理掉。

Train your body physically or mentally o.english: Train your body, mind, and spirit continuously. You may live and work longer than you anticipate. Invest in retirement planning and acquire a viable second skill.
Train your body physically or mentally o.mandarin: 持續鍛鍊自己的身體、心理與精神。你的壽命可能比想像中更長，提早規劃退休生活，並培養第二專長技能。
Train your body physically or mentally o.taiwanese: 身體、心理佮精神攏愛不時鍛鍊。你的壽命可能比想的閣較長，愛提早規劃退休生活，培養第二專長。

Keep silence and mouth shut when hearing.english: Keep silent and avoid spreading rumors. Speak out confidently only when demonstrating your professional expertise. Remain humble, and avoid criticizing others. (Related to Items 162 and 190)
Keep silence and mouth shut when hearing.mandarin: 聽到八卦謠言時請保持沉默，閉緊嘴巴。唯有在需要展現專業能力時才高調表態。保持謙遜，切勿批評他人。（對照第162、190條）
Keep silence and mouth shut when hearing.taiwanese: 聽著閒話謠言的時恬恬就好。只有佇展示專業能力的時陣才高調發言。維持謙虛，毋通去批評別人。（對照第162、190條）

Take a deep breath when you feel pressur.english: When feeling stressed or frustrated (ak-chak), take a deep breath or step out for a walk. Use the breathing technique: inhale for 4 seconds and exhale for 8 seconds. (Related to Item 174)
Take a deep breath when you feel pressur.mandarin: 當感到壓力沉重或心情煩悶（台語：鬱卒 ak-chak）時，深呼吸或去散散步。吸氣 4 秒，呼氣 8 秒以調節狀態。（對照第174條）
Take a deep breath when you feel pressur.taiwanese: 感覺壓力重、心肝頭鬱卒的時陣，吸一下大氣抑是出去行行咧。吸氣 4 秒，吐氣 8 秒，共狀態調轉來。（對照第174條）

Ask how are they if they feel uncomforta.english: Show empathy by asking how colleagues are doing when they feel unwell or sick. Offer support and stand by them when they need it.
Ask how are they if they feel uncomforta.mandarin: 當同事身體不適或生病時，主動關心慰問。在他們需要支持時給予陪伴與協助，建立溫暖的職場連結。
Ask how are they if they feel uncomforta.taiwanese: 同事身體無爽快抑是破病的時陣，愛主動關心、問候。個需要支持的時陣，陪伴、鬥相共，建立溫暖的職場人情。

Using soft voice to explain question is.english: Explaining complex issues in a soft, steady, and calm voice is a true hallmark of expertise. (Related to Items 2 and 138)
Using soft voice to explain question is.mandarin: 能用溫和且堅定的聲音向他人說明複雜問題，才是真正展現專家風範的表現。（對照第2、138條）
Using soft voice to explain question is.taiwanese: 會當用溫和閣堅定的聲音共人講清楚複雜的問題，才是真正有專家的氣度。（對照第2、138條）

Enjoy your work or make sure you get pay.english: Either find joy and fulfillment in your work, or at least ensure you are compensated fairly for your time.
Enjoy your work or make sure you get pay.mandarin: 要嘛盡情享受你的工作並從中尋找價值，要嘛確保你付出的時間得到了合理飽滿的報酬。
Enjoy your work or make sure you get pay.taiwanese: 若毋是盡量享受你的工課、對內底揣著價值，就是愛確定你出的時間有得著合理、飽滇的報酬。

Try mediation, sport, sleep, stretch. It.english: Manage stress through meditation, sports, sleep, and stretching (Related to Item 66). Take deep breaths using the 4-7-8 method (inhale 4s, hold 7s, exhale 8s) or practice Tabata exercises. (Related to Item 178)
Try mediation, sport, sleep, stretch. It.mandarin: 藉由冥想、運動、充足睡眠與拉伸舒緩壓力（對照第66條）。練習深呼吸（4-7-8 呼吸法：吸氣 4 秒、屏息 7 秒、呼氣 8 秒）或進行 Tabata 間歇訓練。（對照第178條）
Try mediation, sport, sleep, stretch. It.taiwanese: 用冥想、運動、睏予飽佮伸跤伸手來放鬆壓力（對照第66條）。練習吸大氣（4-7-8 呼吸法：吸氣 4 秒、擋氣 7 秒、吐氣 8 秒），抑是做 Tabata 間歇訓練。（對照第178條）

Use alternative statement, different col.english: Be mindful of cultural differences in communications; colors carry different meanings across cultures. For example, avoid using red in slides, as Western colleagues may associate it with errors, warnings, or bad performance.
Use alternative statement, different col.mandarin: 注意跨文化溝通的差異。不同顏色在不同文化中代表的含義不同（如紅色）。簡報中避免濫用紅色，因為西方同事通常會將其視為警示、錯誤或負面表現的象徵。
Use alternative statement, different col.taiwanese: 愛注意跨文化溝通的差別。仝一款色水佇無仝的文化代表的意思無仝（親像紅色）。簡報內底莫烏白用紅色，因為西方的同事通常會共看做警告、錯誤抑是負面表現的象徵。

Speak out your wishes. So, people know y.english: Express your goals and career desires clearly so that others know how to support or help you. Do not hesitate to call for help when needed. (Related to Items 185)
Speak out your wishes. So, people know y.mandarin: 勇敢表達你的期望與訴求。這樣別人才知道如何支持與協助你，在需要時大方尋求支援。（對照第185條）
Speak out your wishes. So, people know y.taiwanese: 你的期望佮要求愛勇敢講出來。按呢別人才知欲按怎支持你、共你鬥相共，需要的時陣就大大方方請人支援。（對照第185條）

Write down meeting minutes and who atten.english: Document meeting minutes and compile the attendee list, especially when seeking official approvals. Specify deadlines for replies to establish a paper trail and protect yourself.
Write down meeting minutes and who atten.mandarin: 養成撰寫會議記錄並註明與會者的習慣，特別是涉及決策與審查時。註明各窗口回覆的截止日期，以求留下憑據、自我保護。
Write down meeting minutes and who atten.taiwanese: 愛養成寫會議記錄、閣註明參加者的習慣，尤其是牽涉著決策佮審查的時陣。逐个窗口回覆的期限嘛愛註明，留落憑據、保護家己。

Recite a joke then you may use it in one.english: Keep a few jokes in mind to use as icebreakers when the occasion arises. However, ensure they are appropriate and will not be misunderstood.
Recite a joke then you may use it in one.mandarin: 平時記住一兩個笑話，以備在需要破冰的場合使用。但必須確保笑話大方得體，避免引發誤會或尷尬。
Recite a joke then you may use it in one.taiwanese: 平常時記一兩个笑詼，需要破冰的場合就用會著。毋過笑詼一定愛大方得體，莫引起誤會抑是予人歹勢。

Use English to say your culture, history.english: Practice describing your culture, history, weather, population, and geography in English. Find reference articles to memorize or practice summarizing your daily feelings in English. Prepare templates for topics like religion, food culture, and geographic location.
Use English to say your culture, history.mandarin: 練習用英文介紹自己的文化、歷史、氣候、人口與地理環境。可以找範文來背誦，或用英文記錄每日心情。平時針對宗教、飲食文化、地理位置等主題準備好對話範本。
Use English to say your culture, history.taiwanese: 練習用英文介紹家己的文化、歷史、氣候、人口佮地理環境。會使揣範文來背，抑是用英文寫逐工的心情。平常時對宗教、飲食文化、地理位置這寡主題，就先準備好對話的範本。

Understand your glass ceiling. What else.english: Understand your career's glass ceiling. Identify what skills you need to acquire to break through. Recognize that salary ranks, raises, and bonuses are bound to your KPI and base salary, and each rank has its ceiling. Focus on expanding your circle of competence. (Related to Item 119)
Understand your glass ceiling. What else.mandarin: 看清你的職涯玻璃天花板。思考需要突破哪些技能？認識到薪資職等、調薪與獎金均綁定於你的 KPI 與底薪，且每個職等都有其上限。專注於擴展你的能力圈。（對照第119條）
Understand your glass ceiling. What else.taiwanese: 看予清楚家己職涯的玻璃天篷。想看覓愛突破佗一寡本事？愛知影薪水職等、調薪佮獎金攏綁佇你的 KPI 佮底薪，逐个職等嘛攏有伊的頂限。專心共家己的能力圈拍予闊。（對照第119條）

Speak out what can you offer or contribu.english: Clearly communicate what value you can offer or contribute, especially when seeking a promotion. Be proactive, ambitious, and bold about your goals. Stand at the forefront and showcase your worth.
Speak out what can you offer or contribu.mandarin: 明確表達你能提供什麼價值與貢獻（特別是爭取升遷時）。對自己想要的目標保持主動與野心，站上第一線，展現膽識。
Speak out what can you offer or contribu.taiwanese: 你會當提供啥物價值、有啥物貢獻，愛講予明（尤其是咧爭取升級的時陣）。對家己想欲的目標愛主動、有企圖心，徛佇頭前線，展出你的膽頭。

Promote yourself in public or in private.english: Promote yourself in both public and private settings (Related to Item 214). However, balance it with humility. Back up your claims with solid evidence and express them clearly.
Promote yourself in public or in private.mandarin: 在公開與私下場合都要適度宣傳自己（對照第214條）。但要拿捏分寸、保持謙遜。用堅實的數據與成果做後盾，大方說出來。
Promote yourself in public or in private.taiwanese: 公開的場合抑是私底下，攏愛適度替家己展風神（對照第214條）。毋過愛知分寸、保持謙卑。用有影的數字佮成果做後壁山，大大方方講出來。

Understand different time zone for diffe.english: Be mindful of different time zones for global offices. Always verify and account for them when scheduling meetings.
Understand different time zone for diffe.mandarin: 理解全球各據點的時區差異。在安排或發起跨國會議時，務必提前確認並對齊時間。
Understand different time zone for diffe.taiwanese: 愛知影世界各所在辦公室的時差。欲排抑是發起跨國會議的時陣，一定愛先確認、共時間對予齊。

Don't reply so quickly after receiving a.english: Avoid replying to emails too quickly. Write your response, but schedule it to send later to manage expectations and allow time for reflection.
Don't reply so quickly after receiving a.mandarin: 收到郵件時不要立刻回覆。你可以先寫好回信，但利用延遲發送功能設定在稍後寄出，保留緩衝空間。
Don't reply so quickly after receiving a.taiwanese: 收著批（電子郵件）莫隨回。會使先共回批寫好，毋過用延遲寄出的功能，設較慢才寄，共家己留一屑仔轉踅的空間。

Build up your skillset. Do not only take.english: Continuously build your skillset. Do not limit yourself strictly to assigned duties; step outside your comfort zone to understand broader responsibility and accountability.
Build up your skillset. Do not only take.mandarin: 持續豐富你的技能樹。不要只拘泥於本分，適度跨出職責邊界，釐清「職責」（Responsibility）與「終極責任」（Accountability）的差別。
Build up your skillset. Do not only take.taiwanese: 愛不時共家己的技能樹添枝發葉。莫干焦顧本分的頭路，適度踏出職責的界線，分予清「職責」（Responsibility）佮「終極責任」（Accountability）無仝的所在。

To avoid a PR (public relation) crisis公關.english: To avoid public relations crises in the office, never speak or write about things you don't know with 100% confidence. Keep in mind that emails and messages can be easily forwarded, which might mislead others or drag unintended stakeholders into issues.
To avoid a PR (public relation) crisis公關.mandarin: 為避免公關危機，切勿在沒有百分之百把握的情況下議論你不清楚的事。即使你有把握，也要防範他人轉發你的郵件或對話紀錄，這可能會誤導他人或將無關的人捲入糾紛。
To avoid a PR (public relation) crisis公關.taiwanese: 為著避免公關風波，無百分之百把握的代誌，千萬莫烏白講。就算你有把握，嘛愛防人共你的批抑對話紀錄轉出去，按呢可能會誤導別人，抑是共無相干的人牽落去紛爭內底。

Be careful what you replied email, other.english: Exercise caution in your email replies, as they can be forwarded to others. Be equally mindful of what webpages you display when sharing your screen during video calls, as well as your verbal remarks.
Be careful what you replied email, other.mandarin: 寫郵件回信時要非常謹慎，因為內容隨時可能被轉寄。此外，在視訊會議分享螢幕時，要注意已打開的網頁與檔案，口頭發言也要謹慎防範失言。
Be careful what you replied email, other.taiwanese: 回批的時陣愛真細膩，因為內容隨時可能予人轉寄。閣再，視訊會議分享螢幕的時，愛注意已經拍開的網頁佮檔案，喙講的話嘛愛謹慎，莫講毋著話。

Sometimes showing weakness is the best p.english: Sometimes, showing vulnerability or admitting a limitation is the best policy to obtain help or support. Keep a low profile, subdue your ego, and focus strictly on outputs and continuous improvement.
Sometimes showing weakness is the best p.mandarin: 有時適度示弱是尋求資源與支援的最佳策略。保持低調、放下自尊心，將精力專注於實際產出與持續改善。
Sometimes showing weakness is the best p.taiwanese: 有時陣適度示弱，反倒是討資源、揣支援上好的步數。做人低調，共面子囥一邊，氣力囥佇實際的產出佮繼續改善。

You may learn pretending not heard or no.english: Learn the art of pretending not to hear or see certain things (playing dumb / Ke-siau) to avoid unnecessary workplace drama. Treat it like a performance.
You may learn pretending not heard or no.mandarin: 學會「裝聾作啞」的藝術（台語：假懵 Ke-siau2），避免捲入無謂的職場麻煩。有時職場就像一場表演，不需要戳破所有事。
You may learn pretending not heard or no.taiwanese: 學會「假毋知、假無聽著」的工夫（台語：假痟），免予無意義的職場麻煩牽著。有時職場就親像咧搬戲，毋免逐項攏共拆破。

PREP, point, reason, example, point meth.english: Use the PREP method (Point, Reason, Example, Point) to deliver clear, structured, and persuasive presentations.
PREP, point, reason, example, point meth.mandarin: 運用 PREP 結構（結論-原因-實例-重申結論）來組織發言與簡報，讓溝通高效有說服力。
PREP, point, reason, example, point meth.taiwanese: 用 PREP 結構（結論－原因－實例－閣講一擺結論）來排你的發言佮簡報，溝通才會有效率、有說服力。

What can you get / gain / feel from this.english: Reflect on what you gained or learned from a book, experience, or discussion. Ensure you are not just busy running in circles ('chasing your tail'). Ask: Am I accumulating professional relationships, assets, new skills, or increasing my competency? Track the time spent on these tasks.
What can you get / gain / feel from this.mandarin: 反思你能從這本書、這段經歷或這次討論中得到或感受到什麼？確保自己不是在原地打轉（追著尾巴跑的無效忙碌）。自問：我有藉此累積人脈、資產、新技能或提昇能力等級嗎？評估你在這些任務上花費的時間是否合乎比例。
What can you get / gain / feel from this.taiwanese: 想看覓你對這本冊、這段經歷抑是這擺討論，得著抑感受著啥物？莫佇原地踅玲瑯（若狗咧咬家己的尾溜，無路用的無閒）。問家己：我敢有趁這个機會累積人脈、資產、新本事，抑是提升能力等級？評估看你佇這寡工課頂懸開的時間敢合比例。

Don’t make unnecessary, involuntary (無意識.english: Avoid making careless, involuntary, and avoidable mistakes. Stay focused and operate within your circle of competence.
Don’t make unnecessary, involuntary (無意識.mandarin: 避免犯下無謂的、無意識的低級錯誤。保持專注，將行動限縮在自己的能力圈之內。
Don’t make unnecessary, involuntary (無意識.taiwanese: 莫犯無意義、無張持的低級錯誤。心肝愛定，做代誌限佇家己的能力圈內底。

Don’t no politic in the office and discu.english: Do not participate in office politics or engage in gossip with colleagues. (Related to Item 162)
Don’t no politic in the office and discu.mandarin: 絕不在辦公室裡議論政治，也不與同事議論公司八卦。（對照第162條）
Don’t no politic in the office and discu.taiwanese: 絕不在辦公室內底議論政治，嘛莫佮同事開八卦。（對照第162條）

Don’t jump to others’ arguments. Keep di.english: Do not get dragged into other people's arguments. Maintain a professional distance.
Don’t jump to others’ arguments. Keep di.mandarin: 不要隨意介入他人的爭執或辯論，保持中立與安全距離。
Don’t jump to others’ arguments. Keep di.taiwanese: 別人咧冤家抑是辯論，莫隨便插跤，保持中立，徛較遠咧較安全。

Don’t feel anxious when people have more.english: Do not feel anxious when others offer feedback or suggestions. Reframe it positively: they are resources helping you improve. Kill your ego and embrace feedback.
Don’t feel anxious when people have more.mandarin: 當他人提出較多意見或建議時，不要感到焦慮。轉念思考：這些意見能幫助你做得更好。放下自尊心，用正面思維擁抱回饋。
Don’t feel anxious when people have more.taiwanese: 別人提較濟意見抑建議的時陣，毋免煩惱。換一个想法：這寡意見會當幫你做甲閣較好。共面子放落，用正面的心情來接受回饋。

Any benefit or added value for the work.english: Ask yourself: What is the benefit or added value of the task you are currently performing? Identify what skillsets you need to acquire to enhance its value.
Any benefit or added value for the work.mandarin: 自問：你目前正在做的工作有什麼效益或附加價值？為此，你還需要補充哪些技能組合？
Any benefit or added value for the work.taiwanese: 問家己：你這馬咧做的工課，有啥物效益抑加值？為著這个，你閣愛補啥物技能？

Reduce the number of emails you send. To.english: Reduce the volume of emails you send to prevent unnecessary back-and-forth threads. Aim to send no more than 8 emails a day.
Reduce the number of emails you send. To.mandarin: 減少主動發信的數量，以避免招致無謂的郵件拉扯。設定目標：每天發信不超過 8 封。

Ask you questions if no one ask you. Bey.english: Ask yourself questions if no one else does. Challenge yourself to exceed expectations and achieve excellence. Review your progress and achievements at the end of each day or week, and maintain a clear career and financial roadmap.

Ask you questions if no one ask you. Bey.taiwanese: 若無人來共你問，就家己問家己。挑戰家己，做甲超過人的期待、追求上好。逐工抑逐禮拜收尾的時陣，共家己的成果佮表現點算一下，閣替個人的職涯佮財務規劃畫一張清楚的路線圖。

Don’t trust your memory but your notes,.english: Never rely on memory alone; trust only your notes, objective data, and verified facts. Develop a good digital note-taking system using consistent formatting rules.
Don’t trust your memory but your notes,.mandarin: 不要依賴大腦記憶，只信賴你的筆記、數據與事實。養成數位筆記的習慣，並建立良好的檔案命名與組織規範。
Don’t trust your memory but your notes,.taiwanese: 莫靠頭殼記，干焦信你的筆記、數據佮事實。養成數位筆記的習慣，閣共檔案的號名佮整理規矩建立好勢。

Focus on the agenda. Otherwise, It can l.english: Keep discussions strictly focused on the meeting agenda to prevent fragmented debates and avoid diverging from the main topic.
Focus on the agenda. Otherwise, It can l.mandarin: 開會時務必緊扣議程，避免話題發散導致討論碎片化與失焦。
Focus on the agenda. Otherwise, It can l.taiwanese: 開會的時陣一定愛綴牢議程，莫講甲四散去，討論才袂零零碎碎、拍無重點。

It is not your responsibility or obligat.english: It is not your duty or obligation to manage your colleagues' professional growth unless they explicitly ask for your help. Prioritize investing in yourself first.
It is not your responsibility or obligat.mandarin: 除非同事主動尋求協助，否則幫助同事成長並非你的職責或義務。先投資並照顧好自己。（對照第234條）
It is not your responsibility or obligat.taiwanese: 除非同事家己來討救兵，若無，幫同事成長毋是你的責任抑義務。先投資、顧好家己。（對照第234條）

Use one page / template to explain/propo.english: Use a one-page summary or a structured template to explain and pitch your ideas. This is especially helpful in preventing misunderstandings when communicating in a second language.
Use one page / template to explain/propo.mandarin: 嘗試用一頁紙或標準範本來呈現及提案你的想法。在以非母語溝通時，這能有效防止資訊失真與誤解。
Use one page / template to explain/propo.taiwanese: 試看覓用一頁紙抑標準範本來呈現、提案你的想法。用毋是母語咧溝通的時陣，按呢會使有效防止資訊走精佮誤會。

Always have eye contact when you talk to.english: Maintain eye contact when speaking to others. If uncomfortable looking directly at their eyes, focus on a specific point on their face (like the bridge of the nose).
Always have eye contact when you talk to.mandarin: 與人交談時保持眼神接觸。如果直視眼睛感到不自在，可以盯著對方臉上的某個點（如鼻樑）。
Always have eye contact when you talk to.taiwanese: 佮人講話的時，目睭愛看人。若是直接看人的目睭感覺礙虐，會使看對方面頂的某一點（親像鼻樑）。

Give your blessing for someone’s birthda.english: Send greetings for birthdays, the New Year, or major holidays. Keep a contact list and send a brief, thoughtful message to maintain professional relations.
Give your blessing for someone’s birthda.mandarin: 在同事生日、新年或重大節日送上祝福。平時可整理一份聯絡清單，發個簡單的訊息維繫職場人際溫度。
Give your blessing for someone’s birthda.taiwanese: 同事生日、過年抑大節日，送一句祝福。平常時會使整理一張聯絡清單，傳一个簡單的訊息，予職場人情保持燒烙。

You cannot check data efficiency without.english: Without standard templates, you cannot evaluate data efficiency systematically. Create your own or leverage existing ones to boost productivity.
You cannot check data efficiency without.mandarin: 缺乏標準範本，就無法系統性地檢視數據的處理效率。借鑑他人或自己設計範本，以提高生產力。
You cannot check data efficiency without.taiwanese: 若無標準範本，就無法度有系統來檢查數據處理的效率。參考別人的抑是家己設計範本，提懸生產力。

Run your templates to make sure you won’.english: Regularly run and test your templates to keep your workflows fresh. Ensure your skills and expertise remain up-to-date rather than rusting from disuse.
Run your templates to make sure you won’.mandarin: 定期運作與測試你的工作範本以維持熟練度。確認你的專業技能始終跟上最新狀態，避免因久未使用而生疏。
Run your templates to make sure you won’.taiwanese: 定定共你的工作範本提出來用、提出來試，保持手路熟。確定你的專業本事一直綴會著上新的狀態，免得久無用就生疏去。

Turn off laptop when leaving office and.english: Shut down your laptop and clean your physical desk when leaving the office. Treat this routine as a ritual for a fresh start next time. (Related to Item 268)
Turn off laptop when leaving office and.mandarin: 下班離開辦公室前，確實關閉電腦並清理乾淨桌面。用儀式感結束工作，以便下次有好的開始。（對照第268條）
Turn off laptop when leaving office and.taiwanese: 下班離開辦公室進前，電腦愛確實關掉，桌頂嘛愛收拾清氣。用有儀式感的方式共工課收尾，後擺才有好的開始。（對照第268條）

Learn / observe your lead or manager’s h.english: Observe and understand the habits, working style, and preferences of your lead or manager.
Learn / observe your lead or manager’s h.mandarin: 細心觀察並理解你的直屬主管或經理的工作習慣、偏好與節奏。
Learn / observe your lead or manager’s h.taiwanese: 細膩觀察、了解你的直屬主管抑經理做代誌的習慣、偏好佮節奏。

To build up multiple mindset models, the.english: Build multiple mental models as part of your skillset. Step out of your comfort zone to upgrade your competency. Be mentally adaptable (heart-adaptability / Maslow, carrots and sticks). When someone criticizes you face-to-face, manage your reaction and accept that you cannot satisfy everyone.
To build up multiple mindset models, the.mandarin: 建構多元的思維模型，將其納入你的軟實力組合。勇於跨出舒適圈以升級你的能力等級。鍛鍊心理彈性（心適力），理解馬斯洛需求理論，靈活運用胡蘿蔔與大棒。面對他人當面的批評，克制本能反應，明白你不可能取悅所有人。
To build up multiple mindset models, the.taiwanese: 建立濟款的思考模型，共伊囥入去你的軟實力內底。敢踏出四序的圈仔，共家己的能力升級。磨練心理的彈性（心適力），了解馬斯洛需求理論，紅蘿蔔佮大枝棍仔愛活用。別人當面共你批評的時陣，愛忍住本能的反應，知影你無可能予逐家攏歡喜。

Show your competence to your boss or man.english: Demonstrate your competence to your manager. Proactively share your experiences and build a solid expert image within the organization. (Expert Mindset)
Show your competence to your boss or man.mandarin: 向主管展示你的專業能力。積極分享經驗，並在組織中建立清晰的專家形象（專家思維）。
Show your competence to your boss or man.taiwanese: 向主管展示你的專業能力。主動分享經驗，佇團隊中建立專家的形象（專家思維）。

Can predict possible pro and cons for de.english: Anticipate the pros and cons of any decision. Ask: What is the worst-case scenario? Ensure you can survive and sustain operations until conditions return to normal.
Can predict possible pro and cons for de.mandarin: 預測各項決策可能帶來的利弊得失。自問：最壞的情況是什麼？確保你能撐過最壞情境，直到一切恢復正常。
Can predict possible pro and cons for de.taiwanese: 先想看覓逐項決定可能帶來的好處佮歹處。問家己：上歹的情形是按怎？愛確定你會當撐過上歹的時陣，等到一切恢復正常。

Can execute a project for long-term. Sta.english: Build the capacity to manage and execute long-term projects. Stay the course consistently, whether in professional goals or personal life plans.
Can execute a project for long-term. Sta.mandarin: 培養執行長期專案的能力。不論在工作還是生活領域，都要堅持走在設定好的軌道上，深耕累積。
Can execute a project for long-term. Sta.taiwanese: 培養執行長期專案的能力。毋管是工課抑是生活，攏愛堅持行佇設好的軌道頂懸，深耕慢慢仔積。

To avoid receiver think you may be too c.english: If you need to reply quickly on the go, append a disclaimer like 'sent from mobile' to manage expectations and prevent the recipient from mistaking brevity for carelessness.

To avoid receiver think you may be too c.taiwanese: 假使佇外口需要快回 Email，會使在尾端加一句「此信由手機寄送」，避免收件人因為短字而誤認你粗心敷衍。

“I have different opinion” vs “ I disagr.english: Note the difference between 'I have a different opinion' and 'I disagree.' Experiment by using these phrasing variations when replying to your managers, and observe their responses.
