“I have different opinion” vs “ I disagr.taiwanese: 注意「我有無仝的看法」佮「我反對」兩句話意思的精差。試看覓共這兩種講法當做小實驗，用佇回主管的批內底，觀察、分析𪜶的反應佮回覆的方式。

Build a system instead of reaching a goa.english: Focus on building a robust system rather than just reaching a single goal. Learn continuously from your mistakes and practice regular retrospect.
Build a system instead of reaching a goa.mandarin: 專注於建構一個能穩定運作的「系統」，而非僅僅追求單一「目標」。從錯誤中汲取教訓，並培養定期回頭審視的習慣。
Build a system instead of reaching a goa.taiwanese: 專心起一套會當穩定運作的「系統」，毋是干焦追一个「目標」。對錯誤內底學教訓，閣養成定期回頭檢討的習慣。

Mind your business more than other’s bus.english: Focus more on your own business and growth than on other people's affairs. Keep your eyes on overall self-improvement and capacity building, not just financial rewards.
Mind your business more than other’s bus.mandarin: 多關心自己的事，少管別人的閒事。將焦點放在個人的全方位成長與價值提升上，而非僅僅盯著金錢利益。
Mind your business more than other’s bus.taiwanese: 加關心家己的代誌，少管別人的閒事。將重點囥在家己的成長與價值提升，毋是只有看錢。

You cannot keep saving your colleagues..english: You cannot keep rescueing your colleagues indefinitely. You must prioritize securing your own professional capability and growth. (Related to Item 234)
You cannot keep saving your colleagues..mandarin: 你不可能無限制地去拯救水深火熱的同事。你必須先確保自己的核心能力與職涯維持成長軌跡。（對照第234條）
You cannot keep saving your colleagues..taiwanese: 你無可能無限制去救彼寡咧水深火熱的同事。你愛先顧予牢家己的核心能力，予家己的職涯保持咧成長。（對照第234條）

Be curious how your colleagues with good.mandarin: 對績效優秀的同事的工作模式保持好奇心。觀察他們是如何完成任務的，並跨領域吸收他們的長處與工作方法。

Stop negative words otherwise it will hu.english: Eliminate negative phrasing and complaining from your speech; otherwise, it will ultimately damage your professional image and mental energy.
Stop negative words otherwise it will hu.mandarin: 停止使用負面詞彙與抱怨，否則負能量終將反噬你自身的專業形象與大腦能量。
Stop negative words otherwise it will hu.taiwanese: 負面的話佮怨嘆莫閣講矣，若無，彼款負能量尾仔會倒頭咬著你家己的專業形象佮頭殼的能量。

Ask yourself what do you learn today any.english: Ask yourself daily: 'What did I learn today? What progress did I make toward my goals?' Practice this reflection daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly.

Connecting the dot.english: Connect the dots: trust that the unique skills and diverse knowledge you acquire today will eventually link up and serve a purpose in your future.
Connecting the dot.mandarin: 串聯生命中的起點（Connecting the dots）。相信你所積累的每項技能與經歷，日後都會有機地串聯在一起，發揮作用。
Connecting the dot.taiwanese: 共性命中的起點串起來（Connecting the dots）。愛相信你累積的逐項本事佮經歷，以後攏會自然串做伙，發揮作用。

makes rules and follow it. measure time.english: Establish personal rules and stick to them. Measure and track the time spent on each task to maintain efficiency and stay on course. (Related to Item 32)
makes rules and follow it. measure time.mandarin: 制定你的個人原則並嚴格遵守。記錄並分析每項工作花費的時間，確保走在預定軌道上。（對照第32條）
makes rules and follow it. measure time.taiwanese: 訂好你個人的原則，閣愛確實遵守。逐項工課開偌濟時間攏愛記錄、分析，確定家己有行佇排好的軌道頂。（對照第32條）

Reuse your previous works /study and oth.english: Leverage and reuse your own past deliverables and others' studies. Read books, maintain thorough documentation, and review them routinely.
Reuse your previous works /study and oth.mandarin: 學會調用與借鑑你過去的成果或他人的研究。大量閱讀、做好文件記錄與知識存檔，並定期回頭溫故知新。

Always face the questions and solve it n.english: Always confront problems head-on and solve them, no matter how long it takes. Break complex challenges down into smaller, actionable tasks.
Always face the questions and solve it n.mandarin: 直面遭遇的問題，不論要花多久時間，誓要徹底解決它。將複雜的大難題拆解為可以立即執行的小步驟。

Learn WoW, build a system, enhance compe.taiwanese: 共工作方法論（WoW）改予較好、建立系統化的流程，提升毋管去佗一間公司攏紮會走的「可攜式能力」。（對照第219條）

Keep looking for what you want. Stay on.english: Never lose sight of what you truly want. Keep searching and stay firmly on course.

Don’t try to correct others’ WoW or atti.mandarin: 除非他人主動請求指點，否則不要試圖去糾正別人的工作方法或工作態度。（對照第236條）

Don’t debate people or blame. They need.mandarin: 不要無謂地與人爭辯或指責對方，他們必須自己學會解決自己的問題。不隨意批評，避免成為讓人討厭的同事。
Don’t debate people or blame. They need.taiwanese: 莫無意義佮人諍、共人怪，個家己的問題愛家己學會解決。莫隨便批評，莫變做予人討厭的同事。

You get No pay when you complain to othe.taiwanese: 共人怨嘆對你無半項好處。糾正錯誤的時陣，戇人會怨恨你，巧人會感謝你。愛會記得，對人大聲喝、起性地，絕對無法度解決抑是改正錯誤。

Stop unnecessary talking or stop talking.english: Eliminate unnecessary chatter and practice active, deliberate silence when appropriate. (Related to Item 278)

Keeping busy is not good, you won’t get.english: Blind busyness is counterproductive; it deprives you of time to think. Reserve bandwidth to track industry trends. Always clarify the ultimate goal and target.

Reduce the frequency of checking email a.english: Reduce the frequency of checking emails, and disable real-time notifications to preserve focus.

Don’t be over passionate on the tasks wh.taiwanese: 毋是你責任範圍的工課，莫展傷過頭的熱情。上無佇面頂，這款傷超過的雞婆愛藏起來。

Don’t over-do, proactive, some co-operat.english: Avoid over-reaching even when being proactive. Excessive cross-department cooperation can sometimes trigger political friction. Establish and respect clear boundaries.
Don’t over-do, proactive, some co-operat.mandarin: 主動積極的同時切忌越俎代庖。過度的跨部門協作有時會引發敏感的政治問題，必須畫清界線。
Don’t over-do, proactive, some co-operat.taiwanese: 積極主動的同時莫越俎代庖。過度的跨部門協作有時會引發敏感的政治問題，愛畫清楚邊界。

Try to co-work with slacker, procrastina.english: Develop the professional tolerance to collaborate effectively with slackers, procrastinators, and difficult personalities.
Try to co-work with slacker, procrastina.mandarin: 鍛鍊自己的職場適應力，學會與偷懶摸魚者、拖延症患者以及難以相處的人和平共事並拿到成果。
Try to co-work with slacker, procrastina.taiwanese: 愛練家己佇職場的適應力，學會佮偷懶、拖沙的人，閣有歹相處的人和平做伙，閣會當提著成果。

Embrace it! If you're nervous, that's a.english: Embrace it! Feeling nervous is a good sign. It shows that you care and are prepared to succeed. Accept the feeling and leverage it.
Embrace it! If you're nervous, that's a.mandarin: 擁抱緊張感！感到緊張其實是好事，這代表你在乎、且很有可能取得成功。接受它並將它化為動力吧！

Stick with plan, principle you will than.english: Stick to your plans and principles; your future self will thank you. When exhausted, take a rest instead of giving up. Time has a way of resolving most challenges.
Stick with plan, principle you will than.mandarin: 堅守你的計畫與原則，未來的你定會感謝現在的自己。感到累了就休息，但不要輕易放棄，時間終會解決大部分的難題。
Stick with plan, principle you will than.taiwanese: 你的計畫佮原則愛守予牢，未來的你一定會感謝這馬的家己。忝矣就歇睏，毋過莫隨便放棄，時間尾仔會解決大部份的難題。

Difficulties, issue, problem, question,.english: Acknowledge that difficulties, issues, dilemmas, obstacles, and bottlenecks are inevitable. Learn to work with time to resolve them patiently.
Difficulties, issue, problem, question,.mandarin: 坦然面對職場中的挑戰、困難、困境與瓶頸。學會「與時間做朋友」，用耐性逐一化解它們。
Difficulties, issue, problem, question,.taiwanese: 坦然面對挑戰、困難、困境與瓶頸。學會「同時間做朋友」，用耐心慢慢化解怹。

Refresh / retrospective flow, system and.english: Implement regular retrospects to review workflows and systems, establishing Continuous Improvement Programs (CIP / Kaizen) and documenting Best Known Methods (BKM).
Refresh / retrospective flow, system and.mandarin: 定期審視與回顧工作流程及系統，建立「持續改善計畫」（CIP/改善 Kaizen）並發展最佳實踐做法（BKM）。

Finding problems and developing thoughtf.english: Discovering problems and formulating thoughtful, deep questions are essential survival skills, both in your career and daily life.

Not over-reply email next time if no fee.english: If you don't receive feedback on an email thread, avoid over-replying. Be patient and wait for the appropriate follow-up window.

Clean up your desk and add coming task i.english: Clean up your desk, schedule upcoming tasks into your calendar, and shut down your laptop when leaving the office. Treat this routine as a daily closing ritual. (Related to Item 211)

Understand market rules, so you may not.taiwanese: 市場的規律佮遊戲規則愛摸予透，按呢會當幫你指出正確的方向，省掉四界摸的時間。

Don’t make joke which others may not tak.english: Do not make jokes that others might take seriously or find offensive. Keep your mouth shut, stay quiet, and focus on execution until your goals are met. (Related to Item 292)
Don’t make joke which others may not tak.mandarin: 不要開那些可能讓別人覺得不好笑或受冒犯的玩笑。保持靜默，專注於任務執行，在達成目標前無須多言。（對照第292條）
Don’t make joke which others may not tak.taiwanese: 莫亂講笑詼，人聽了無好笑、抑是感覺去予冒犯就害矣。恬恬仔做代誌，目標猶未達到進前，免講傷濟。（對照第292條）

Don’t ask questions if you won’t never g.english: Do not ask questions when you know you will never get a straight or correct answer, or if the topic is politically too sensitive.
Don’t ask questions if you won’t never g.mandarin: 如果你心知肚明絕對得不到真實、正確的答案，或者問題過於敏感，就不要白費力氣提問。
Don’t ask questions if you won’t never g.taiwanese: 假使你知影絕對提袂著真實、正確的答案，抑是問題太敏感，就莫浪費力氣提問。

If not understandable, “please ask again.english: If a request is unclear, ask: 'Could you please elaborate or rephrase using different words?' Seek to understand the ultimate goal and purpose.
If not understandable, “please ask again.mandarin: 如果無法理解對方的意思，大方提出：「請換個說法再說明一次好嗎？」引導對方詳加說明，並釐清任務的核心目的與標的。
If not understandable, “please ask again.taiwanese: 聽無對方的意思，就大方共問：「敢會使換一个講法，閣共我解說一擺？」予對方講較詳細咧，閣共任務真正的目的佮目標釐予清楚。

Need to lock the screen when leaving., c.english: Always lock your computer screen when stepping away, and clean up your desk, especially before leaving for holidays.
Need to lock the screen when leaving., c.mandarin: 離開座位時務必鎖定電腦螢幕。下班或放長假前，將辦公桌面清理乾淨以求資訊安全與整潔。
Need to lock the screen when leaving., c.taiwanese: 離開位仔的時陣，電腦螢幕一定愛鎖起來。下班抑是欲歇長假進前，桌頂愛收拾清氣，資料較安全，看著嘛清爽。

Say “you are right” instead of defense..english: When receiving criticism, start by saying 'You are right' to disarm defense, instead of immediately leading with words like 'but' or 'however'.
Say “you are right” instead of defense..mandarin: 面對質疑或意見時，先說「你是對的」來消弭對立，切忌急著用「但是」等否定詞自我辯解。
Say “you are right” instead of defense..taiwanese: 人對你有疑問抑是意見的時陣，先講「你講了著」，共對立的氣氛化掉，千萬莫隨就用「毋過」這款話替家己辯解。

To accept uncertainty. That is a normal.english: Accept uncertainty as a permanent state. Change is the only constant. Keep yourself well-prepared, strong-willed, growth-oriented, and mature. (Related to Item 296)
To accept uncertainty. That is a normal.mandarin: 學會接受不確定性是未來的常態。改變是唯一不變的事實。隨時做好準備，保持堅韌的意志、成長型思維與成熟的心態。（對照第296條）
To accept uncertainty. That is a normal.taiwanese: 愛學會接受，無確定才是未來的常態；世間只有「變」這件代誌袂變。隨時攢便便，意志愛韌，頭腦愛會成長，心態愛老練。（對照第296條）

Raise your hand and call for help if thi.english: Raise your hand and proactively call for help if a situation goes beyond your control.
Raise your hand and call for help if thi.mandarin: 一旦事情發展超出你的控制範圍，立即舉手尋求協助與外部資源支持。
Raise your hand and call for help if thi.taiwanese: 一旦代誌發展超過你管得到的範疇，著愛隨時夯手討鬥相共，借外部資源來相挺。

Dare to reject the requests which are no.english: Have the courage to decline unreasonable requests. Navigate office politics cautiously and define roles and responsibilities (R/R) clearly.
Dare to reject the requests which are no.mandarin: 勇敢拒絕對方不合理的請求。謹慎應對辦公室政治，明確界定並劃清角色與職責邊界（R/R）。
Dare to reject the requests which are no.taiwanese: 人無理的要求，愛有膽共拒絕。辦公室政治愛細膩應付，角色佮責任的界線（R/R）愛分予清清楚楚。

You cannot do everything in one time. Se.english: You cannot accomplish everything at once. Establish a plan and break the big goal down into smaller, manageable sub-tasks.
You cannot do everything in one time. Se.mandarin: 你不可能一次把所有事情做完。制定可行的計畫，並將專案拆解為更小、更容易執行的子任務。
You cannot do everything in one time. Se.taiwanese: 你無可能一擺共所有代誌做完。做好計畫，並將專案拆解做卡容易執行的小工作。

Do right vs Do quick. It depends on situ.english: Balance doing things correctly versus doing them quickly depending on the situation (Related to Item 312). Practice fast failure, iterate quickly, and focus on finishing what you start.
Do right vs Do quick. It depends on situ.mandarin: 做對還是做快？這取決於具體情境（對照第312條）。快速嘗試、快速失敗並立刻修正，專注於完成任務而非只是盲目開頭。
Do right vs Do quick. It depends on situ.taiwanese: 做著較要緊，抑是做緊較要緊？愛看當時的情形（對照第312條）。緊試、緊失敗、隨改，重點是共代誌做完成，毋是干焦青盲仔起一个頭。

No mercy. No one care who you are. World.english: Understand that the world is indifferent; it will keep spinning regardless of your feelings. Eliminate self-pity and focus single-mindedly on what you want to achieve.
No mercy. No one care who you are. World.mandarin: 職場無情。沒有人會在乎你的個人情緒，不論你怎麼想，地球依然在轉動。放下自憐，專注於你想達成的成果。
No mercy. No one care who you are. World.taiwanese: 職場是無情的。無人會管你心情好穩，毋管你按怎想，地球照常咧轉。莫閣可憐家己，專心佇你想欲達成的成果。

Look the bright side, be optimistic..english: Always look on the bright side and maintain an optimistic, solution-oriented mindset.
Look the bright side, be optimistic..mandarin: 凡事多看光明面，保持樂觀且凡事尋求解決方案的積極心態。
Look the bright side, be optimistic..taiwanese: 凡事看較光明的彼面，心肝放予樂觀，代誌來就想辦法解決。

State the responsibility and role clearl.english: Always clarify and define roles and responsibilities (R/R) at the start of any cooperation.
State the responsibility and role clearl.mandarin: 在任何合作案開跑前，務必明確界定角色與職責邊界（R/R）。
State the responsibility and role clearl.taiwanese: 任何合作案欲起跑進前，一定愛先共角色佮責任的界線（R/R）講予明。

Deliberately not to engaged or not criti.english: Deliberately choose not to engage or criticize. Take a break, be still, and stop chasing toxic 'productivity.' Choose your battles wisely.
Deliberately not to engaged or not criti.mandarin: 刻意選擇不介入爭論、不批評他人。適時給自己放假、讓心靜下來，無須盲目追求所謂的「高生產力」，挑選真正屬於你的戰役。
Deliberately not to engaged or not criti.taiwanese: 刁工莫插人冤家、莫批評人。該歇睏就予家己放假，予心靜落來，免綴人青盲仔拚啥物「高生產力」，揀家己真正值得拍的戰。

Forget about emotion and focus on proble.english: Set aside emotions; focus on problem-solving and professional growth. Improve your quality of life through better communication and refined WoW.
Forget about emotion and focus on proble.mandarin: 拋開情緒用事，專注於解決問題與自我成長。藉由改善溝通技巧與優化工作方法論（WoW），提昇你的生活品質。
Forget about emotion and focus on proble.taiwanese: 莫用情緒做代誌，專心解決問題佮家己成長。共溝通的功夫練予好、工作的方法（WoW）改予較好，生活的品質自然就會提升。

Repeating is part of learning. Try to en.english: Repetition is a fundamental part of learning and mastery. Reframe your mindset and try to enjoy it.
Repeating is part of learning. Try to en.mandarin: 重複是學習與通往精通的必經之路。調整心態，試著去享受反覆練習的過程。
Repeating is part of learning. Try to en.taiwanese: 重複是學習佮精通的必經之路。調整心態，試著享受反覆練習的過程。

Go running/jogging, reading but not comp.english: Spend your energy running, jogging, or reading, rather than wasting it on complaining or criticizing.
Go running/jogging, reading but not comp.mandarin: 把精力投入在慢跑、閱讀等建設性活動上，而不是浪費在無謂的抱怨與批評上。
Go running/jogging, reading but not comp.taiwanese: 共氣力囥佇跑步、讀冊這款有建設性的代誌，莫拍損佇無路用的怨嘆佮批評。

You cannot survive well without principl.english: Without clear personal principles and operating rules, you cannot survive or thrive effectively in a complex environment.
You cannot survive well without principl.mandarin: 在複雜環境中，如果沒有建立清晰的個人原則與行動守則，你將難以安身立命、高效生存。
You cannot survive well without principl.taiwanese: 佇複雜的環境內底，若無家己清楚的原則佮做代誌的規矩，你就真歹徛起，嘛真歹有效率活落去。

Adapted to unknown. Changing is always..english: Learn to adapt to the unknown. Change is constant and inevitable.
Adapted to unknown. Changing is always..mandarin: 學會適應未知的變局。變化無所不在，且無可避免。
Adapted to unknown. Changing is always..taiwanese: 學習適應未知的變局。改變是無所不在，且避無可避。

Premeditatio malorum : 意思是：對邪惡的事先冥思。Item.english: Practice 'Premeditatio Malorum' (pre-meditation of evils / pre-mortem): mentally rehearse worst-case scenarios to stress-test your plans. Balance it to avoid overthinking black swans. (Related to Items 50, 125, and 136)
Premeditatio malorum : 意思是：對邪惡的事先冥思。Item.mandarin: 實踐「對邪惡的事先冥思」（Premeditatio Malorum，即預前驗屍/Pre-mortem）：在腦中模擬並預防最壞情境。但要克制，避免因過度思考黑天鵝事件而導致焦慮。（對照第50、125、136條）
Premeditatio malorum : 意思是：對邪惡的事先冥思。Item.taiwanese: 做「對歹代誌先想予好」（Premeditatio Malorum，就是事先驗屍／Pre-mortem）：佇腦內先模擬上䆀的情形，先共防予好。毋過愛有節制，莫為著烏天鵝的代誌想傷濟，煩惱甲食袂落、睏袂去。（對照第50、125、136條）

Keeping silence, more humor and laugh..english: Keep silent when appropriate, and bring more humor and laughter to your daily interactions.
Keeping silence, more humor and laugh..mandarin: 保持適度的靜默，多用幽默感與笑容化解職場的緊繃感。
Keeping silence, more humor and laugh..taiwanese: 話莫講傷濟，加用一寡幽默佮笑容，共職場內底絚絚的氣氛化予冗。

Your position or skillset is not in that.english: If your current rank or skillset is not yet at the level required for a task, it is wise to keep silent. Reframe the challenge and treat your personal growth as a project.
Your position or skillset is not in that.mandarin: 如果發現自己的職級或技能組合尚不足以應對當前任務，保持沉默是明智的選擇。思考如何自我提升：將你的能力升級視為一個專案來管理。
Your position or skillset is not in that.taiwanese: 若是發覺家己的職級抑功夫猶未夠處理這馬的任務，恬恬看是上巧的選擇。想看覓按怎充實能力：共家己的升級當做專案來好好規劃執行。

Fallacy: confirmation bias, survivor bia.english: Beware of cognitive fallacies: confirmation bias, survivor bias, negativity bias, short-term mindset, and tunnel vision. Never block or damage others' KPIs (台語/Mandarin: M̄-thang tàng lâng ê KPI).
Fallacy: confirmation bias, survivor bia.mandarin: 提防各類認知謬誤：確認偏誤、倖存者偏差、消極偏誤、短期思維與隧道視野。切記，千萬不要擋到別人的 KPI（台語漢字：毋通擋人的 KPI）。
Fallacy: confirmation bias, survivor bia.taiwanese: 小心各類認知謬誤：確認偏誤、倖存者偏差、消極偏誤、短視思維與隧道視野。記住，千萬毋通擋著別人的 KPI（毋通擋人的 KPI）。

In any situation, stay calm. Item388..english: In any situation, maintain your composure and stay calm. (Related to Item 388)
In any situation, stay calm. Item388..mandarin: 不論面對何種突發狀況，務必保持冷靜與克制。（對照第388條）
In any situation, stay calm. Item388..taiwanese: 毋管拄著啥物臨時的狀況，一定愛沉會牢、忍會住。（對照第388條）

80 percentage salary for sick leave.english: Ensure compliance with leave benefits, such as receiving 80% salary compensation for sick leaves.
80 percentage salary for sick leave.mandarin: 掌握勞動權益福利，如普通傷病假可獲得八成薪資保障。
80 percentage salary for sick leave.taiwanese: 掌握勞動權益福利，親像普通傷病假可以提著八成薪水保障。

What is the next killer product and appl.english: Always analyze and keep track of what the next killer product and core application will be in the market. (Related to Item 453)
What is the next killer product and appl.mandarin: 保持前瞻思維，敏銳分析下一個市場上的殺手級產品與核心應用是什麼。（對照第453條）
What is the next killer product and appl.taiwanese: 眼光愛看較遠咧，敏感分析市場上後一个殺手級的產品佮核心應用是啥物。（對照第453條）

No politic in the office and discussion.english: Avoid discussing politics in the office and engaging in gossip with colleagues. (Related to Item 162)
No politic in the office and discussion.mandarin: 避免在辦公室裡討論政治話題，或與同事參與八卦閒聊。（對照第162條）
No politic in the office and discussion.taiwanese: 佇辦公室莫講政治，嘛莫綴同事講人的閒仔話。（對照第162條）

Soft skill to communicate with your team.english: Master the soft skills needed to communicate effectively with team members, leaders, and managers.
Soft skill to communicate with your team.mandarin: 掌握與團隊成員、主管及經理進行有效溝通的職場軟實力。
Soft skill to communicate with your team.taiwanese: 愛學會佮團隊成員、主管佮經理有效溝通的職場軟實力。

You don’t need to move fast but move wit.english: You don't need to move fast, but you must move with steady and stable steps.
You don’t need to move fast but move wit.mandarin: 你不需要追求跑得快，但每一步都要走得穩健扎實。
You don’t need to move fast but move wit.taiwanese: 你免追求走甲緊，毋過逐步攏愛行予在、行予實。

Set up a routine in your calendar (your.english: Schedule a regular slot in your calendar (your personal "daily standup") to review your projects and life routine. Establishing this daily ritual saves decision-making energy and builds an expert mindset.
Set up a routine in your calendar (your.mandarin: 在行事曆上設定固定行程（給自己的每日站會），審視工作專案與生活常規。透過每日儀式感節省大腦的決策能量，建立專家思維。
Set up a routine in your calendar (your.taiwanese: 佇行事曆設一个固定的行程（予家己的每日站會），共工作專案佮生活的日常攏巡一遍。用逐工的儀式感省頭殼做決定的氣力，養成專家的思維。

Schedule your resources / energy (Gantt.english: Manage your resources and energy systematically (like a Gantt chart). Avoid double-booking tasks and balance work with leaves. Mental energy is finite. Work-life balance is a dynamic trade-off; identify future key skills, take action, manage risks, and think probabilistically ("thinking in bets").
Schedule your resources / energy (Gantt.mandarin: 像甘特圖一樣規劃你的時間與能量。不要把多項行程塞在同一個時段，合理調配休假與工作。心智能力是有限的。工作與生活的平衡是動態調配的過程；思考未來需要學習的核心技能，擬定行動並控制風險，保持「以小博大、合理下注」的思維。
Schedule your resources / energy (Gantt.taiwanese: 共你的時間佮精神當做甘特圖來排。莫共幾若个行程窒佇仝一个時段，歇睏佮工課愛調配予合理。頭殼的能力是有限的。工課佮生活的平衡是一直咧調整的過程；愛想以後需要學的核心本事，擬好行動、控制風險，保持「以小博大、合理落注」的思維。

Always have a good relationship with you.english: Always maintain positive relations with assistants, managers, and peers, whether local, foreign, or from other departments (e.g., Supply Chain, WPE, MPE, Assembly, Process Engineering, Quality, and Reliability). Always use a soft and professional tone.
Always have a good relationship with you.mandarin: 不論是本地或外籍同事，還是行政助理、直屬主管及跨部門窗口（如 Supply Chain、WPE、MPE、Assembly、Process Eng、Quality 等），都要維持良好的人際關係。說話語氣保持溫和理性。
Always have a good relationship with you.taiwanese: 毋管是本地抑是外籍的同事，抑是行政助理、直屬主管佮跨部門的窗口（像 Supply Chain、WPE、MPE、Assembly、Process Eng、Quality 等），人際關係攏愛顧予好。講話的口氣愛溫和、有理性。

Distinguish the role and responsibility.english: Clearly define the roles and responsibilities (R&R) among team members. (Related to Item 36)
Distinguish the role and responsibility.mandarin: 明確劃分團隊成員間的職責分工（Role & Responsibility, R&R），避免權責不清。
Distinguish the role and responsibility.taiwanese: 團隊內底逐个人的職責分工（Role & Responsibility, R&R）愛分予清楚，莫予權責烏白攪做伙。

Write down / breakdown task and set dead.english: Write down and break down tasks, then schedule deadlines on your calendar. Draw mind maps, process flows, or Gantt charts to visualize progress.
Write down / breakdown task and set dead.mandarin: 書寫並拆解任務，在行事曆上設定截止日期。繪製心智圖、流程圖或甘特圖來將工作進度視覺化。
Write down / breakdown task and set dead.taiwanese: 共任務寫落來、拆予細，佇行事曆設好期限。畫心智圖、流程圖抑是甘特圖，共工課的進度看會著。

File naming / folder management / file b.english: Implement strict file naming conventions, folder structures, and regular backups. Use detailed naming patterns (e.g., `Product-Stage-SVN-Category-Issue-Version_DATE`) to identify job classifications instantly and facilitate retrieval in seconds as part of knowledge management.
File naming / folder management / file b.mandarin: 落實嚴格的命名規範、資料夾管理與定期備份。採用詳細且長檔名的命名結構（例如：產品-階段-SVN-分類-問題-版本_日期），以便在數秒內精確檢索與辨識，做好知識管理。
File naming / folder management / file b.taiwanese: 命名規範、資料夾管理佮定期備份攏愛確實做。檔名用詳細、較長的結構（比如：產品-階段-SVN-分類-問題-版本_日期），幾秒鐘就揣會著、認會出，知識管理才做會好。

Data can be used to prove or cheat. Stat.english: Data can be used to prove facts or to mislead. Ensure the sample size is statistically significant before using data to back your arguments. Avoid relying on intuition or feeling, which can be misleading. Always ask where the data comes from to avoid causal fallacies, and watch out for large variations (sigma) or outliers that could lead to black swan events. (Related to Item 64)
Data can be used to prove or cheat. Stat.mandarin: 數據可以用來證明事實，也能用來蒙蔽真相。用數據支持論點前，確保樣本數足夠。直覺與感覺往往會誤導你。務必釐清數據的來源以避免因果謬誤；注意過大的變異（Sigma）或被忽略的極端值，防範黑天鵝風險。
Data can be used to prove or cheat. Stat.taiwanese: 數據會當證明事實，嘛會當用來共真相掩崁。用數據撐你的論點進前，樣本數愛確定有夠。直覺佮感覺定定會共你騙去。數據對佗位來的愛查予清楚，才袂誤會因果；愛注意傷大的變異（Sigma）抑是予人放揀的極端值，防備黑天鵝的風險。

Keep principles and follow. Item 14..english: Establish clear working principles and adhere to them consistently. (Related to Item 14)
Keep principles and follow. Item 14..mandarin: 建立明確的工作原則並嚴格遵循。
Keep principles and follow. Item 14..taiwanese: 家己的工作原則愛立予清楚，閣愛確實照咧行。

And tell yourself you (or your colleague.english: Remind yourself and your team that you have done excellent work over the months. Do not let offhand comments affect your self-worth; put your ego aside and focus on facts.
And tell yourself you (or your colleague.mandarin: 告訴自己和團隊：過去幾個月來大家做得棒極了！不要因為某人的一句話就自我懷疑、看輕自己。放下無謂的自尊（Ego），用客觀事實看問題。
And tell yourself you (or your colleague.taiwanese: 共家己佮團隊講：過去這幾個月逐家做甲真讚！莫因為人一句話就懷疑家己、看輕家己。共無意義的面子（Ego）放落，用客觀的事實看問題。

Do not make low tech mistake. Item 50. W.english: Avoid low-tech, careless mistakes that may be irreversible. Perform pre-mortem analysis: ask what the consequences are if we fail, and evaluate the real-world impact to prevent regret. (Related to Item 50)
Do not make low tech mistake. Item 50. W.mandarin: 嚴防那些無法挽回的低級技術性錯誤。開展預前驗屍（Pre-mortem）：思考如果這件事搞砸了會怎樣？不去做會帶來什麼實質處罰或後悔？提前築好防線。
Do not make low tech mistake. Item 50. W.taiwanese: 粗淺閣無法度挽回的技術性錯誤，一定愛嚴防。做預前驗屍（Pre-mortem）：想看這件代誌若舞歹去會按怎？若無做會有啥物實際的處罰抑是後悔？防線愛先築好。

Try to set up firewall to protect yourse.english: Build defensive "firewalls" to protect yourself from others' mistakes. Document everything carefully (e.g., archiving emails, saving meeting minutes, and obtaining CCB approvals).
Try to set up firewall to protect yourse.mandarin: 建立防衛性「防火牆」，避免同事犯錯時波及到你。落實工作留痕與文件化（例如：保存郵件備份、詳細的會議記錄、CCB 變更審查審核記錄）。
Try to set up firewall to protect yourse.taiwanese: 愛起一道防衛性的「防火牆」，免得同事犯錯的時陣牽連著你。工課愛留痕跡、做文件化（比如：保存電子郵件的備份、詳細的會議記錄、CCB 變更審查的審核記錄）。

Focus and Don't get distracted on non-pr.english: Maintain focus and avoid getting distracted by low-priority tasks. Constantly ask yourself: "Why am I doing this?" (Related to Item 14)
Focus and Don't get distracted on non-pr.mandarin: 保持專注，不被非核心的雜務分心。時常拷問自己：「我做這件事的目的是什麼？它能帶來核心價值嗎？」
Focus and Don't get distracted on non-pr.taiwanese: 心愛定，莫予無關緊要的冗雜代誌拖去。定定問家己：「我做這項代誌是為著啥物？伊有法度生出核心價值無？」

What boost you to finish this? And why?.english: Analyze what motivates or blocks you in finishing a task (e.g., recognition, achievement, pressure, financial reward, passion, survival, or simple reality). Understanding your underlying motivation is key. (Related to Item 46)
What boost you to finish this? And why?.mandarin: 分析推動你完成任務或阻礙你前行的動力是什麼？（是成就感、生存壓力、經濟因素、熱情還是現實的職責？）。看清核心動機，有助於調整自身能量與狀態。
What boost you to finish this? And why?.taiwanese: 分析看覓，到底是啥物咧推你共工課做完，抑是咧共你擋路？（是成就感、生活的壓力、經濟的因素、熱情，抑是現實的責任？）。共核心的動機看予清，才有法度調整家己的精神佮狀態。

Remember to protect yourself ( interest).english: Protect your personal interests and learn to keep your mouth shut. Avoid playing the teacher or giving unsolicited advice unless explicitly asked. (Related to Item 88)
Remember to protect yourself ( interest).mandarin: 學會保護自身利益並適時保持沉默。別人在沒主動請教的情況下，不要好為人師去指點別人。
Remember to protect yourself ( interest).taiwanese: 愛會曉保護家己的利益，該恬的時陣就恬恬。人無主動來請教，就莫愛做人的先生去共人指點。

Difficulties will pass away , just be pa.english: Setbacks will eventually pass; practice patience and wait. Sometimes, we need time to allow results to unfold before making the next decision. Remember, you cannot jump from step A to C without going through B. (Related to Items 46, 75, 84, and 131)
Difficulties will pass away , just be pa.mandarin: 難關終究會過去，保持耐心。很多時候我們需要時間讓結果明朗，才能做出下一步的明智決策。你無法不經歷 B，就直接從 A 跳到 C。
Difficulties will pass away , just be pa.taiwanese: 難關總是會過，愛有耐性。真濟時陣，咱需要時間等結果清楚，才有法度做出下一步精光的決定。你無可能無經過 B，就直接對 A 跳去 C。

Before starting meeting, ask people how.english: Before starting a meeting, engage in warm-up conversations (e.g., asking about holidays, family, kids, or the weather). Effective icebreaking builds rapport and facilitates smoother collaboration; prepare a few casual topics or global news in advance.
Before starting meeting, ask people how.mandarin: 在會議正式開始前，主動聊家常（例如詢問週末過得如何、家庭、小孩或天氣）。良好的破冰有助於建立融洽氣氛，讓溝通更順暢。平時可以準備一些全球新聞或輕鬆話題作為素材。
Before starting meeting, ask people how.taiwanese: 會議正式開始進前，主動開講話家常（親像問人歇睏日過了按怎、厝內、囡仔抑是天氣）。好的破冰會使予氣氛較融洽，講話溝通較順。平常時會使準備一寡全世界的新聞抑是輕鬆的話題做材料。

Fallacy: confirmation bias, survivor bia.english: Beware of cognitive fallacies: confirmation bias, survivor bias, negativity bias, short-term mindset, and tunnel vision. Never block or damage others' KPIs (台語/Mandarin: M̄-thang tàng lâng ê KPI).
Fallacy: confirmation bias, survivor bia.mandarin: 提防各類認知謬誤：確認偏誤、倖存者偏差、消極偏誤、短期思維與隧道視野。切記，千萬不要擋到別人的 KPI（台語漢字：毋通擋人的 KPI）。
Fallacy: confirmation bias, survivor bia.taiwanese: 愛防各種頭腦的盲點：確認偏誤、倖存者偏差、消極偏誤、目睭看傷短，佮隧道視野。記咧，千萬毋通擋人的 KPI。

Understand welfare policy, any compensat.english: Fully understand company benefits and welfare policies: food allowances, leave allowances (14–22 days depending on rank), childcare benefits, LTIP, AIP bonuses, RSU vesting, ESPP, health screenings, and business travel policies. Know how to apply and qualify for these. This knowledge is key for financial management and serves as a benchmark when evaluating new job offers.
Understand welfare policy, any compensat.mandarin: 徹底搞懂公司的各項福利與補償政策：伙食津貼、年假（依職級約 14-22 天）、育兒津貼、長期激勵計畫（LTIP）、年度激勵金（AIP）、RSU 股票、ESPP 員工認股、健檢與差旅補助等。掌握申請管道與資格，這不僅是財務管理的一環，也是日後跳槽或離職談判的重要基準。了解在家工作（WFH）的彈性額度（如每年最多20天）。
Understand welfare policy, any compensat.taiwanese: 公司的各種福利佮補償規定愛徹底摸予清楚：伙食津貼、年假（照職級差不多 14-22 工）、育兒津貼、長期激勵計畫（LTIP）、年度激勵金（AIP）、RSU 股票、ESPP 員工認股、健康檢查佮出差補助等等。愛知影按怎申請、啥物資格，這毋但是管錢的一部份，嘛是後擺跳槽抑是離職談判的重要根據。閣愛了解佇厝上班（WFH）有偌濟彈性額度（親像一年上濟20工）。

when you feel frustrated and disappointe.english: When frustrated or disappointed, be patient and take a deep breath. Remind yourself that you did a good job; avoid burnout. Focus strictly on what you can control and let the rest go. Life is not fair, but you must keep moving forward and growing—for yourself, not for the company or colleagues. Life is a struggle to support family and pursue ideals, but stay positive and take it one day at a time. The future you will thank you for trying.
when you feel frustrated and disappointe.mandarin: 感到沮喪和失望時，保持耐心，深呼吸。告訴自己你已經做得很好了，別讓自己燃燒殆盡。專注於你能控制的事，放手那些你無法控制的事。生活確實不公平，但你仍須前行，為了自己（而非公司或同事）持續成長。生活固然辛苦，需要養家糊口並兼顧理想，但請保持積極心態。很多事情在時機成熟前是沒有答案的；努力活出更好的自己，多年後你會深深感謝現在的自己。
when you feel frustrated and disappointe.taiwanese: 心內鬱卒、失望的時陣，愛忍耐，大力吸一口氣。共家己講你已經做甲真好矣，莫共家己燒了了。專心佇你會當控制的代誌，控制袂著的就放手。人生確實無公平，毋過你猶是愛行落去，為著家己（毋是為著公司抑是同事）繼續成長。生活固然艱苦，愛飼家伙閣愛顧理想，毋過心態愛放予正面。真濟代誌時機猶未到就無答案；拍拚活出較好的家己，濟年後你會真感謝這馬的家己。

What are you doing right now? is it alig.english: Ask yourself daily: "What am I doing right now, and is it aligned with my long-term goals?"
What are you doing right now? is it alig.mandarin: 每天自我詰問：「我現在正在做的事，是否與我想要達成的終極目標一致？」
What are you doing right now? is it alig.taiwanese: 逐工問家己：「我這馬咧做的代誌，敢有佮我上尾想欲達成的目標仝一个方向？」

Quick learn / collect the latest informa.english: Develop a method for quick learning and capturing industry trends using structured digital note-taking.
Quick learn / collect the latest informa.mandarin: 建立一套利用數位筆記快速學習與收集未來市場最新資訊的工作方法。
Quick learn / collect the latest informa.taiwanese: 家己建立一套方法，用數位筆記緊緊學，閣收集未來市場上新的資訊。

Evaluate the value of your tasks. In sho.english: Regularly evaluate the value of your tasks from both short-term and long-term perspectives. Aim to extract transferable experience from everything you do.
Evaluate the value of your tasks. In sho.mandarin: 從短期與長期的雙重維度評估你手頭任務的價值。致力於從做過的每件事中吸取能帶得走的實戰經驗。
Evaluate the value of your tasks. In sho.taiwanese: 對短期佮長期兩爿去評估你手頭任務的價值。愛拍拚對做過的逐件代誌，學著紮會走的實戰經驗。

Secure your field ( territory) first and.english: Secure your own professional territory first before expanding. Protect your passion and manage your mental energy.
Secure your field ( territory) first and.mandarin: 先站穩並鞏固你自己的業務領地，再圖擴張。保護好你的工作熱情，做好能量管理。
Secure your field ( territory) first and.taiwanese: 先共家己的業務地盤徛予在、顧予牢，才來想欲擴張。共你工課的熱情保護好，能量管理愛做好。

Reserved your time for exercise, family,.english: Reserve non-negotiable blocks of "sacred time" on your calendar for exercise, family, and learning. Let low-priority tasks go; less is often better.
Reserved your time for exercise, family,.mandarin: 在行事曆上為運動、家人與自學預留不可妥協的「神聖時間」。果斷捨棄次要雜務，越簡單越有力。
Reserved your time for exercise, family,.taiwanese: 佇行事曆替運動、厝內的人佮自學留落無通妥協的「神聖時間」。次要的雜事愛果斷放揀，愈簡單愈有力。

Antifragile, prepare resign letter and u.english: Maintain antifragility: draft a resignation letter and keep your resume updated with the latest industry keywords to attract headhunters. Understand your circle of competence, and maintain contact with recruiters to track market opportunities.
Antifragile, prepare resign letter and u.mandarin: 落實反脆弱思維：寫好一份預備辭職信，並定期更新履歷表（加入最新的業界關鍵字，方便獵頭檢索）。認清自己的能力圈，與獵頭保持定期聯絡以掌握市面上的好機會。
Antifragile, prepare resign letter and u.taiwanese: 愛落實反脆弱的思維：寫好一張預備的辭職批，閣定期更新履歷表（加入上新的業界關鍵字，予獵頭好揣）。認清家己的能力圈，佮獵頭定期聯絡，掌握市面上的好機會。

Care about your instinct, what does it f.english: Listen to your gut instinct and what it is trying to tell you. However, always prioritize objective, scientific data to guide your final decisions.
Care about your instinct, what does it f.mandarin: 重視你的直覺，傾聽它想傳遞給你的警訊。然而，最終決策仍應以客觀、科學的數據為依歸。
Care about your instinct, what does it f.taiwanese: 愛看重你的直覺，聽伊想欲共你講的警訊。毋過上尾的決定，猶是愛以客觀、科學的數據做根據。

Go around when tired in front of laptop,.english: When feeling fatigued sitting in front of your laptop, stand up and walk around. Find a colleague who seems stressed and offer a word of encouragement; helping others boosts your own mood.
Go around when tired in front of laptop,.mandarin: 在電腦前坐累了，就起身走走。若看到顯得焦慮的同事，主動給予鼓勵，關懷他人也能為自己注入正能量。
Go around when tired in front of laptop,.taiwanese: 佇電腦頭前坐忝矣，就徛起來行行咧。若看著同事起煩惱，主動共鼓勵，關心別人嘛會予家己加添正能量。

developing Surviving skill, try to cook.english: Build basic survival and life skills, such as learning to cook your own meals to maintain physical health.
developing Surviving skill, try to cook.mandarin: 培養基本的自主生活技能，例如學會自己下廚準備三餐，這是維持身體健康的基礎。
developing Surviving skill, try to cook.taiwanese: 基本的家己生活本事愛學起來，像家己煮三頓，這是顧身體健康的地基。

do not talk about negative things to you.english: Avoid sharing negative thoughts with colleagues. Focus on positive milestones; this encourages respect and establishes your authority. Complaining or sharing vulnerabilities in the office can cause others to perceive you as weak. Understand that workplace survival requires strategic self-presentation.
do not talk about negative things to you.mandarin: 避免在同事面前流露消極想法。多談論正面、有建設性的事，這能建立你的專業自信並贏得尊重。相反地，頻繁抱怨只會讓旁人質疑你的能力。認清現實：職場是一場表演，為了生存，你必須展現專業與實力。
do not talk about negative things to you.taiwanese: 莫佇同事面頭前展出消極的想法。加講正面、有建設性的代誌，按呢會建立你的專業自信，嘛會得著人的尊重。倒反，若是定定咧怨嘆，別人干焦會懷疑你的能力。愛看清現實：職場就是一齣戲，為著生存，你愛展出專業佮實力。

Check if you are the DRI for the questio.english: When receiving an email, verify if you are the DRI (Directly Responsible Individual). If not, you do not need to reply. Have the courage to decline or cancel meetings that lack clear value, stating your reasons politely.
Check if you are the DRI for the questio.mandarin: 收到郵件時，先確認你是否為該任務的直接負責人（DRI）。若不是，你無須搶著回信。勇敢拒絕或取消無價值的會議，並禮貌地說明理由。
Check if you are the DRI for the questio.taiwanese: 收著批的時陣，先看你敢是這項工課的直接負責人（DRI）。若毋是，就免搶咧回批。無價值的會議愛敢推辭抑是取消，好禮仔共理由講清楚。

Spend time on other field / your favorit.english: Dedicate time to fields outside of work and hobbies to relieve stress (using the SPIRE wellness framework), and strive to achieve solid, measurable results.
Spend time on other field / your favorit.mandarin: 將時間投在工作以外的興趣領域以排解壓力（參考 SPIRE 身心靈平衡指標），並努力取得具體、有成就感的結果。
Spend time on other field / your favorit.taiwanese: 共時間開佇工作以外的興趣來消壓力（參考 SPIRE 身心靈平衡指標），閣愛拍拚做出具體、有成就感的成果。

Add your leave and personal work time, e.english: Block out all leave, personal work time, business trips, and national holidays in your calendar. Set up automatic out-of-office email replies (prompting senders to follow up upon your return if needed). When you return, colleagues can use delayed email delivery to stagger messages. Plan everything directly in your calendar (refer to Item 82).
Add your leave and personal work time, e.mandarin: 在行事曆中完整排定假勤、個人專注工作時間、出差與國定假日。同步設定電子郵件自動回覆（可提醒寄件者於返工後再發送），同仁亦可利用預約定時寄件功能於特定日期遞送郵件。養成將所有工作與休假妥善規劃於行事曆中的習慣（參見第 82 項）。
Add your leave and personal work time, e.taiwanese: 請假、家己專心做工課的時間、出差佮國定假日，攏愛佇行事曆排予齊全。電子郵件的自動回覆嘛愛順紲設好（會使提醒寄批的人等你轉來上班才閣寄），同事嘛會當用預約定時寄件，佇指定的日子才共批寄出去。愛養成共所有工課佮歇睏攏佇行事曆排好勢的習慣（參見第 82 項）。

Ask politely with reason and watch out y.english: Communicate requests politely by providing clear rationale while monitoring your tone of voice. Mastering these soft skills ensures effective and harmonious professional communication.
Ask politely with reason and watch out y.mandarin: 提問或要求時應禮貌並說明具體原因，同時注意說話的語氣與聲調。掌握這類溝通與表達的軟實力，能讓職場互動更加順暢與和諧。
Ask politely with reason and watch out y.taiwanese: 欲問代誌抑是拜託人的時陣，愛有禮貌，閣共具體的原因講清楚，嘛愛注意講話的口氣佮聲調。這款溝通佮表達的軟實力若掠會牢，佇職場佮人來往就會較順、較和氣。

Prepare questions during the meeting. //.english: Prepare thoughtful questions prior to or during meetings by understanding the agenda and desired outcomes (aligning with OKRs). As an autonomous professional, continuously ask yourself sharp questions to drive clarity.
Prepare questions during the meeting. //.mandarin: 開會前與會議中應預先準備好問題，充分理解會議議程與預期目標（結合 OKR 思考）。作為一位自主獨立的專業人士，更要養成向自己提出好問題的習慣。
Prepare questions during the meeting. //.taiwanese: 開會進前佮開會中，問題攏愛先準備好，會議的議程佮欲達成的目標嘛愛摸予清楚（配合 OKR 來想）。做一个家己會出力、會獨立的專業人，閣較愛養成家己問家己好問題的習慣。

Don't jump to conclusions too soon. You.english: Avoid rushing to hasty conclusions driven by instinct or the "lizard brain." Maintain humility and acknowledge that your initial impression could be flawed; keep a mental bias checklist handy.
Don't jump to conclusions too soon. You.mandarin: 切忌過早下定論，避免任由蜥蜴腦（本能衝動）來主導反應。保持謙遜，意識到自己也可能犯錯，並對常見的心理偏見保持警覺。
Don't jump to conclusions too soon. You.taiwanese: 千萬莫傷早落結論，莫予蜥蜴腦（本能衝動）牽咧走。愛謙卑，知影家己嘛有可能會出差錯，對常見的心理偏見愛會警覺。

Smile Always smile. A friend is better t.english: Always maintain a smile; dynamic cooperation is always better than friction. Stay calm and deliberate in all circumstances. Practice box breathing (inhale, hold, exhale, hold) to regulate your emotions under pressure.
Smile Always smile. A friend is better t.mandarin: 保持微笑，多一個朋友少一個敵人。無論面對何種局勢，都要保持冷靜與克制，切勿衝動行事。可透過正念呼吸（吸氣、憋氣、呼氣、憋氣）來穩定情緒。
Smile Always smile. A friend is better t.taiwanese: 面笑笑，加一个朋友、少一个冤家。毋管拄著啥物場面，攏愛沉會牢、忍會住，千萬莫衝碰。心浮的時陣，會使用正念呼吸（吸氣、憋氣、吐氣、憋氣）共心情安予定。

Write down meeting minutes, even no one.english: Proactively take meeting minutes even when not explicitly requested. Keeping clear trace records ensures accountability and allows you to easily reference key decisions in future discussions.
Write down meeting minutes, even no one.mandarin: 即使沒有被要求，也應主動記錄會議摘要或紀錄。這有助於後續追蹤與覆盤，日後亦可作為參考依據，哪怕只是簡短的要點記錄也極具價值。
Write down meeting minutes, even no one.taiwanese: 就算無人叫你做，嘛愛家己主動共會議的重點抑是紀錄寫落來。按呢後續較好追蹤、檢討，以後嘛會當做參考，就算干焦簡單的重點紀錄，嘛真有價值。

Try creating some templates (PowerBI). T.english: Develop standardized templates and automated solutions (such as Power BI dashboards) by learning from successful products. Building scalable, automated processes builds a distinct competitive edge. Be bold and proactive—as the proverb goes, fortune favors the brave.
Try creating some templates (PowerBI). T.mandarin: 善用標竿案例開發標準化範本與自動化流程（例如 Power BI 儀表板），這能顯著提升工作效率並建立個人競爭優勢。保持積極進取的勝任心態，勇於嘗試與創新：「驚驚袂著頂，敢的挾去配」。
Try creating some templates (PowerBI). T.taiwanese: 好好仔利用標竿案例，開發標準化的範本佮自動化的流程（比如 Power BI 儀表板），按呢工作效率會大大提升，嘛會起造家己的競爭優勢。愛保持拍拚向前、有法度擔當的心態，敢試、敢創新：「驚驚袂著等，敢的挾去配」。

Make sure you backup your file regularly.english: Routinely back up your documentation and notes (fleeting, literature, and permanent notes) to cloud storage and dedicated local drives to enable fast retrieval and cross-referencing.
Make sure you backup your file regularly.mandarin: 養成定期備份檔案與筆記（包括閃念筆記、文獻筆記、永久筆記）的習慣。將資料上傳至雲端與硬碟，確保隨時可方便檢索與調閱。
Make sure you backup your file regularly.taiwanese: 愛養成定期共檔案佮筆記（包括閃念筆記、文獻筆記、永久筆記）備份的習慣。資料愛傳去雲端佮硬碟，隨時欲揣、欲提出來看攏方便。

Try to be a leader, for any task or proj.english: Volunteer to lead tasks, projects, or meetings. Taking ownership helps build structured analytical and managerial skills, boosts your professional visibility, and encourages strategic, long-term thinking.
Try to be a leader, for any task or proj.mandarin: 爭取擔任任務、專案或會議的負責人。透過實際主導來淬鍊結構化邏輯與管理思維，累積經驗，提升個人能見度並培養遠見。
Try to be a leader, for any task or proj.taiwanese: 愛爭取做任務、專案抑是會議的負責人。用實際主導來練結構化的邏輯佮管理的思維，累積經驗，予家己較予人看會著，嘛培養看較遠的眼光。

To apply your work skillset into your li.english: Apply professional management skillsets to your personal life to streamline routines and reduce effort. Practice regularly through small, continuous steps instead of pursuing immediate perfection.
To apply your work skillset into your li.mandarin: 將工作上的管理技能延伸運用至日常生活，能讓生活與工作皆大為簡化、事半功倍。透過持續的小步迭代來累積成果，不必過度追求一步到位。
To apply your work skillset into your li.taiwanese: 共工課頂的管理功夫提來用佇日常生活，生活佮工課攏會簡單足濟，事半功倍。一步一步細細仔改、慢慢仔累積，免想欲一擺就做到盡磅。

Be patient. Take deep breath when you fe.english: Maintain patience when encountering chaos—take deep breaths, enjoy a hot beverage, or engage with your favorite media to reset. Slowing down intentionally helps preserve mental clarity when pushing past comfort zones.
Be patient. Take deep breath when you fe.mandarin: 保持耐心。感到混亂時深呼吸，喝杯熱茶適度放鬆（收聽喜愛的影音清單，咖啡適量即可）。適時放慢步調，能幫助你在走出舒適圈時維持內心的平衡。
Be patient. Take deep breath when you fe.taiwanese: 愛有耐性。心肝亂操操的時陣，先吸一下大氣，啉一杯燒茶放輕鬆（聽家己佮意的歌單、影片，咖啡啉適量就好）。該慢就慢，跤步放予在，行出舒適圈的時陣心內才會穩。

Ask your boss how KPI measured and then.english: Clarify KPI evaluation criteria with your manager before submitting annual targets in management tools like Workday. Maintain monthly progress updates, align with unwritten expectations, and break down strategic goals into meaningful, actionable tasks.
Ask your boss how KPI measured and then.mandarin: 主動與主管確認 KPI 評核標準後再填報設定（如在 Workday 系統），並每月定期更新進度。掌握職場的隱形規則，提前規劃年度目標，並將宏大願景拆解為具體可執行的任務。
Ask your boss how KPI measured and then.taiwanese: 先主動佮主管確認 KPI 的考核標準，才去填報設定（親像佇 Workday 系統），逐個月閣愛定期更新進度。職場內底無寫出來的規矩愛摸予清楚，年度目標愛先規劃，共大大的願景拆做一項一項做會到的工課。

try to commit to your mistake and say so.english: Own up to mistakes and apologize promptly when oversights occur. Rely on peer reviews, constructive feedback, and updated checklists to prevent missed details. Regularly conduct retrospectives to iterate, update checklists, and achieve continuous, purpose-driven improvement.
try to commit to your mistake and say so.mandarin: 勇於承認錯誤並及時致歉。意識到個人思慮難免有疏漏，應建立同行審查、同仁回饋與查核清單（Checklist）機制。透過定期覆盤與持續迭代，動態修訂檢核標準，實現以目標為導向的自我完善。
try to commit to your mistake and say so.taiwanese: 有錯就勇敢承認，隨時會失禮。愛知影一个人想代誌難免會有漏勾，所以愛建立同行審查、同事回饋佮查核清單（Checklist）的機制。定期覆盤、繼續改進，檢核的標準跟咧調整，向目標一步一步共家己變較好。

Do not input many information in one tim.english: Avoid overwhelming stakeholders with too much information at once, particularly bad news. Balance negative updates with positive wins when reporting to leadership. Use delayed email delivery to time communication strategically, and keep email layouts clean and concise.
Do not input many information in one tim.mandarin: 避免一次性堆疊過多資訊，尤其是壞消息；向主管回報時應注意好壞訊息的平衡與搭配。完成工作後可運用電子郵件的「預約定時寄件」功能彈性控管發送時機，並保持信件排版簡潔有條理。
Do not input many information in one tim.taiwanese: 莫一擺就共傷濟資訊堆過去，尤其是歹消息；向主管報告的時陣，好消息佮歹消息愛配予平均。工課做好了後，會使用電子郵件的「預約定時寄件」功能，靈活控制寄出去的時機，批的排版嘛愛簡單、有條理。

Try to take a leave for 2-3 days even lo.english: Schedule extended leaves (2-3 days or more) aligned with key family milestones to recharge. Set aside dedicated reflection time in your calendar to review achievements and acquire new skills. Cultivate mental resilience—stay grounded, allow situation dynamics to unfold naturally, and embrace setbacks as growth opportunities.
Try to take a leave for 2-3 days even lo.mandarin: 安排 2-3 天以上的假期（結合家庭重要節日與時程）充充電。在行事曆中為自己預留專屬的覆盤與學習時間。建立強大的心理韌性，保持沉著穩重，讓子彈飛一會兒，將挫折視為成長的一部分。
Try to take a leave for 2-3 days even lo.taiwanese: 安排兩三工以上的假期（配合厝內重要的節日佮時程）充電一下。佇行事曆替家己留專屬的覆盤佮學習時間。愛練出強壯的心理韌性，沉著穩重，予銃子飛一時仔，共挫折當做成長的一部份。

Leverage previous notes for works or oth.english: Leverage past notes and documentation to accelerate new tasks. Block out regular time to summarize project outcomes and conduct thorough retrospectives (refer to Item 38) for future knowledge reuse.
Leverage previous notes for works or oth.mandarin: 善用過往的工作筆記與知識庫來賦能當前任務。養成定時整理與總結工作成果的習慣，妥善留存紀錄以利日後覆盤與經驗傳承（參見第 38 項）。
Leverage previous notes for works or oth.taiwanese: 較早的工作筆記佮知識庫愛會曉提來用，予這馬的工課加較有力。養成定時整理、總結工作成果的習慣，紀錄好好仔收，後擺覆盤佮傳經驗才有通參考（參照第 38 項）。

Try to learn from past experience 復盤, fr.english: Systematically learn from retrospectives, industry peers, and foundational books rather than relying solely on trial and error. Base decisions on data, mathematical statistics, and empirical facts (refer to Item 93). Curate a reference reading list to draw upon when tackling complex challenges.
Try to learn from past experience 復盤, fr.mandarin: 從過往經驗（覆盤）、他人智慧與經典書籍中吸收養分。堅持以數據說話，信賴科學與統計客觀事實（參見第 93 項）。隨時維護一份參考書單，以備面臨決策挑戰時查閱尋求解答。
Try to learn from past experience 復盤, fr.taiwanese: 對較早的經驗（覆盤）、別人的智慧佮經典冊內底吸收養分。堅持用數據講話，相信科學佮統計的客觀事實（參照第 93 項）。手頭隨時顧一份參考冊單，拄著愛做決定的難關，才有通翻來揣答案。

Find out when or what you want to procra.english: Identify your procrastination triggers and practice "eating the frog"—tackling the hardest task first. Step out of your comfort zone into the learning zone, producing tangible deliverables to build accomplishments and share knowledge with others.
Find out when or what you want to procra.mandarin: 釐清引發拖延的誘因，實踐「先吃掉那隻青蛙」原則，優先處理最棘手的任務。勇於跨出舒適圈進入學習區，透過產出實質成果累積成就感，並藉由傳授他人深化自身理解。
Find out when or what you want to procra.taiwanese: 先摸清楚是啥物予你拖沙，照「先食彼隻青蛙」的原則，上歹處理的工課先做。敢跳出舒適圈行入學習區，用做出實在的成果來儉成就感，閣用教別人的方式予家己理解較深。

Dare to disagree with solid evidence and.english: Express disagreement confidently when backed by solid evidence and clear reasoning. Frame discussions around facts and task outcomes rather than personal dynamics (refer to Item 41) to foster constructive discourse.
Dare to disagree with solid evidence and.mandarin: 憑藉紮實的證據與充分理由勇於表達不同意見。掌握建設性對立的技巧（參見第 41 項），堅持對事不對人的原則，清晰展現個人專業見解。
Dare to disagree with solid evidence and.taiwanese: 有紮實的證據佮充分的理由，就愛敢講出無仝的意見。掌握有建設性的對立的技巧（參照第 41 項），堅持論事毋論人，共家己的專業看法清清楚楚展現出來。

Wear headphones to isolation the noisy e.english: Wear noise-canceling headphones to physically and visually isolate yourself from ambient office noise. This establishes clear personal boundaries, signaling to colleagues that you are in deep focus mode.
Wear headphones to isolation the noisy e.mandarin: 佩戴耳機以隔離周遭環境噪音，防止不必要的干擾。這亦能向同仁傳遞正處於高度專注狀態的視覺訊號，維護高效工作的心理距離。
Wear headphones to isolation the noisy e.taiwanese: 掛耳機共四箍輾轉的吵鬧聲隔開，免予無必要的代誌攪擾。這嘛會當予同事看著你這馬當咧專心，顧好認真做工課的心理距離。

What is your biggest day for you company.english: Master your company's critical annual financial and career milestones: KPI performance reviews, AIP incentive payouts, ESPP purchase windows, RSU vesting schedules, and promotion/bonus timelines. Proactively complete annual self-assessments in Workday by early October before management calibration meetings. Focus on high-impact projects that demonstrate tangible value, solicit feedback continuously, and align next year's roadmap early.
What is your biggest day for you company.mandarin: 掌握公司年度重大考核與財務時程（如 KPI 評核、績效獎金 AIP、員工認股 ESPP、RSU 歸屬、晉升加薪及分紅）。每年 10 月初即應主動於 Workday 完成自評與回饋收集，搶在團隊績效排名會議前提交主管。聚焦於具展現價值的亮點專案，並提前於年中規劃下一年度目標與職涯藍圖。
What is your biggest day for you company.taiwanese: 公司每年重大的考核佮財務的時程愛掌握好勢（像 KPI 評核、績效獎金 AIP、員工認股 ESPP、RSU 歸屬、升官加薪佮分紅）。逐年10月初就愛主動佇 Workday 共自評佮回饋收集做好，搶佇團隊績效排名會議進前交予主管。重點囥佇會當展現價值的亮點專案，閣愛佇年中就先共後一年的目標佮職涯藍圖規劃好勢。

Put your ass heavy, you don’t need to re.english: Maintain composure and refrain from reacting instantly to every email, message, or drop-in request. Reserve a buffer time ("safety margin") to assess whether issues resolve themselves naturally, evaluating the true impact of inaction before committing your bandwidth (refer to Item 21).
Put your ass heavy, you don’t need to re.mandarin: 保持沉著冷靜（「屁股要沉」），不必對每封郵件或突然到訪的要求做出即時反應。為自己預留思考的安全邊界，先評估「暫不回應」的影響，觀察局勢發展再做處理（參見第 21 項）。
Put your ass heavy, you don’t need to re.taiwanese: 愛沉會牢、冷靜（「尻川愛沉」），毋免逐封電子郵件抑是忽然來的要求攏隨反應。替家己留一寡思考的安全空間，先評估「暫時無回應」會有啥物影響，看局勢按怎發展才來處理（參照第 21 項）。

Image when project / life running is not.english: Prepare for unexpected disruption and "black swan" events in projects and personal life. Utilize sandbox mental simulation to stress-test scenarios in advance, formulating measured responses for difficult circumstances or impolite interactions.
Image when project / life running is not.mandarin: 預想專案或生活面臨逆境與「黑天鵝」事件的可能。建立沙盒模擬心態進行壓力測試，預先設想各種情境（包括如何應對不禮貌的言行），以確保臨危不亂。
Image when project / life running is not.taiwanese: 先想看覓專案抑是生活拄著歹運佮「烏天鵝」事件的可能。用沙盒模擬的心態做壓力測試，先想好各種情形（包括按怎應付無禮貌的言語佮動作），才袂臨危亂了腳手。

Write down key items which to be checked.english: Document key follow-up items and essential credentials (including laptop passwords) before taking extended leave. Maintaining a simplified post-holiday action list minimizes mental friction upon your return.
Write down key items which to be checked.mandarin: 休假前詳細列出假後待辦事項與關鍵密碼（如電腦登入密碼及帳戶資訊）。透過清單化管理降低複雜度，確保休假歸隊後能迅速無縫無痛重返工作狀態。
Write down key items which to be checked.taiwanese: 放假進前，共收假了後欲做的代誌佮重要的密碼（像電腦登入密碼佮帳號資料）詳細列出來。用清單管理共複雜度降低，收假轉來就會當緊閣順、無痛轉來工作狀態。

What’s the worse situation / scenario /.english: Define the absolute worst-case scenario and bottom line through rigorous stress testing. Evaluate whether risks are temporary or permanent, calculate potential downside impact, and extract valuable lessons from potential failure (refer to Items 50 & 125).
What’s the worse situation / scenario /.mandarin: 釐清最壞的打算與停損底線，進行極限壓力測試。評估衝擊屬於暫時性抑或永久性，量化失敗後的損失與影響，並從中汲取經驗與教訓（參見第 50 與 125 項）。
What’s the worse situation / scenario /.taiwanese: 共上歹的打算佮停損的底線想予清楚，做極限的壓力測試。評估衝擊是暫時的抑是永久的，共失敗了後的損失佮影響量化，閣對內底學著經驗佮教示（參照第 50 佮 125 項）。

Try to co-work with people who you don’t.english: Learn to collaborate effectively with individuals you find difficult. Speak with a steady, gentle tone, practice empathy by putting yourself in their shoes, and focus strictly on operational workflows and tangible results (refer to Items 2 & 153).
Try to co-work with people who you don’t.mandarin: 鍛鍊與個人偏好不同者協同工作的能力。保持溫和穩定的語氣，換位思考展現同理心，將重點聚焦於工作流程（Ways of Working）與最終成果（參見第 2 與 153 項）。
Try to co-work with people who you don’t.taiwanese: 愛練佮個性、喜好佮你無仝的人做伙做工課的本事。口氣愛溫和、穩定，換做對方的位置想，展現同理心，重點囥佇工作流程（Ways of Working）佮上尾的成果（參見第 2 佮 153 項）。

To promote yourself (capability-hard/sof.english: Actively showcase your contributions and expertise (both hard and soft skills). Clearly articulate your value to stakeholders using structured frameworks such as KPIs, OKRs, and OGSM strategic metrics.
To promote yourself (capability-hard/sof.mandarin: 積極展現個人的硬實力與軟實力，清楚闡述自身貢獻。運用 KPI、OKR 與 OGSM 等策略衡量框架，量化呈現工作成效與價值。
To promote yourself (capability-hard/sof.taiwanese: 家己的硬實力佮軟實力愛勇敢展現出來，家己有啥物貢獻愛講予清楚。用 KPI、OKR 佮 OGSM 這款策略衡量框架，共工課的成效佮價值量化呈現出來。

Always do reverse thinking. If you don’t.english: Consistently practice reverse thinking—ask yourself what would happen if you took no action. Challenge assumptions, evaluate effort versus impact, and eliminate non-essential tasks to conserve your bandwidth for high-value priorities (refer to Item 122).
Always do reverse thinking. If you don’t.mandarin: 養成逆向思考的習慣，反思「如果這件事不做會怎樣？」。挑戰反事實與假設，評估成本與效益，透過減少無效益的投入來放大成效，將資源與精力保留給最重要的事情（參見第 122 項）。
Always do reverse thinking. If you don’t.taiwanese: 愛養成倒頭想的習慣，問家己「這件代誌若無做會按怎？」。共反事實佮假設提出來挑戰，算看覓成本佮效益，共無效益的投入減掉，成效才會放大，共資源佮氣力留予上要緊的代誌（參見第 122 項）。

Root cause vs proximate cause, root caus.english: Distinguish between root causes and proximate causes, and master root-cause analysis and problem-solving skills (e.g., BCG structured thinking and Six Thinking Hats: green, red, white, blue, black, and yellow).
Root cause vs proximate cause, root caus.mandarin: 區分根本原因（Root Cause）與近因（Proximate Cause），掌握根本原因分析與問題解決技巧（如 BCG 結構化思考與六頂思考帽：綠、紅、白、藍、黑、黃）。
Root cause vs proximate cause, root caus.taiwanese: 愛分清楚根本原因（Root Cause）佮近因（Proximate Cause），學會根本原因分析佮解決問題的功夫（親像 BCG 結構化思考佮六頂思考帽：青、紅、白、藍、烏、黃）。

Can you / how can you restart when fail?.english: How can you restart after a failure, and how long can you survive if you are laid off or stranded? Remember, setbacks are temporary. Can you transition into another domain? What new hard and soft skills must you acquire for the future?
Can you / how can you restart when fail?.mandarin: 面對失敗時該如何重新出發？若遭解僱或陷入困境，你能撐多久？請記住這只是暫時的。你是否能跨領域尋找新機會？未來又需要學習哪些新的硬實力與軟實力？
Can you / how can you restart when fail?.taiwanese: 拄著失敗的時陣，欲按怎重新出發？若予人辭頭路抑是跋落困境，你會當撐偌久？愛會記得這只是一時的。你敢有法度跨領域去揣新機會？未來閣愛學啥物新的硬實力佮軟實力？

Done is better than perfect. For some, m.english: Done is better than perfect. However, for certain ill-conceived ideas, not starting at all might be the wiser choice.
Done is better than perfect. For some, m.mandarin: 求先有再求好（完成勝過完美）。但對於未成熟或不合適的想法，不盲目啟動或許才是更好的選擇。
Done is better than perfect. For some, m.taiwanese: 先求有才求好（做會完較贏做甲完美）。毋過對猶未成熟抑是無適合的想法，莫青盲牛起步，可能才是較好的選擇。

Dress, speak and behave decently. Item 1.english: Dress, speak, and act appropriately. Make small changes every year and step out of your comfort zone—read books outside your field (such as literature, psychology, or business), vary your running pace and routes, and engage with unfamiliar people.
Dress, speak and behave decently. Item 1.mandarin: 穿著、言語與舉止皆應得體端莊。每年都嘗試一些新改變與突破——例如閱讀不同領域的書籍（人文文學、心理學、市場商業）、改變跑步速度與路線，或主動與不熟悉的人交流。
Dress, speak and behave decently. Item 1.taiwanese: 穿插、講話佮舉止攏愛得體端莊。逐年攏試做寡新的改變佮突破——比如讀無仝領域的冊（人文文學、心理學、市場商業）、改變跑步的速度佮路線，抑是主動佮無熟的人交陪。

Your weak teammate will help you learn m.english: Working with weaker teammates forces you to learn more deeply and become a true expert. However, to save time and foster their growth, guide them to learn independently.
Your weak teammate will help you learn m.mandarin: 與能力較弱的隊友合作能促使你深研業務、成長為專家；但為了提升效率與培養他人，應適度放手讓他們自主學習。
Your weak teammate will help you learn m.taiwanese: 佮能力較弱的隊友做伙，會逼你共業務鑽予深、變做專家；毋過為著效率佮栽培別人，嘛愛適度放手，予個家己去學。

Buy you collogues a drink or coffee. To.english: Treat your colleagues to a drink or coffee to show genuine care, and always remember to express your sincere gratitude.
Buy you collogues a drink or coffee. To.mandarin: 偶爾請同事喝杯飲料或咖啡，表達關心與善意，並適時說聲謝謝。
Buy you collogues a drink or coffee. To.taiwanese: 有當時仔請同事啉一杯飲料抑是咖啡，表示關心佮善意，該講多謝的時陣就愛講。

No coffee after 11:00 AM, 3 cups top per.english: Limit coffee intake: stop drinking coffee after 11:00 AM, capped at a maximum of 3 cups or 1,000 cc per day.
No coffee after 11:00 AM, 3 cups top per.mandarin: 控制咖啡因攝取：上午 11:00 後不再喝咖啡，每日最多不超過 3 杯（上限 1,000 cc）。
No coffee after 11:00 AM, 3 cups top per.taiwanese: 咖啡因愛控制：早起 11:00 以後就莫閣啉咖啡，一工上濟毋通超過 3 杯（上限 1,000 cc）。

Check what kind of skills or tools or kn.english: Assess the skills, tools, and knowledge required in the coming years. List prospective projects and capabilities for next year (e.g., Power BI, O+, R, Python, BB).
Check what kind of skills or tools or kn.mandarin: 盤點未來幾年所需的新技能、工具與專業知識。列出明年的潛在工作任務與學習目標（如 Power BI、O+、R、Python、BB）。
Check what kind of skills or tools or kn.taiwanese: 共未來幾年需要的新技術、工具佮專業知識盤點一擺。共明年可能的工作任務佮學習目標列出來（親像 Power BI、O+、R、Python、BB）。

Keep silence and mouth shut when hearing.english: Remain silent when encountering gossip or rumors, but speak up confidently when demonstrating your domain expertise. Stay humble, refrain from criticizing others, and practice restraint.
Keep silence and mouth shut when hearing.mandarin: 面對八卦流言保持沈默，但在展現專業能力時大膽發聲。不輕易批評他人，保持謙遜，學會藏鋒守拙。
Keep silence and mouth shut when hearing.taiwanese: 拄著八卦風聲就恬恬，毋過欲展現專業本事的時陣就愛大聲講出來。莫隨便批評別人，愛謙卑，學會共鋒頭藏起來。

Show your competence to your boss or man.english: Demonstrate your competence to leadership, share key insights, build an image of expertise through continuous learning, and deliver structured, high-impact status reports.
Show your competence to your boss or man.mandarin: 向主管展現卓越的工作能力與經驗分享，形塑專業權威形象；以專家思維處理工作並落實定期回報。
Show your competence to your boss or man.taiwanese: 對主管展出你上好的工作能力，分享經驗，塑造專業的權威形象；用專家的思維處理工課，閣愛確實定期回報。

To avoid receiver think you may be too c.english: When responding rapidly on mobile, append a tag like 'Sent from mobile phone' or 'Quick response—please let me know if further clarification is needed' to prevent recipients from viewing your reply as overly terse or careless.
To avoid receiver think you may be too c.mandarin: 需要快速回覆郵件時，可在末尾附註「此信件由手機發送，若需進一步說明請告知」，避免收件者誤認為態度草率。
To avoid receiver think you may be too c.taiwanese: 需要緊回批的時陣，會使佇尾仔加一句「這張批是用手機仔寄的，若需要閣較詳細的說明請共我講」，免得收批的人誤會你的態度草草。

Mind your business more than other’s bus.english: Focus on your own growth and core responsibilities rather than meddling in others' affairs. Pursue holistic development, encompassing personal, mental, and spiritual well-being alongside financial goals.
Mind your business more than other’s bus.mandarin: 專注於自身的職責與成長，而非過度干涉他人事務。除了財務回報外，更應追求心靈與精神層面的全面提升。
Mind your business more than other’s bus.taiwanese: 專心顧家己的職責佮成長，莫傷超過去插別人的代誌。除了錢的回報，閣較愛追求心靈佮精神方面的全面提升。

Be curious how your colleagues with good.english: Be curious about how high-performing colleagues execute their tasks. Observe their methods and presentation styles as if watching a masterclass to gain cross-functional insights.
Be curious how your colleagues with good.mandarin: 保持好奇心，觀察績效卓越的同事如何高效完成工作與呈現結果。向不同領域的佼佼者學習，借鑑其精彩的處事方式。
Be curious how your colleagues with good.taiwanese: 愛保持好奇心，看表現上好的同事是按怎有效率共工課做好、共結果呈現出來。愛向無仝領域的頂港有名聲的人學，參考個精彩的做事方法。

What do you believe? And how do you reac.english: What are your core beliefs, and how do you respond when challenged? Are you willing to stand by your principles when facing facts, news, or unverified rumors?
What do you believe? And how do you reac.mandarin: 你的核心信念為何？面對各種事實、新聞或傳言時如何反應？你是否願意堅持自己的原則與立場？
What do you believe? And how do you reac.taiwanese: 你核心的信念是啥物？拄著各種事實、新聞抑是風聲的時陣你會按怎反應？你敢願意堅持家己的原則佮立場？

Make own checklist/principles. Like this.english: Establish your personal operating principles and checklists (similar to this summary sheet) to maintain clarity and efficiency.
Make own checklist/principles. Like this.mandarin: 建立屬於自己的工作準則與檢查清單（如本表），保持行動的系統化與高效。
Make own checklist/principles. Like this.taiwanese: 建立屬於家己的工作準則佮檢查清單（親像這張表），予做代誌有系統閣有效率。

Reduce the frequency of checking email a.english: Reduce the frequency of checking emails and turn off real-time notifications to avoid non-stop context switching and endless social media scrolling.
Reduce the frequency of checking email a.mandarin: 降低查看電子郵件的頻率並關閉即時通知，減少注意力分散與無意識刷社群媒體的時間。
Reduce the frequency of checking email a.taiwanese: 看電子郵件的次數愛減，即時通知關掉，減少注意力分散，嘛減少無意識咧滑社群媒體的時間。

Don’t over-do, proactive, some co-operat.english: Be proactive, but avoid overstepping. Dynamic cross-departmental collaboration can trigger organizational politics; establish clear lines and boundaries.
Don’t over-do, proactive, some co-operat.mandarin: 保持積極主動，但切忌過度跨界。跨部門合作常牽涉組織政治，務必設定清晰的權責界線與分寸。
Don’t over-do, proactive, some co-operat.taiwanese: 愛積極主動，毋過千萬莫踏過界。跨部門合作定定牽涉著組織政治，權責的界線佮分寸一定愛劃予清楚。

Difficulties, issue, problem, question,.english: Navigate challenges, problems, dilemmas, bottlenecks, and setbacks with patience. Allow time to work in your favor as you overcome adversity.
Difficulties, issue, problem, question,.mandarin: 直面工作中的困難、瓶頸、困境與挫折。學會與時間做朋友，穩紮穩打度過逆境。
Difficulties, issue, problem, question,.taiwanese: 工課內底的困難、瓶頸、困境佮挫折攏愛正面面對。學會佮時間做朋友，穩紮穩打行過逆境。

Try to ask / collect salary information.english: Gather detailed compensation benchmarks from headhunters, including key timelines, base salary, bonuses, raises, ESPP, RSUs, family benefits, health checks, gym perks, and net take-home pay.
Try to ask / collect salary information.mandarin: 向獵頭顧問收集全面的薪酬市場資訊，精確了解整體薪酬組合（含底薪、分紅、加薪率、ESPP、RSU、子女與健康福利、稅後淨收入等）。
Try to ask / collect salary information.taiwanese: 向獵頭顧問收集完整的薪水市場資訊，準準了解規个薪酬組合（包括底薪、分紅、加薪率、ESPP、RSU、囡仔佮健康福利、稅後實領等等）。

Use auto email reply when you are busy..english: Set up automatic email replies when you need to focus. Minimize unnecessary email interactions, as constant email checking creates major cognitive noise.
Use auto email reply when you are busy..mandarin: 忙碌或需專注時善用電子郵件自動回覆；減少無謂的郵件傳送，避免信箱成為干擾專注的巨型噪音源。
Use auto email reply when you are busy..taiwanese: 無閒抑是需要專心的時陣，電子郵件的自動回覆愛好好用；無必要的批莫寄，莫予批箱變做攪擾專心的大噪音。

Use common language ( for each position.english: Establish a shared lexicon across different functions and positions to prevent miscommunication and clarify responsibility boundaries.
Use common language ( for each position.mandarin: 在不同崗位間建立共通的工作語言，避免資訊傳遞誤解並明確溝通界線。
Use common language ( for each position.taiwanese: 佇無仝的崗位之間建立共通的工作語言，莫予資訊傳來傳去煞誤會，溝通的界線嘛愛清楚。

Sometimes we need to commit this job is.english: Recognize that a job primarily serves to generate cash flow for your family and asset allocation. Finding your ideal career takes time; build dual income engines and strengthen financial literacy.
Sometimes we need to commit this job is.mandarin: 坦然接受工作首先是為家庭提供穩定現金流的資產配置工具。尋找理想職涯需要時間，應著手建立雙引擎並提升財務智商。
Sometimes we need to commit this job is.taiwanese: 坦然接受：工課頭一項是為厝內提供穩定現金流的資產配置工具。揣理想的職涯需要時間，愛開始建立雙引擎，提升理財的智商。

\"If I do a job in 30 minutes it’s becau.english: "If I complete a job in 30 minutes, it is because I spent 10 years learning how to do it in 30 minutes. You are paying for the years, not the minutes." Yet today, AI might accomplish it in just 1 minute.
\"If I do a job in 30 minutes it’s becau.mandarin: 「如果我能 30 分鐘完成工作，是因為我花了 10 年積累這份能力。你支付的是我十年的努力，而不是 30 分鐘。」然而在 AI 時代，相同任務可能只需 1 分鐘。
\"If I do a job in 30 minutes it’s becau.taiwanese: 「我若會當 30 分鐘做好工課，是因為我開 10 冬去累積這份本事。你付的是我十冬的拍拚，毋是 30 分鐘。」毋過佇 AI 時代，仝款的任務可能干焦愛 1 分鐘。

Don’t ask questions if you won’t never g.english: Refrain from asking questions when you know you will not receive an honest answer, or when the topic is overly sensitive and personal.
Don’t ask questions if you won’t never g.mandarin: 若明知無法獲得真實答覆，或議題過於敏感私密，就切勿貿然追問。
Don’t ask questions if you won’t never g.taiwanese: 若明知問嘛問袂著真話，抑是話題傷敏感、傷私密，就莫硬欲共人問到底。

Raise your hand and call for help if thi.english: Raise your hand and request support promptly when issues exceed your control or fall outside your designated role and responsibility.
Raise your hand and call for help if thi.mandarin: 當問題超出個人掌控或權責範圍時，應及時舉手求助，釐清角色與責任。
Raise your hand and call for help if thi.taiwanese: 問題若超過家己會當控制的範圍，抑是毋是家己的權責，就愛趕緊舉手討救兵，共角色佮責任釐清楚。

You cannot do everything in one time. Se.english: You cannot accomplish everything at once. Formulate a structured plan, break down sub-tasks, and build momentum through small wins.
You cannot do everything in one time. Se.mandarin: 無法一口吃成胖子。制定周全計畫並拆解子任務，靠累積「小勝」一步步推進。
You cannot do everything in one time. Se.taiwanese: 一喙食袂成一个胖子。計畫先拍予周全，大工課拆做細項，一擺贏一點仔，一步一步向前行。

Repeating is part of learning. Try to en.english: Repetition is a fundamental part of learning. Learn to enjoy the process—rep by rep, brick by brick.
Repeating is part of learning. Try to en.mandarin: 重複練習是學習不可或缺的過程。試著去享受它，一次又一次、一磚一瓦積累實力。
Repeating is part of learning. Try to en.taiwanese: 一遍閣一遍練，是學功夫無法度閃的過程。試看覓去享受，一擺閣一擺、一塊磚一塊瓦，共實力儉起來。

Adapted to unknown. Changing is always..english: Adapt to the unknown; change is the only constant. Keep memento mori in mind.
Adapted to unknown. Changing is always..mandarin: 適應未知，變化是唯一的常態。時刻謹記「切記人終將一死（Memento Mori）」，保持謙卑與務實。
Adapted to unknown. Changing is always..taiwanese: 愛適應無法度預料的代誌，變化才是唯一的常態。時時刻刻記咧「人終其尾攏會死（Memento Mori）」，保持謙卑，腳踏實地。

Your position or skillset is not in that.english: If your current position or skillset isn't at the required level for a task, it's best to keep silent. To grow, treat it as a personal project and pursue self-study.
Your position or skillset is not in that.mandarin: 若自身的職位或專業能力尚未達到該任務的要求，保持沉默是明智的。若想突破成長，不妨將其視為一項個人專案，進行自主學習與鑽研。
Your position or skillset is not in that.taiwanese: 若家己的職位抑是專業猶未到彼个任務的要求，恬恬才是巧。若想欲突破、成長，毋妨共當做家己的一个專案，家己來學、來鑽研。

Leader host statement: ( for meeting) I.english: Meeting Leader Statements & Strategies: Reiterate key agreements and confirm understandings ('Let me confirm: I will repeat what you said to make sure I got it right'). Express gratitude to the team ('I received immense help from everyone; thank you for your dedicated hard work'). Clarify follow-ups ('When is our next discussion, and what is the agenda? What is the final goal? Can you complete it on or before the deadline?'). Probe intent using frameworks like PAR (Purpose, Action, Result) or ORID ('Why are we doing this?'). Know how to tactfully decline ('My current skillset isn't suited for this topic, nor is it within my role to address this'). Continually challenge yourself with unfamiliar experiences—such as running a marathon, giving a new presentation, or reading a new book—to broaden your horizon.
Leader host statement: ( for meeting) I.mandarin: 會議主持人關鍵用語與心法：明確確認共識（「讓我複述您所說的，確認我的理解是否正確」）；誠摯感謝團隊（「感謝團隊的全力協助與辛苦付出」）；釐清後續作為與時程（「下次討論的時間、議程與最終目標為何？能否在期限前完成？」）；運用 PAR （目的/行動/結果） 或 ORID 思考架構詢問根本原因；學會委婉拒絕（「這非我專業範疇或職責所在」）；並持續挑戰未曾嘗試的新事（如馬拉松、新演講、新書讀後感），拓展自身視野。
Leader host statement: ( for meeting) I.taiwanese: 會議主持人上要緊的話術佮心法：共識愛確認清楚（「我共你講的閣講一遍，看我了解了有著無」）；誠心感謝團隊（「多謝團隊全力鬥相共，辛苦矣」）；後續欲按怎做、時程愛講明（「下擺討論是當時、議程是啥物、上尾的目標是啥物？期限進前敢做會了？」）；用 PAR（目的／行動／結果）抑是 ORID 的思考架構，問出問題的根頭；學會婉轉拒絕（「這毋是我的專業，嘛毋是我的職責」）；閣愛不時挑戰毋捌做過的新代誌（親像馬拉松、新的演講、新冊的讀後感），共家己的眼界拍予開。

watch out economic environment and indus.english: Pay close attention to economic conditions and industry trends. Your earned income is the bedrock of your retirement plan. If your performance is exceptional and recognized by management, proactively request a promotion; otherwise, hold off. Ensure your annual salary increase outpaces inflation (e.g., 3%) to maintain your purchasing power. Finally, rebalance your asset portfolio regularly, maintain a strong savings rate, and execute your strategy steadily without being swayed by market volatility.
watch out economic environment and indus.mandarin: 時刻關注宏觀經濟與產業趨勢。薪資收入是退休規劃的首要基石；若表現優異且獲主管認可，應積極爭取升遷加薪，否則不宜草率提及。務必確保年度調薪高於市場通膨率（約3%），以防購買力遭侵蝕。同時，落實資產配置與定期再平衡，維持高儲蓄率，心無旁騖地穩健前行。
watch out economic environment and indus.taiwanese: 時時愛注意大環境的經濟佮產業的趨勢。薪水是退休計畫上要緊的地基；若表現好、主管嘛肯定，就愛主動爭取升官加薪，若無，就莫烏白提起。年年調薪一定愛贏過市場的通膨（差不多3%），錢才袂愈來愈薄。同時，資產配置愛做、定期愛閣平衡，儉錢的比例愛懸，心肝定定，穩穩仔向前行。

Spend time to be alone, listen music you.english: Reserve sacred, undisturbed quiet time—whether at work or in private—to be alone, listen to your favorite music, pursue personal goals, or develop new skills. Know yourself and regularly review your goals list.
Spend time to be alone, listen music you.mandarin: 預留神聖的獨處時間（包含工作與私人時間），聽喜歡的音樂、做想做的事或開發第二專長。深入認識自己，定期檢視目標清單。
Spend time to be alone, listen music you.taiwanese: 留一段神聖的孤一人時間（工作佮私人的時間攏有），聽佮意的音樂、做想欲做的代誌，抑是發展第二專長。深深認捌家己，定定掀開目標清單看覓。

What if you got fired, how soon you can.english: Prepare for risk by evaluating your margin for error: If laid off, how quickly can you secure a new job? What are your government unemployment benefits (e.g., 60–80% of insured salary based on dependents)? Have you documented your track record of achievements? How long can your emergency funds and resources sustain you? Continually improve your readiness.
What if you got fired, how soon you can.mandarin: 隨時評估失業風險與容錯空間：若被解僱，多快能找到新工作？是否清楚失業給付（如按投保薪資6至8成發給、扶養親屬加給）及報稅狀況？個人的工作成就是否妥善歸檔帶走？個人資金與資源能支撐多久？持續優化自我轉職與避險能力。
What if you got fired, how soon you can.taiwanese: 隨時算失業的風險佮會當犯錯的空間：若予人辭頭路，偌緊會當揣著新頭路？敢清楚失業給付（像照投保薪資的六到八成發、有扶養親屬會加發）佮報稅的情形？家己工作的成就敢有歸檔好勢通紮走？家己的錢佮資源會當撐偌久？轉換跑道佮避險的本事愛一直加強。

Increase the mobility. Use cellphone to.english: Enhance your operational mobility by leveraging mobile devices and cloud tools for quick information access, while remaining mindful of digital fatigue and addiction.
Increase the mobility. Use cellphone to.mandarin: 提升行動與工作靈活性，善用手機與雲端工具隨時獲取資訊，但須注意避免數位成癮與資訊過載。
Increase the mobility. Use cellphone to.taiwanese: 行動佮工作愛較活跳，勢用手機佮雲端工具隨時提資訊，毋過愛注意莫數位成癮、資訊食傷濟。

Don’t tell your boss whom you don’t like.english: Never confide in your boss about colleagues you dislike—they will sense your bias anyway. Be patient and let situations play out naturally ('let the bullets fly').
Don’t tell your boss whom you don’t like.mandarin: 切勿向主管透露你厭惡誰，因為主管終究會察覺你的偏見。保持平靜，讓子彈飛一會兒，靜觀其變。
Don’t tell your boss whom you don’t like.taiwanese: 千萬莫共主管講你討厭啥人，因為主管早慢會看出你的偏見。心愛平靜，予子彈飛一下，恬恬看變化。

Learn the way manager talks. 5 years pla.english: Adopt the communication style and strategic perspective of management, including thinking in terms of long-term (e.g., 5-year) plans.
Learn the way manager talks. 5 years pla.mandarin: 學習管理者的思維模式與溝通話術，並養成以五年長期計畫構思全局的習慣。
Learn the way manager talks. 5 years pla.taiwanese: 學管理者的思考方式佮講話的話術，養成用五年的長期計畫來想規个局面的習慣。

How many leaves and floating leaves / ye.english: Keep track of your total statutory leave, flexible days off, and annual/monthly leave planning.
How many leaves and floating leaves / ye.mandarin: 掌握個人的特休、彈性假總額，並妥善進行年度與月度排假規劃。
How many leaves and floating leaves / ye.taiwanese: 家己的特休、彈性假總共有偌濟愛掌握清楚，年度佮月份的排假愛規劃予好勢。

80 percentage salary for sick leave. ( i.english: Understand your company's leave benefit policies, such as sick leave pay ratio (e.g., 80% salary or statutory half-pay).
80 percentage salary for sick leave. ( i.mandarin: 清楚瞭解公司各類假別的給薪制度（如病薪扣給付比例或相關法規規定）。
80 percentage salary for sick leave. ( i.taiwanese: 公司各種假的給薪制度愛了解清楚（像病假薪水扣偌濟、發幾成，抑是相關法規按怎規定）。

Find your battle. Same in 424.english: Choose your battles wisely; focus energy only on high-leverage and high-priority challenges.
Find your battle. Same in 424.mandarin: 選擇屬於你的主戰場，將資源與精力聚焦於最具價值的核心目標。
Find your battle. Same in 424.taiwanese: 揀屬於你的主戰場，共資源佮精神氣力集中佇上有價值的核心目標。

Spend more energy in time important thin.english: Allocate a larger share of your time and effort to high-value, high-importance tasks.
Spend more energy in time important thin.mandarin: 將更多時間與心力傾注在真正重要且具長期價值的關鍵事項上。
Spend more energy in time important thin.taiwanese: 共較濟的時間佮心力囥佇真正要緊、有長期價值的關鍵代誌。

Take one week off after Luⁿar new year ..english: Plan a one-week break after Lunar New Year to sync with children's key school milestones (e.g., April and September). Maintain a travel wishlist and vacation agenda, reviewing past trips to continuously improve future plans.
Take one week off after Luⁿar new year ..mandarin: 農曆年後安排一週休假以調整孩子的新學期作息（關注四月與九月關鍵期）。列出旅遊願望清單與排假計畫，並回顧過往行程以持續優化。
Take one week off after Luⁿar new year ..taiwanese: 舊曆年過了排一禮拜的假，予囡仔調整新學期的作息（注意四月佮九月的關鍵期）。列一張旅遊願望清單佮排假計畫，閣回頭看過去的行程，一直改予較好。

Try to move electrical notes obsidian in.english: Migrate your digital notes (e.g., Obsidian) from office computers to a secure cloud synchronization tool or GitHub repository.
Try to move electrical notes obsidian in.mandarin: 將辦公室電腦中的 Obsidian 電子筆記同步至雲端（如 GitHub），建立可隨時調用的知識庫。
Try to move electrical notes obsidian in.taiwanese: 共辦公室電腦內底的 Obsidian 電子筆記同步到雲端（像 GitHub），起一个隨時會當提來用的知識庫。

Check if there is an existing tool to fi.english: Before building custom solutions, check whether existing tools or libraries already solve the problem.
Check if there is an existing tool to fi.mandarin: 遇到問題時，先搜尋並評估市面上是否已有現成的工具或解決方案可直接運用。
Check if there is an existing tool to fi.taiwanese: 拄著問題的時陣，先揣看覓、評估市面上敢有現成的工具抑是辦法通直接用。

What is the skill to be needed? In the f.english: Anticipate the market trends and identify key skills that will be required in the future.
What is the skill to be needed? In the f.mandarin: 洞察未來趨勢，提前識別並布局未來必備的核心技能。
What is the skill to be needed? In the f.taiwanese: 看透未來的趨勢，提早認出、先布局以後一定愛有的核心本事。

BUILD UP CREDIT and relationship, stop g.english: Build strong personal credit, professional credibility, and healthy relationships while refraining from workplace gossip.
BUILD UP CREDIT and relationship, stop g.mandarin: 建立良好信用與人脈網絡，遠離職場流言蜚語。
BUILD UP CREDIT and relationship, stop g.taiwanese: 共家己的信用佮人脈經營予好，職場的閒仔話離較遠咧。

Don’t sent the results out before releas.english: Do not distribute unverified or preliminary results before official release, and always attach clear qualification statements.
Don’t sent the results out before releas.mandarin: 產品或數據尚未正式發布前切勿擅自對外傳送，發布時須附上明確的聲明與範圍說明。
Don’t sent the results out before releas.taiwanese: 產品抑是數據猶未正式發表進前，千萬莫家己烏白傳出去；發表的時陣愛附清楚的聲明佮範圍說明。

Skip the work/email what suddenly throw.english: De-prioritize ad-hoc tasks or incoming emails that unexpectedly interrupt your workflow. Focus on your primary priorities first to avoid distraction.
Skip the work/email what suddenly throw.mandarin: 對於突然插進來的臨時郵件與雜務，先予擱置；優先完成既定的核心工作，避免被分心。
Skip the work/email what suddenly throw.taiwanese: 對臨時𨑨入來的批佮雜事，先囥一邊；先共排好的核心工課做完，莫予人拖去分心。

5S rules &2 mins action save u..english: Apply 5S workspace management principles and the 2-minute rule (do immediate quick tasks right away) to maximize efficiency.
5S rules &2 mins action save u..mandarin: 貫徹 5S 整理整頓原則與「兩分鐘原則」（微小任務立即完成），提升個人與工作環境效能。
5S rules &2 mins action save u..taiwanese: 確實做 5S 整理整頓的原則佮「兩分鐘原則」（細項的工課隨做隨了），予家己佮工作環境的效率提升。

Prepare for oversee job, try and see.english: Prepare yourself for overseas career opportunities; stay curious and willing to step out of your comfort zone.
Prepare for oversee job, try and see.mandarin: 隨時為海外工作機會做好準備，勇敢嘗試，拓展國際視野。
Prepare for oversee job, try and see.taiwanese: 隨時為海外的工作機會準備好勢，有膽去試，共國際的眼界拍予闊。

Be kind to anyone..english: Treat everyone with kindness, empathy, and professional respect.
Be kind to anyone..mandarin: 對待任何人皆保持友善與同理心。
Be kind to anyone..taiwanese: 對待啥物人攏愛友善，有同理心。

Don’t get two engine for investment..english: Avoid maintaining contradictory or competing core strategies (two parallel engines) in your investment portfolio; keep your framework clear and focused.
Don’t get two engine for investment..mandarin: 投資策略應切忌雙重核心（雙引擎矛盾），確保戰略一致性與專注度。
Don’t get two engine for investment..taiwanese: 投資策略上驚雙核心（兩粒引擎相拄相剋），策略愛一致、愛專心。

Make friends with cleaners.english: Build warm, respectful relationships with the cleaning staff and support service team.
Make friends with cleaners.mandarin: 與清潔人員及後勤支援同仁保持良好與友善的互動。
Make friends with cleaners.taiwanese: 佮清潔人員佮後勤支援的同仁，愛保持好來往、友善的互動。

Always prepare your CV updated.english: Keep your resume and profile continuously updated to remain ready for unexpected opportunities.
Always prepare your CV updated.mandarin: 隨時更新個人履歷，保持對職涯機會的敏銳度與準備狀態。
Always prepare your CV updated.taiwanese: 個人的履歷愛定定更新，對職涯的機會保持敏感、隨時準備好勢。
